Definitions.Name: Physician's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You say you're new around here? Welcome! Take these <rApples>, they're on the house! I'm sure they'll come in handy to you.<n><t>Now return to Senna at (2223, 2785).<n><t>(Ditto has given you some "Apples". Drag to F1 - F12 hotkey slot to use as a shortcut.)

Definitions.Name: Survival Compass
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you here to become an Explorer? Explorer often encounter many dangers and have to persevere on their own. Without any proper knowledge, you will not surive in this harsh world as an Explorer. To obtain the <rSurvival Compass>, you will need to go to the <pOutskirt of Argent City>, defeat 5 <bMarsh Spirits> (North of Mine), 10 <bSea Snails> (Seaside) and collect 5 <bTortoise Blood> (Grass Tortoise).<n><t>If you can complete these task, I will give you the <bSurvival Compass>.<n><t>When you have reached level 10, you can come back to become a full fledge Explorer.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Quite a nice performance I must say!<n><t>You have passed the test I had set. This <rSurvival Compass> is what all new Explorer requires. <n><t>Keep it safe and come back to me when you are <pLv10>.

Definitions.Name: Journey of the Voyager
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hoho! You wish to become a Voyager?  Then you must work harder! It will be a promising future for you if you become a Voyager!

Definitions.Name: Journey of the Voyager
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Damn Little Daniel! Only thought of me after so long!

Definitions.Name: Journey of the Voyager
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, a new Voyager, welcome!<n><t>Remember to help me remind Little Daniel that he owe me 50000G...for 5 years already...

Definitions.Name: Journey of the Voyager
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Sailing the sea is perilous. Talk to me if you have any needs. Little Daniel used to help me a lot in the past.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You're new here? People call me <bGoldie>, I'm the Blacksmith of <pArgent City>. I mainly forge swords but I do make quite a bit of sales off other weapons as well. I'm really busy these days but I'll make an exception to help you out since you have beautiful Senna's recommendation.<n><t>Don't forget to return to tell <bSenna> at <j(2223, 2785)> that I'm doing all this for her sake, haha!<n><t>(Goldie has given you a pair of "Newbie Knife". Open your inventory and double click on it to equip.)

Definitions.Name: Walk of the Cleric
Definitions.ResultTalk: This is a gift for me? You are so kind. I will tell the High Priest about it.

Definitions.Name: Walk of the Cleric
Definitions.ResultTalk: So the high priest sent you. I lack some important herbs and you come at the right moment. I will report back to the high priest regarding this matter.

Definitions.Name: Ways of the Seal
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>May the Goddess bless you.<n><t>So you have brought these stuffs to be purified. Very well. I will do my utmost for you in this sacred temple.<n><t>You can go back to Gannon in Shaitan. I prefer to be alone here.<n><t>May the Goddess bless you.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: You're new here?<n><t>People call me <bSmithy>, I'm the Blacksmith of <pShaitan City>. I forge swords and also make quite a bit of sales off other weapons as well. I'm really busy<n><t>Don't forget to return to tell <bNewbie Guile - Resline> at <j(876,3572)> that I'm doing all this for her sake, haha!<n><t>(Smithy has given you a pair of "Newbie Knife". Open your inventory and double click on it to equip.)

Definitions.Name: Welcome
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> Welcome!<n><t>Come to me if you have any questions regarding Classes and Attribute related issue.<n><t>Next I am going to tell you where to buy good weapons in <pArgent City>.<n><t>Since you have leveled up,  you can press the yellow button below your portrait (Alt + A) to open your character page to distribute your stats. Every time you level up, you will received more points for your own allocation. <n><t>You have 5 basic attributes that can be added: Strength which affects your melee attack power; Agility which increases your Attack Speed and Dodge rate; Accuracy which increases your Hit Rate and range attack power; Spirit which increases your Max SP and magical damage; Constitution which increases your defense and Max HP.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Greetings

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bArgent's Blacksmith - Goldie> at <j(2193,2706)>. Return to look for <bNewbie Guide - Senna> at <j(2223,2785)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You will not be able to survive in this harsh world if you are going around unarmed.<n><t>Take this letter to <bArgent's Blacksmith - Goldie> at <j(2193,2706)>. I believe he can be of help to you.<n><t>You can use the Radar (Alt + R) to locate him.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I see, so you've met <bGoldie>. He's the guy to look for when you have made enough money to get a good weapon.

Definitions.Name: Tailor's Greetings

Needs.Description: Hand the letter to <bTailor - Granny Nila> at <j(2267,2704)> and return to <bNewbie Guide - Senna> at <j(2223,2785)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is the second recommendation letter. Pass it to <bTailor - Granny Nila> at <j(2267,2704)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Wow! You mean <bGranny Nila> specially custom made these gloves for you? It looks perfect! I hope you take good care of it.

Definitions.Name: Physician's Greetings

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bPhysician - Ditto> at <j(2250,2770)>. Return to look for <bNewbie Guide Senna> at <j(2223, 2785)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Now, give this final letter to <bPhysician - Ditto> at <j(2250,2770)>. I am quite sure he will be able to render his assistance to you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh.. So <bDitto> gave you some <rApples>. An <rApple> a day keeps the doctor away! It can also recover a bit of HP.

Definitions.Name: Battle training
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hmm, not bad, now that your preparations are ready. Then go ahead and leave the comforts of the city and try some fighting but of course do not travel too far, you may take this as the last test I have for you.<n><t>From this side, head left and your on the right track to exit the city.<n><t>Defeat 5 Forest Spirits and bring back a pair of Wings.<n><t>The forest spirits can be found just outside the city gates while the pair of wing can be found on any forest spirit. Complete the mission and I will give you some nice reward.<n><t>(You can enter combat by just left clicking on the enemy target, however combat cannot be initiated in the city. To pick items, left click on the items or you can use CTRL + A for quick looting.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done, it looks like you now have a good grasp at basic combat and also a good idea on how item drops work.<n><t>Since there is nothing much left, why don't you go and look for my friends? If fighting is your cup of tea, seek out <bMarcusa> at <j<j(2065, 2732)>>. Another person you may like to meet would be <bPhysician Ditto> at <j(2250, 2770)>. Lately, he has been looking for helpers to help her collect more ingredients.<n><t>Good luck!

Definitions.Name: Tailor's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>My my, this is interesting. I haven't seen you around here before. I am <bGranny Nila>, owner of the tailor shop in <pArgent City>. Since Senna has recommended you, I shall have these pair of <rNewbie Gloves> custom-made for you. Do drop by more often in your free time and perhaps we can have a chat.<n><t>Now return to <bNewbie Guide Senna> at <j(2223, 2785)>.<n><t>(Nila has given you a pair of "Newbie Gloves". Open your inventory and double click on it to equip.)

Definitions.Name: Welcome
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ah!<n><t>Another newcomer, welcome! You can come to me if you have any questions regarding Classes and Attribute related issue.<n><t>Next I am going to tell you where to buy good weapons in <pShaitan City>.<n><t>Since you have leveled up,  you can press the yellow button below your protrait (Alt + A) to open your character page to distribute your stats. Every time you level up, you will received more points for your own allocation.<n><t>You have 5 basic attributes that can be added: Strength which affects your melee attack power; Agility which increases your attack speed and dodge rate; Accuracy which increases your hit rate and range attack power; Spirit which increases your max SP and magical damage; Constitution which increases your defense and max HP.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Greetings

Needs.Description: Hand the letter to <bBlacksmith - Smithy> in <pShaitan City> at <j(902, 3495)> and return to <bNewbie Guide Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You will not be able to survive in this harsh world if you are going around unarmed. Take this letter to <bBlacksmith Smithy> at <j(902, 3495)>.<n><t>Check to see if there is any suitable weapon for you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have seen <bSmithy>? Look for him for better weapons when you have earned enough.

Definitions.Name: Tailor's Greetings

Needs.Description: Hand the letter to <bTailor Moya> in <pShaitan City> at <j(894, 3602)> and return to <bNewbie Guide Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Okay, look for the tailor next. You need to send the letter over to <pShaitan City> <bTailor - Moya> at <j(894,3602)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh? So this is the gloves <bMoya> give you? It looks good. You must treasure it well.

Definitions.Name: Physician's Greetings

Needs.Description: Hand the letter to <bPhysician - Shala> in <pShaitan City> at <j(903, 3646)> and return to <bNewbie Guide Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Okay, time for you to visit <bPhysician - Shala> at <j(903, 3646)>. This is the last letter, so hurry up and go quickly.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>These <rApples> given to you by <bShala> are not only good for health, they have healing properties and will allow you to regain a bit of HP.

Definitions.Name: Battle training
Definitions.BeginTalk: Well well, not bad at all! Now that you are sufficiently equipped, you are fit to venture out of town to test out your fighting skills.<n><t>Kill 5 <rBaby Scorpions> outside the eastern side of the city. While you're at it, please collect 1 <rCactus Hairball> from fighting <rMelons> as well. Of course, always remember that safety comes first!<n><t>(You can enter combat by just left clicking on the enemy target, however combat cannot be initiated in the city. To pick items, left click on the items or you can use CTRL + A for quick looting.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done, it looks like you now have a good grasp at basic combat and also a good idea on how item drops work.<n><t>Since there is nothing much left, why don't you go and look for my friends? If fighting is your cup of tea, seek out <bMichael>. He's a patroller and is often seen patrolling about the outskirts of this city at <j(2085, 2742)>. Another person you may like to meet would be Physician <bShala> at <j(2250, 2770)>. Lately, she has been looking for helpers to help him collect more ingredients for her medicine.

Definitions.Name: Tailor's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Keke!<n><t>It is Resline's recommendation letter <n><t>Okay, as usual, this pair of gloves is my gift to you.<n><t>The next time round, I will charge you cheaper when you come to the shop to buy your stuff.<n><t For now, return to <bNewbie Guide Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>. She will introduce you to others.<n><t>(Moya has given you a "Newbie Glove", you can select it from your inventory and equip it).

Definitions.Name: Welcome
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ah!<n><t>Another newcomer, welcome! You can come to me if you have any questions regarding Classes and Attribute related issue.<n><t>Next I am going to tell you where to buy good weapons in <pIcicle City>.<n><t>Since you have leveled up, you can press the yellow button below your protrait (Alt + A) to open your character page to distribute your stats. Every time you level up, you will received more points for your own allocation.<n><t>You have 5 basic attributes that can be added: Strength which affects your melee attack power; Agility which increases your attack speed and dodge rate; Accuracy which increases your hit rate and range attack power; Spirit which increases your max SP and magical damage; Constitution which increases your defense and max HP.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Greetings

Needs.Description: Bring the letter to <bBlacksmith - Bash> in <pIcicle City> at <j(1344, 529)>. Return to <bNewbie Guide Angela> at <j(1315, 507)> after that.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You will not be able to survive in this harsh world if you are going around unarmed. Take this letter to <pArgent City>'s <bBlacksmith Goldie> at <j(2193, 2706)>. I believe he can be of help to you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Have you met <bBash> yet? Did he ask you to introduce a girlfriend to him because he's still single?

Definitions.Name: Tailor's Greetings

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bTailor - Hannah> in <pIcicle City> at <j(1349, 539)>. Return to look for <bNewbie Guide Angela> at <j(1315, 507)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Here's another letter. Please give it <pHannah> <j(1349, 539)>, owner of the tailor shop in Icicle Castle. She'll definitely be glad to help you out.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>So <b Hannah> made you a new glove? It looks good on you. Treasure it well.

Definitions.Name: Physician's Greetings

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bPhysican - Daisha> in <pIcicle City> at <j(1352, 499)>. Return to look for <bNewbie Guide Angela> at <j(1315, 507)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Lastly, remember! Potions are very important for any battle. To get started, bring this letter to <pIcicle City>'s <bPhysican - Daisha> at <j(1352, 499)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hey, these <rApples> are given to you by <bDaisha>.<n><t>Eating <rApples> are beneficial as they can recover a small amount of HP.

Definitions.Name: Battle training
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hmm, not bad.<n><t>Now that your preparations are complete, its time for the special training. Go outside the city and slay 5 <Snow Squirts>.<n><t>Oh by the way, also collect a special seed for me. The Snow Squirt can be found south of the Icicle City gates while the seed can be found on the Snowy Mystic Shrub. Look for me after you have completed your task!<n><t>(You can enter combat by just left clicking on the enemy target, however combat cannot be initiated in the city. To pick items, left click on the items or you can use CTRL + A for quick item loot.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done, it looks like you now have a good grasp at basic combat and also a good idea on how item drops work.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are new around here? I am <bBash>, the Blacksmith of <pIcicle Castle>. I specialize in making weapons and sadly, still single.<n><t>Now return to <bAngela> at <j(1315, 507)>. She will introduce you to other NPCs.<n><t>(Bash has given you a pair of "Newbie Knife". Open your inventory and double click on it to equip.)

Definitions.Name: Tailor's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are new around here, aren't you? Welcome to <pIcicle Castle>. I'm the owner of the tailor shop, <bHannah>. Thank you for the letter, please take these gloves, they are custom made for you. Don't forget to return to <bNewbie Guide Angela> at <j(1315, 507)> and tell her that I've received her letter.<n><t>(Hannah has given you a pair of "Newbie Gloves". Open your inventory and double click on it to equip.)

Definitions.Name: Physician's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> You say you're new around here? Welcome! Take these <rApples>, they're on the house! I'm sure they'll come in handy to you.<n><t>Now return to <bAngela> at <j(1315, 507)>.<n><t>(Daisha has given you some "Apples". Drag to F1 - F12 hotkey slot to use as a shortcut.)

Definitions.Name: Physician's Greetings
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> You say you're new around here? No wonder I haven't seen you in Shaitan before. Welcome! I am <bPhysician - Shala>. Take these <rApples>, they're free this time but next time you'll have to buy them from me.<n><t>Now return to <bNewbie Guide Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>.<n><t>(Shala has given you some "Apples". Place in your shortcut which is labeled by F1 - F12 to use it)

Definitions.Name: Send a letter to Marcusa

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Patrol - Marcusa

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There's nothing more for me to help you with.<n><t>Take this letter to <bMarcusa>, the patroller and see if he has anymore tasks for you. He can be found outside Argent City at <j(2065, 2732)>.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Ditto

Needs.Description: Send the letter to Physician Ditto

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If you like collecting stuff more than fighting, give this letter to the <bPhysician Ditto> at <j(2250, 2770)>. He has a task for you.

Definitions.Name: Send a letter to Marcusa
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It's good that you are here, I could use a helping hand.<n><t>Also, take note of your HP bar while in battle. That's right, the red bar shows your HP level. You will die when it reaches 0. Beware!<n><t>Beside eating "Apples", "Cakes" or other recovery potion, you can press the "Insert" key to increase HP/SP recovery rate.

Definitions.Name: Emergency

Needs.Description: Kill 6 <rMini Bee> and look for <bMarcusa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It is starting to get dangerous around here. There has been reports of a huge swarm of <rMini Bees>. Many have been stung, can you help us to slay 6 <rMini Bees>? There will be a reward.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is good! You are truly a friend. With your help, I will not get punish to wash the socks of the whole battalion again.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Salvier

Needs.Description: Send the letter to Salvier in Argent

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The Mini Bees situation has gotten better. I have a report here regarding the whole incident.<n><t>Can I trust you to deliver this report to Argent's Secretary, <bSalvier> at <j(2219, 2749)>?

Definitions.Name: Letter for Salvier
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>According to <bMarcusa's> report, it states that you played a big role in ridding us of the bees. Well done!

Definitions.Name: Shroom Population

Needs.Description: Kill 8 <rGreedy Shroom> and report back to <bSalvier> in Argent City at <j(2219, 2749)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I don't know which nuisance raise so many <rGreedy Shrooms> ouside the city. Now they have multiplied beyond control. Even though I love drinking mushroom soup, no one is willing to bitten by those <rGreedy Shrooms>.<n><t>I am short of manpower here so I have to trouble you to go to <j(2220, 2564)> and eradicate 8 <rGreedy Shrooms>. Please help out as, if this matter isn't solved, we can't carry on to clear other tasks.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh its done? You are great!<n><t>This is good. With your help, our jobs will be easier.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Goldie

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Blacksmith Goldie

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have an official letter here to deliver to <bArgent's Blacksmith Goldie>.<n><t>You should know him. Go to <j(2193, 2706)> and look for him now.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Goldie
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, it's a letter from <bSalvier>.<n><t>I didn't expect him to dispatch someone like you to deliver this.

Definitions.Name: Conservation Activity

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rGrass Tortoise> and return to <bGoldie> in Argent City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Have you noticed that the greenery surrounding Argent City has been reduced considerably. I heard from that captain that it was due to the voracious appetite of the <rGrass Tortoise> gathering near the city. Please help me kill 12 <rGrass Tortoise> at <j(2057, 2564)>.<n><t>I will give you some reward once it is done and by the way, let me give you some warning. These grass tortoise might be slow but they do have high defence so this task is harder than the ones previously. However it should be suitable for your level.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Completed? Well done! Although the tortoise are pitiful, they need to be killed for our survival.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Senna

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Argent's <bNewbie Guide - Senna>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although we have asked you for help with many of our things, you have also progress much.<n><t>Please take this letter to <bNewbie Guide Senna> at <j(2223, 2785)>.<n><t>After locating her, she'll give you some new instructions.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Senna
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for the letter, it looks like you are quite well liked in Argent City.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion

Needs.Description: Send the letter to Peter in Argent City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Its time for you to choose what you want to be. If you want to be a Swordsman, please go to Argent City and look for Castle Guard, <bPeter>. He can be found at <j(2192, 2767)>. He will test you accordingly.<n><t>Swordsman is the strongest melee class. They can advance to be an agile Crusader and a highly defensive Champion.

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion

Needs.Description: Send the letter to Ray in Icicle City

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Now it is time for you to decide a path of your choice. If you wish to be a hunter, you will have to pass this letter to <bRay> at Icicle City <j(1365,70)>. He will give you a trial to test your ability.<n><t>Hunter is a long ranged character class that uses either bow or firegun, suitable for Lance and Phyllis.

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion

Needs.Description: Bring this letter to <bHigh Priest Gannon> in Shaitan City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It's time for you to choose what you want to be. If you want to be a Herbalist, please go to Shaitan City and look for <bHigh Priest Gannon>. He can be found at <j(862, 3500)>. He'll trial you accordingly.<n><t>Herbalist use their ability to assist others in battle and can advance to either Cleric or Seal Master.

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Little Daniel

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Its time for you to choose what you want to be. If you want to be an Explorer, please go to Argent City and look for <bLittle Daniel> at <j(2193, 2730)>. Bring this letter to him.<n><t>Explorer uses coral to channel their energy and can advance to Voyager. It is the strongest class in the sea.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Since the Newbie Guide recommended you, you must have shown some potential. If you want to become a Swordsman, you'll have to finish the tasks I assign to you.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion

Needs.Description: Hunt 12 <rPiglets> and talk to <bPeter> in Argent City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>So you want to be a Swordsman? You have some guts.<n><t>However courage alone is not enough. To become a Swordsman, you must prove that you have the required ability and intellect.<n><t>Go now to the <pOutskirt of Argent City> and defeat 12 <rPiglets> at <j(1950, 2563)> and then return to me.<n><t>The first test will be completed if you are able to do so.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have done well.<n><t>You have passed the first test to becoming a Swordsman.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion

Needs.Description: Send the letter to General William of the Navy

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Now, report to <bGeneral William> at <j(2277, 2831)> with this letter to prove that you have gotten pass the first part of the trial and he will give you the final quest to become a Swordsman.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, good. Another person interested to become a Swordsman.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion

Needs.Description: Collect 3 <rCashmeres> and talk to <bGeneral William> at <j(2277, 2831)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You wish to pass the test I have set?<n><t>Then go to the <pOutskirts of Argent City> and collect 3 <rCashmeres> and bring it back.<n><t>Once this task is completed, I shall admit that you are a qualifed Swordsman.<n><t>Oh by the way, the cashmere can be found on Cuddly Lambs at <j(2057, 2638)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You succeeded! I am really happy for you!

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion

Needs.Description: Send a letter to <bPeter> in Argent City at <j(2192, 2767)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You've already proven your worth. Go and speak to <bPeter> and tell him that I've approved you to become a Swordsman. This <rCourage Certificate> will serve as proof.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Ditto
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Its good that you are here, I could use a helping hand.

Definitions.Name: Decoction Recipe

Needs.Description: Collect 3 vials of <rOctopus Ink> and report back to <bPhysician Ditto> at <j(2250, 2770)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have an inspiration to make a new kind of medicine suddenly. Sorry to trouble you but could you help me to collect 3 <rOctopus Inks>? These can be found by defeating <rLittle Squidys> near the sea. My new medicine all depends on you!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Very well. Since you have collected the nessaccery items, I can begin my research for a new potion.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Rouri

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Rouri

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My experiments have yet to yield any proper results.<n><t>Looks like I can't help you much. Give this letter to the chairman's assistant, <bRouri> at <j(2240, 2752)>, and see if there's anything you can help out with.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Rouri
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I see, so it was Ditto who recommended you to come here.

Definitions.Name: Mushroom Mushroom

Needs.Description: Collect 6 <rPoison Mushrooms> and look for <bRouri> in Argent City at <j(2240, 2752)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Speaking about it, in the past, I used to raise several <rGreedy Shrooms> outside Argent City. Recently I have been busy experimenting with the recipe so I totally forgotten all about them, seems to me now is a good time to put them to good use. Can you please retrieve 6 <rPoison Mushrooms>?<n><t>Err...Speaking about it, these Greedy Shroom are quite aggressive so its better to bring some healing items just in case. Other than that, these Greedy Shrooms can be found at <j(2220, 2564)>. Have a look, it might be the best time for harvest, everything is in your hands now!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! You have collected all the stuff! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Letter for Coddy

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Sailor Coddy

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Seems that you are very capable.<n><t>Take this letter to <bSailor - Cody> in Argent Harbor at <j(2219, 2911)>.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Coddy
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I see, so it was <bDitto> who recommended you to come here.

Definitions.Name: Lost Items

Needs.Description: Collect 2 vials of <rTortoise Blood> and return to <bSailor - Coddy> in Argent City at <j(2219, 2911)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Previously, I was in charge of a batch of goods at the harbor. Unfortunately, I lost 2 vials of <rTortoise Blood>. This could spell some trouble for me!<n><t>Can you please locate and bring 2 vials of Tortoise Blood for me? It can turn out to be a life threatening situation!<n><t>I remember that the blood can be found on <rGrass Tortoise> at <j(2057, 2564)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great!<n><t>You have saved me! Thank you so much!

Definitions.Name: Letter for Senna

Needs.Description: Bring this letter to Argent's <bNewbie Guide Senna>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although we have asked you for help with many of our things, you have also progress much. Please take this letter to <bNewbie Guide Senna> at <j(2223, 2785)>. After locating her, she'll give you some new instructions.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Senna
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for the letter, it looks like you are quite well liked in Argent City.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Michael

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bGuard - Michael>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There's nothing more for me to help you with.<n><t>Take this letter to <bMichael>, the patroller and see if he has anymore tasks for you. He can be found outside Shaitan City <j(958, 3549)>.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Amos

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bAmos>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If you prefer collecting stuff to fighting, give this letter to <bAmos> the Grocer at <j(840, 3585)>. He has a task for you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Michael
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It's good that you are here, I could use a helping hand.<n><t>Also, take note of your HP bar while in battle. That's right, the red bar shows your HP level. You will die when it reaches 0. Beware!<n><t>Beside eating "Apples", "Cakes" or other recovery potion, you can press the "Insert" key to increase HP/SP recovery rate.

Definitions.Name: Cactus Invasion

Needs.Description: Kill 6 <rCactus> and return to <bMichael> at <j(2065, 2732)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ah! Now the hills surrounding Shaitan city are overflowing with cactus. In my area especially, there are unusually plenty of them. Can you do me a favour? Defeat 15 <rCactus>, they can be found at <j(1031, 3556)> and seems to me you are the most suited for this task.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank God! You've exterminated quite a lot of them.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Franco

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Franco

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Please deliver this letter to my good friend <bFranco> at <j(867, 3660)> in Shaitan City.<n><t>He's an interesting person and will be able to help you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Franco
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, you're <bMichael's> friend? Thank you for the letter..

Definitions.Name: Kicking Monster

Needs.Description: Hunt 8 <rHumpy Camel> and report back to Franco at <j(867, 3660)> in Shaitan.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Have you heard about a creature in the desert that kicks travelers? While on the way to this city, I was kicked and injured by a <rHumpy Camel>. Can you help me to teach them a lesson? Defeating 8 <rHumpy Camels> shouldn't be too hard for you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great. There should not be any further complaint.<n><t>Those camels are really getting out of hand.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Smithy

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Smithy

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Can you deliver this letter to <bBlacksmith Smithy> at <j(902, 3495)>. He's an interesting person and will help you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Smithy
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, <bFranco> sent you to help? That's great! I am short of manpower now!

Definitions.Name: Scorpion Phobia

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rBig Scorpions> and report back to <bBlacksmith Smithy> at <j(902, 3495)> in Shaitan City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To tell you the truth, I ain't afraid of anything but scorpions!<n><t>However my job requires me to constantly travel outside the city to collect quarry!<n><t>It seems that the many giant scorpions suddenly appeared out of nowhere and they are much more powerful than the little scorpions. To be stung by them can be a life threatening situation! Its too scary!<n><t>Please help me kill 12 <Big Scorpions>! You can easily see them at <j(1184, 3557)> but beware of their agile movements, take care!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good! You are the right person for this job. You completed it so fast. That is really brave of you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Bliss

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Shaitan Newbie Guide

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although the people of Shaitan City constantly depended on you for help, however you have grown from the experiences. <n><t>Take this letter to <bNewbie Guide - Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>. She will tell you what to do next.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Bliss
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for the letter, it looks like you are quite well liked in Shaitan City.

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: Since the Newbie Guide recommended you, you must have shown some potential. If you want to become a Herbalist, you'll have to finish the tasks I assign to you.

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion

Needs.Description: Kill 2 <rKiller Cactus> and report back to <bHigh Priest Gannon> at <j(862, 3500)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Why do you want to be a herbalist? Recently, many have tried to be a herbalist just to earn money. You have to prove to me whether you can meet the qualifications of being one.<n><t>I need to test your survivability, proceed to <j(884, 3156)> and kill 2 <rKiller Cactus>. If you able to complete this task at hand, it is considered as passing this part of the test.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Looks like you have succeeded. Well done.

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion

Needs.Description: Send letter to <bNavy HQ - Admiral Nic> at <j(865, 3648)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Please pass this letter to <bNavy HQ - Admiral Nic> at <j(865, 3648)>. She will know what to do.

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You've passed the first part of the trial. Not bad!

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion

Needs.Description: Collect 3 <yMedicated Grass> and return to <bAdmiral Nic> at <j(865, 3648)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Here is where you take the second part of the test to become a herbalist. If you are successful here, you are likely to become a herbalist soon.<n><t>This is the task I have set for you: Gather for me 3 <yMedicated Grass>. It is as simple as that.<n><t>You can obtain them from the <rHopping Lizards> just outside the city at <j(892, 3273)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good. You have completed the task!

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion

Needs.Description: Look for <bHigh Priest Gannon> in Shaitan City at <j(862, 3500)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You have proven that you are worthy. Take this letter to Gannon, I have approved for you to become a Herbalist. This <rRighteous Document> is proof of your success.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Amos
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It's good that you are here, I could use a helping hand.

Definitions.Name: Grafting Analysis

Needs.Description: Collect 6 <rCactus Hairballs> and look for <bAmos> at <j(840, 3585)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do you wish to see flowering Cactus? I'm doing an experiment can you help me gather 6 <rCactus Hairballs>?<n><t>You will be able to find them off the <rMelons> that are outside the city. For now I only need these few but I might have to ask you to get more in future.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good! Now I can start my experiment. Come back next year to see my work!

Definitions.Name: Letter for Lena

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bLena> in Shaitan City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My experiments have yet to yield any proper results.<n><t>Why not you pass this letter to <bLena> at <j(883, 3520)> and see if there's anything you can help out with?

Definitions.Name: Letter for Lena
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are a friend of <bAmos>? Hi!

Definitions.Name: Fake Item

Needs.Description: Collect 3 vials of <rMurky Water> and return to <bLena> in Shaitan City at <j(883, 3520)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Listen to my proposal: Lately, the physician of Icicle City has been collecting the sweat of animals. I want to play a joke on him so I need some materials to make the fakes.<n><t>Help me collect 3 vials of <rMurky Water>. They be found on <rBaby Scorpion> at <j(1184, 3557)>. Just take this as a special request, haha!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Haha! That's great! I'll definitely be able to fool him using these.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Franklin

Needs.Description: Send a letter to <bBuilder Franklin>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have a letter that needs to be delivered.<n><t>Could you take the trouble to give it to <bFranklin the Builder>? He is a friendly fellow and will certainly help you.<n><t>He can be found inside Shaitan City at <j(901, 3668)>.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Franklin
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, a letter from <bLena>! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Medication for Nausea

Needs.Description: Collect 3 <rCactus Blossom> and talk to <bBuilder Franklin> at <j(901, 3668)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I need to collect some medicine that cure seasickness, especially <rCactus Flower> which I am having an acute shortage. Go to <j(1031, 3556)> and collect 3 <rCactus Flower> for me which definitely drop from <rCactus>. At your current level, you should have no problem dealing with them.<n><t>By the way, remember not tell anyone about this recipe for curing seasickness.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I must thanks you. I can start decocting finally.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Bliss

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Shaitan <bNewbie Guide Resline>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although we have asked you for help with many of our things, you have also progress much.<n><t>Please take this letter to <bNewbie Guide Resline> at <j(876, 3572)>.<n><t>After locating her, she will give you some new instructions.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Bliss
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for the letter, it looks like you are quite well liked in Shaitan City.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Little Mo

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bPatrol - Little Mo>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There's nothing more for me to help you with.<n><t>Take this letter to <bLittle Mo>, the patroller and see if he has anymore tasks for you. He can be found outside Icicle Castle at <j(1237, 613)>.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Palpin

Needs.Description: Bring the letter to Grocer Palpin

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If you prefer collecting stuff to fighting, give this letter to <bPalpin> the Grocer at <j(1356, 483)>. He has a task for you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Michael
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It's good that you are here, I could use a helping hand.<n><t>Also, take note of your HP bar while in battle. That's right, the red bar shows your HP level. You will die when it reaches 0. Beware!<n><t>Beside eating "Apples", "Cakes" or other recovery potion, you can press the "Insert" key to increase HP/SP recovery rate.

Definitions.Name: Playful Squidy

Needs.Description: Kill 6 <rSnow Squidy> and report back to <bLittle Mo> at <j(1237, 613)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Lately those Snow Squidy are becoming more playful. They actually attacked me while I was taking a break at my post. Help me teach them a lesson, return after you defeat 6 <rSnow Squidy>.<n><t>Do not take this mission lightly!<n><t>I know your strengths and abilities well enough!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good. Now I can have a good rest.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Ray

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bRay> in Icicle City

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There's not much I can do for you. Take this letter and give it to <bRay> at <j(1365, 570)>. He should be able to help you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Ray
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! <bLittle Mo> send you? Great!

Definitions.Name: There's never too much

Needs.Description: Kill 8 <rSnowy Piglets> and return to <bRay> in Icicle City at <j(1365, 570)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It is a tough time for the people suffering in Icicle City, so the task I am going to entrust you is this: <rSnowy Piglet> consume huge amount of food and are getting out of control, please go to <j(1179, 371)> and destroy 8 <rSnowy Piglets>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Done? Thank you! Those piglets have a big appetite. Seems like I need to have BBQ pork every day!

Definitions.Name: Letter for Hannah

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Tailor - Hannah

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>While I'm currently giving out food to the public, take this letter to <bHannah the Tailor> at <j(1349, 539)>. I think she might have a task for you.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Hannah
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh dear! I need your help so urgently!

Definitions.Name: Wrong Transfer

Needs.Description: Hunt 12 <rLittle Deers> and return to <bHannah> at <j(1349, 539)>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hoho, I have good news! It seems a pack of Little Deer have mistakenly migrated near to the Icicle City. With the current situation at Icicle City, this pack of deers is like a delicacy given by the gods. I want you to travel with haste to <j(1164, 305)>. Hunt and bring back 12 <rLittle Deers> so that we can have a feast tonight.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good! You have done it! I will put aside my duties for those delicious meat! Hehe.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Angela

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Icicle <bNewbie Guide Angela>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although we have asked you for help with many of our things, you have also progress much.<n><t>Please take this letter to <bNewbie Guide Angela> at <j(1315, 507)>.<n><t>After locating her, she will give you some new instructions.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Angela
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for the letter, it looks like you are quite well liked in Icicle Castle.

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: Great! Since the Newbie Guide recommended you, you must be talented. Complete the tasks given to you if you want to become a Hunter.

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rLittle White Deers> and report back to <bRay> in Icicle City at <j(1365, 570)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you here to aquire the Hunter Manual? How brave.<n><t>However, bravery alone isn't enough. To aquire the <rHunter Manual> you are required to prove that you have the required agility and dexterity.<n><t>Go now to <pIcicle City> and capture 12 <rLittle White Deers>. They can be found at <j(1325, 305)>.<n><t>If you are able to complete the task, I will consider that you passed the first part of the test.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have not let me down. You completed the first round of the test.

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion

Needs.Description: Send a letter to <bPatrol - Little Mo>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The second part of the trial is simple. Give this letter to <bLittle Mo> at <j(1237, 613)> and he will tell you what to do for the final part.

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Wow, you've already completed the first part. Congratulations.

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion

Needs.Description: Collect 3 <yBottles> and talk to <bLittle Mo> at <j(1237, 613).

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Let me tell you about the second part of your test. You are required to collect 3 <yMedicine Bottles> and return here. These medicine drop most commonly from <rSnowy Piglets> at <j(1179, 371)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You succeeded! I am really happy for you!

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion

Needs.Description: Talk to <bRay> in Icicle City at <j(1365, 570)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I think you are now fit to become a Hunter. Take this <rHunter Manual> and give it to <bRay> and you'll become a qualified Hunter.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Palpin
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It's good that you are here, I could use a helping hand.

Definitions.Name: Bangle Collection

Needs.Description: Collect 3 <yFat Squid Tentacles> and look for <bPalpin> at <j(1356, 483)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Recently I have been packing my own set of collectors item until I realised that I am missing <yFat Squid Tentacle>. Can you help get 3 <yFat Squid Tentacle>?<n><t>You can get them from <rSnow Squirt> at <j(1465, 402)>. They usually appear near the city gates.<n><t>This is the current task I want you to do!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! I have more stuff to add to my collection.<n><t>Thank you! I will need your help in the future as well.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Yaskey

Needs.Description: Send a letter to <bYaskey> in Icicle City at <j(1290, 540)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I need to trouble you once again. Please send this letter to <bSidorf> at <j(1290, 540)>. He can help you too.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Yaskey
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, <bPalpin> sent you to help out? That's great!

Definitions.Name: Concoction

Needs.Description: Collect 2 <yBottles> and return to <bYaskey> in Icicle City at <j(964, 422)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Recently, there were several incident where a lot of my bottles broke due to accidents.<n><t>Give me a hand! Go to <j(1118, 343)> and obtain 2 <yMedicine Bottles> from <rSnowy Piglets>. In this way, at least I have some replacements.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hoho! Now I have more space for my ingredient!

Definitions.Name: Letter for Belinda

Needs.Description: Send the letter to <bBelinda> in Icicle Castle

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Please deliver this letter <bBelinda>, she can be found at <j(1360, 519)> in Icicle Castle.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Belinda
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I'm surprised that the Innkeeper recommended you. You must be quite capable.

Definitions.Name: Tear

Needs.Description: Collect 1 <yTear> and return to <bBelinda> in Icicle City at <j(1360, 519)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Rumors has it that the tears of <rLittle Deer> at <j(1164, 305)> and <rLittle White Deer> at <j(1325, 305)> can be used to make jewellery that will bring luck to those who wear it!<n><t>Can you find 1 for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! With these I can make a great necklace!

Definitions.Name: Letter for Angela

Needs.Description: Send a letter to Icicle <bNewbie Guide Angela>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although we have asked you for help with many of our things, you have also progress much.<n><t>Please take this letter to <bNewbie Guide Angela> at <j(1315, 507)>.<n><t>After locating her, she will give you some new instructions.

Definitions.Name: Letter for Angela
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for the letter, it looks like you are quite well liked in Icicle Castle.

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: Good. Since you are recommended by the Newbie Guide, you should be quite capable. Complete the tasks I have for you if you want to be an Explorer.

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rPiglets> and report back to <bLittle Daniel> in Argent City at <j(2193, 2730)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you here to sign up for the training to be an Explorer? An Explorer often encounter dangers alone while in the seas. To be able to survive is a basic requirement. If you wish to obtain <rSurvival Guide>, proceed to the Outskirts of Argent City and defeat 12 <rPiglets> at <j(1950, 2563)>. I will tell you your next task once you complete your job.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have done well!<n><t>Since you have passed my test, go forth and take up the last part of your trial now!

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion

Needs.Description: Send a letter to <bGeneral - William>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><t>Now, report to <bGeneral William> at <j(2277,2831)> with this letter to prove that you have gotten pass the first part of the trial. He will ask you to take on the final part of the trial and complete the whole advancement.

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, another adventurous traveler. I hope you are well prepared.

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion

Needs.Description: Collect 2 <yPoisoned Fruits> and return to <bWilliam> at <j(2277,2831)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Head north-east from <pSilver Mine> and obtain 2 <yPoisoned Fruits> from <rMarsh Spirit> at <j(1978,2643) and you'll pass the trial.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Not bad, you have succeeded!<n><t>Congratulations! A journey of dangers and mystery is waiting for you, though my only hope is that you don't become a pirate...

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion

Needs.Description: Bring <rSurvival Compass> to <bLittle Daniel> in Argent City at <j(2193, 2730)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Take this <rSurivial Compass> and give it to <bLittle Daniel> at <j(2193,2730)>. It will prove that you have passed all of the test to be a qualified Explorer.

Definitions.Name: Secretary Message

Needs.Description: Look for <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier> at <j(2219,2749)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey there, right on time. I have received a request from <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier>. He wishes to meet you after hearing of the deeds you have accomplished. Go quickly and good luck.

Definitions.Name: Secretary Message

Needs.Description: Look for <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier> inside <pArgent City> at <j(2219,2749)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey there, right on time. I have received a request from <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier>. He wishes to meet you after hearing of the deeds you have accomplished. Go quickly and good luck.

Definitions.Name: Secretary Message

Needs.Description: Look for <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier> inside <pArgent City> at <j(2219,2749)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey there, right on time. I have received a request from <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier>. He wishes to meet you after hearing of the deeds you have accomplished. Go quickly and good luck.

Definitions.Name: A Small Task

Needs.Description: Look for <bGeneral - William> at <j(2277,2831)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Actually, I wanted to ask you to investigate certain strange happenings in <pShepherd Plains>.<n><t>However, before that, I still have to test you.<n><t>Go to <bGeneral - William> at <j(2277,2831)>. He will give you the next task.

Definitions.Name: Missing Tommy

Needs.Description: Look for <bTommy> at <j(1962,2694)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since your're here, why dont you help us find a missing child. His name is <bTommy>. He was last seen playing near the <pSilver Mine>. Bring him back home safely please!

Definitions.Name: Report to General

Needs.Description: Hand the letter to <bGeneral - William> at <j(2277,2831)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am surprised that the Navy General is worried about me. I would like to thank him for his concerns. Take this letter to him so that he knows I am safe. I am going to stay here for a little while more before returning home.

Definitions.Name: Food Poisoning
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Everyone has been Poisoned?! <n><t>Let me take a look�� Wow, it looks too yummy to be poisonous doesn't it?

Definitions.Name: Tommy's Request

Needs.Description: Ask <bPhysicial - Ditto> at <j(2250,2770)> about the <rWhacky Lamb> incident.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bTommy>'s letter has confirmed that the sheeps that he saw were getting crazy and out of control more often than usual. We decided to call these changed creatures "Feral".<n><t>This is also happens to be one of the case that <bSalvier> wanted you to investigate. I suggest you to talk to <bPhysicial - Ditto> at <j(2250,2770)> for more information.

Definitions.Name: Ditto's Report

Needs.Description: Send the report to <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier> inside <pArgent City> at <j(2219,2749)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This investigation will take me some time, I have written a preliminary <yReport>.<n><t>Please deliver it to <bArgent's Secretary - Salvier> inside <pArgent City> at <j(2219,2749)> to update him on our current situation.

Definitions.Name: A New Task

Needs.Description: Hand the letter to <bSecurity - Kal> at <j(1909,2820)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Rumor has it that there are endless troubles at <pAbandoned Mine Haven>. Here, take this recommendation letter and report to <bSecurity - Kal> at <j(1909,2820)>. New task awaits you over there.

Definitions.Name: Desert Visit

Needs.Description: Look for <bShaitan Clan Chieftain> at <j(898, 3640)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>A <ySecretary Letter> from <bSecretary Salvier> has asked me to inform you to head towards <pShaitan City> in the <pMagical Ocean> region. Look for <bClan Chief Albuda> at <j(898, 3640)> as he has more information about the unusual cases revolving around feral and poisonous animals.

Definitions.Name: Changes
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Baa...I'm <bWelly the Sheep>!<n><t>Wondering how did I start talking?<n><t>Not too long ago, I was taking a nice evening stroll. Baa...Don't you know? Even sheeps need to relax every now and then.<n><t>Anyway, I remember seeing a round egg shaped fruit washed up on shore, it looked good enough to eat.<n><t>Baa...Next thing I knew, I could speak to humans!<n><t>The <bClan Chief> was nice enough to let me stay in town. Baa...tell him I said "Hello" when you meet him.

Definitions.Name: Roland's Notebook

Needs.Description: Ask <bGuard - Michael> at <j(958,3549)> about the progress of the investigation.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hmm...A <yStrange Fruit> which floated ashore? I remember I read about something like that, but where? Let me think...<n><t>Oh right! Its the <bPirate King Roland>'s <yJournal Log>! Our Shaitan library once had the Pirate King's log, it was a long long time ago...<n><t>Its a pity that our library was broken into before you came. Many navigation related books were stolen, even our Lee family genealogy book! The person in charge of investigating is <bPatroller Micheal> at <j(958, 3549)>. I think that it might be a good idea for you get more details from him.

Definitions.Name: Clues

Needs.Description: Find <bSand Bandit - Supermun> at <j(1080,3086)> for more info.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Based on my investigations on the clues, the <rSand Bandit> are definitely responsible for this incident!<n><t>They are the most organised outlaws in this desert!<n><t>How about this, I do know of a weird sand bandit named <bSupermun>, it seems that he is unhappy with the bandit current leadership. He can be found at <pChaotic Oasis> at <j(1080,3086)>, west of <pBabul Haven>. Find out about the current situation from him.

Definitions.Name: The Truth

Needs.Description: Tell the truth to <bGuard - Michael> at <j(958,3549)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since you have helped me to become the new leader of the Sand Bandits, I shall tell you the truth. <n><t>We, the Sand Bandits have an alliance with a group of pirates so I helped them steal the logbook. <n><t>The infamous, "Jack's Pirates", has been trying to find the lost treasure of the <bPirate King Roland>. The secret is believed to be hidden inside the Pirate King's log. Now go and report back to <bMichael>!

Definitions.Name: Buccaneer's News

Needs.Description: Look for <bCoaster Guard - Franco> at <j(867,3660)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although we cannot arrest <bSupermun>, we can investigate on the pirates.<n><t>First, I'll need to report to the <bClan Chief> on the progress of the investigation. Hmm...Could you please go to <pShaitan Harbor> and look for <bCoaster Guard - Franco> at <j(867,3660)>? He will provide further information on the pirates.

Definitions.Name: Jack's Pirates

Needs.Description: Look for <bMerix> at <j(1118,3611)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh, so you wish to know about <rJack's Pirate Crew>. At the beginning, this group of pirates started to turn up in large numbers within the city. However as they did not create any trouble, we the city guards didn't take any action. Lately, they started to appear in the southern desert which is weird.<n><t>The desert belongs to the sand bandits.<n><t>Can it be that they are changing to becoming bandits? Haha...<n><t>For things happening in the desert, you can look for the mysterious <bMerrix> at <j(1118, 3611)>. For some reason, she always know the secrets. Rumor has it that she is the secret agent between Thundoria Castle and Shaitan City. After you exit the city, follow along the coast eastwards and you will find her near a sunken ship.

Definitions.Name: To Whom It May Concern

Needs.Description: Look for the guy codenamed "J"

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have inspected the bag, it seems to contain letters from a mysterious "J" person. It seems to be that <rJack's Pirates> is just working on direct orders from "J". I wonder who this <r"J"> is.<n><t>I have an idea! Let me forge this letter and you take it around town pretending to have "picked" it up from nowhere, perhaps you may find this mysterious "J"

Definitions.Name: Journey to the North

Needs.Description: Look for <bIcicle Swordsman- Ray> at <j(365,570)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It seems that I must go alone to investigate the pirates. I know that <bSecretary Salvier> originally sent you here to investigate the feral animals situation.<n><t>Have you been to the <pIcicle Castle>? It snows there all year round. Recently, it has been overrun by undead. The place is in ruins.<n><t>If you are undaunted by danger, please go and assist <bIcicle Swordsman- Ray> at <j(365,570)>, perhaps he may return the favor.

Definitions.Name: Danger in Icicle

Needs.Description: Look for <bIcicle Royal - Mas> at <j(1346,451)> and inquire about the crisis.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My apologies for my manners earlier. We have been pushed to the brink of sanity due to the recent troubles.<n><t>I'll take a good holiday in the desert once all these is over.<n><t>Talk to <bIcicle Royal - Mas> at <j(1346,451)>. He should be able to help you.

Definitions.Name: Replenishment

Needs.Description: Ask <bPatrol - Little Mo> at <j(1237,613)> about the incident.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The present troubles has caused our situation to change greatly for the worst. The reinforcements from Thundoria Castle has been ambushed on their way here, our supplies from <pArgent City> seems to be waylaid by the enemy. Now our only hope of surviving is the supplies from Shaitan City. <n><t>Could I implore you to help me check with <bPatrol - Little Mo> at <j(1237,613)> about the situation? He should be on the outskirts of the city.

Definitions.Name: Search for Supplies

Needs.Description: Look for <bGasardis> at <j(1028,649)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am certain that the reinforcements has met some trouble, they should arrive by the path to <pAtlantis Haven> at <j(1028, 649)>.<n><t>Could you help me check? If you do see them, tell Captain <bGasardis> that we are expecting him.

Definitions.Name: Escort the Supplies

Needs.Description: Escort the Supplies back to <bIcicle Swordsman- Ray> at <j(365,570)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Since you brought back the supplies, could you help me bring it to <pIcicle Castle> and pass these <yRecovered Supplies> to <bIcicle Swordsman- Ray> at <j(365,570)>. I am in debt to your kindness.

Definitions.Name: Further Investigation

Needs.Description: Look for <bEluna> at <j(1141,575)> and ask about the Snowfield Organism.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>From the information you provided, it seems that the recent incidents and the creatures turning feral is no conicidence.<n><t>I do remember a researcher, <bEluna> at <j(1141,575)> who was doing research on the snow creatures. Head towards Alantis Haven and walk towards the main road. You should find her nearby.

Definitions.Name: Wisdom of Argent

Needs.Description: Ask <bOldman - Blurry> at <j(2272,2700)> about the Yeti.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>After my careful research of the <yYeti King Memo Stone>, I can conclude that it was a extremely ordinary Yeti. It seems to have eaten something unusual that changed both it's physique and intelligence. It became superior to the normal Yeti thus he became their king. From your investigations these seems to be a event occuring in the whole of Ascaron.<n><t>Long ago, my old teacher <bBlurry> told me a legend about a sunken treasure that holds myterious egg or food that can boost ones power when consumed.Now i am certain that the fable is true and such a wonderous item exist.<n><t>If you want to find out more about the legend, you can find <bOldman - Blurry> at <j(2272,2700)>.

Definitions.Name: Blurry
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You're looking for the <yEight Treasures Wine>? We're sold out at the moment, it's pretty popular. However, I can brew you a fresh batch if you can help me find the ingrediants.

Definitions.Name: A Long Long Time Ago

Needs.Description: Look for <bArgent's Chairman - Ronnie> at <j(2241,2748)> to find out more.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since you are so nice to me, I shall disclose a secret.<n><t>The <bArgent City's Chairman Ronnie> has one of those legend fruit that you are talking about.<n><t>You don't believe me? Go ask <bArgent's Chairman - Ronnie> at <j(2241,2748)>.

Definitions.Name: Chairman's Dark Secret

Needs.Description: Look for the <bNavy General - William> at <j(2277, 2831)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If you want the cooperation of <bChairman Ronnie>, we must blackmail him.<n><t>We need the help of <bAdmiral William>. Go have a chat with him at <j(2277, 2831)>.

Definitions.Name: Secret of the Slip

Needs.Description: Bring the <yAncient Bounty Token> to the <bChairman> at <j(2241, 2748)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Look at this <yAncient Bounty Token>, its an official wanted list, and guess who issued it, its none other the <bChairman Ronnie>.<n><t>I will love to follow you to see the look on his face when you ask him about it. Hehe��

Definitions.Name: Behemoth's Escape

Needs.Description: Look for <bPeter> at <j(2192, 2767)> regarding the situation of the <rBehemoth>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Sometime ago, I travelled to the faraway land of <pAutumm Island>. I stumbled upon a <rBehemoth>, which could be sold for a handsome price. I also purchased a magical legendary fruit from a mysterious trader.<n><t>On the way back, I hid the fruit near the Behemoth's cage. I guess it must have eaten the priceless fruit and became strong enough to break its prison.<n><t>It escaped to the west silver mine and terrorising the miners there. I had to issue a reward for the capture of the beast but alas, no one succeeded. The <bCastle Guard - Peter> at <j(2192, 2767)> has also given a try but failed, perhaps he can help you with more details.

Definitions.Name: Scary Monsters

Needs.Description: Find <bGranny Beldi> at <j(2277, 2769)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Strangely, this monster likes to eat <bGranny - Beldi>'s pasteries. Back then when we were having tea break, it suddenly attacked. We were lucky to escape with minor injuries, but the cakes were all gone.

Definitions.Name: Granny's Pastries

Needs.Description: Look for <bMiner Drunky> at <j(296, 57)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bMiner Drunky> loves the pasteries so much that he bought the whole batch today. So you can't have any sample of it.<n><t>But old granny don't think he can finish it all. You could find him at the <pSilver Mine>, guess he won't mind to share some.

Definitions.Name: Sea Haven

Needs.Description: Ask <bHarbor Operator Shirley> at <j(2243, 2826)> about the coordinates of the <pNine Haven>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> When I was the captain of a powerful merchant fleet a long time ago. my travels brought me to <pAutumm Island>. The <rBehemoth> we captured from there would bring me a fortune. <n><t>On the way back, I stopped by <pNine Havan>, a person called <bAndrew> sold me rare magical items, claiming that the magical fruit is part of <bPirate King <Roland>'s treasures. Eating the Fruit will give you magical powers. I did not believe him but at the point of time, I had a spare 100,000G so I bought it as a souvenir.<n><t>The rest as you know is history. You should look for Andrew to solve the mystery of the feral animals. Go to <pArgent Harbor> and look for <bShirley> at <j(2243, 2826)> for directions.

Definitions.Name: Navigation Map

Needs.Description: Ask <bHarbor Operator - Baros> in <pWoody Haven> at <j(2024, 2752)> about the coordinate of the <pNine Haven>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although I have no knowledge of it, there are others that may know.<n><t>The Haven in the sea was attacked several times by pirates until it was destroyed. Usually during the reconstruction of the Haven, there will be a change in its name.<n><t>I remember when I was studying at <pArgent City> Maritime school, I once heard my teacher mentioned a place called <pWoody Heaven> where a harbor operator who was called the "<rLiving Map of the sea>". His name is.....<bBaros>!  Maybe you can try to look for him and question him. However, there are great dangers in the open sea so be prepared.<n><t>Oh right, the location of the Haven is at <j(2024, 2752)>, other than this I can't help you anymore. Good luck!

Definitions.Name: Sailing

Needs.Description: Send the <yParcel of Baros> to <bHarbor Operator - Silion> in <pIcicle Harbor> at <j(1214, 681)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>That wasn't so hard wasn't it? Since you are a young and energetic person, help me with one more errand. <n><t>I won't take advantage of you, I'll give you an easy errand.<n><t>Here's some goods I need to transport to <yIcicle Harbor>. It's not that far.

Definitions.Name: The Li Brothers

Needs.Description: Bring the <yLetter of Baros> to <bLuke> in <pIcicle City> at <j(1320, 585)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>*Muak*<n><t>When you get this letter, I know that you have succesfully delivered the goods. Before you read on��. Take a deep breath��. <n><t>I am really sorry for lying to you, I am actually not the "Walking Map" that you are looking for, but do not get angry. <n><t>I do know who the "Walking Map" is as he is my twin brother. As you are so sincere, for your information, he lives in <bIcicle Castle>. His name is <bLuke>, bring my letter along and show it to him at <j(1320, 585)>. <n><t>P.S He is my twin brother so he will look like me!

Definitions.Name: Blessing Hand

Needs.Description: Bring the <yRing of Fish Scale> to <pIcespire Haven> and request for <bMaster Kerra>'s blessing at <j(2664, 654)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hmm�� This <yRing of Sea> gives you the strength of the sea, but it requires a experienced soul to use it. Thus you cannot use it yet.<n><t>From <pIcicle City> Castle, head east. You will need to cross a narrow path to reach <pIcespire Haven>. There you will meet <bMaster Kerra>. His touch is rumored to be able to bring anything to life. Obtain blessing from him and return to me.

Definitions.Name: Go Forth to Ninth Haven

Needs.Description: Head out to <pAerase Haven> in <pMagical Ocean> and look for <bHarbor Operator Buni> at <j(2042, 635)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The <pNine Haven> you are talking about, existed 10 years ago.<n><t>Back then it was a mercantile trading port protected by the royal navy. They were raided by pirates and razed to ruins.<n><t>When it was rebuilt it was renamed <pAerase Haven>. Due to the victory the pirates had over the navy, it is considered pirate domain.<n><t>Not many people remember the area "Nine Haven" as new about it's sacking were surpressed.The coordinates are <j(2042, 635)> in the <pMagical Ocean>. Look for <bHarbor Operator - Burni>, he will help you.

Definitions.Name: Who is Andrew?

Needs.Description: Inquire about <bAndrew> from <bPirate Jeremy> at <j(2362, 657)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is the what <pNine Haven> was 10 years ago.  We now mingle freely here with the pirates. They are not too bad after all. Just a random bar fight here and there, that's about it.<n><t>I came here after the reconstruction, I have never heard of an <bAndrew> or anyone who has similar sounding names.<n><t>You should visit that old goat <bPirate Jeremy>.Head east towards the <pIsle of Chill> at <j(2362, 657)>, you should find him.

Definitions.Name: Jack Again

Needs.Description: Sneak into the remote part of <yCanary Isle> and look for <bCaptain Jack> at <j(1672, 3777)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Young one, I like your bravery. <bAndrew> has been living on this island for years but he changed his name to <bDarwen> and led a secluded life. Nobody knows that he is <bAndrew>. <n><t>A year ago, a group of pirates figured out that <bDarwen> and <bAndrew> was the same person, they persuaded him to go with them. I vaguely remember that they were men from <rJack the Pirate>'s group. I think you might wanna go to <rJack the Pirate>'s Headquaters at <yCanary Isle>.

Definitions.Name: I'll be Back!

Needs.Description: Look for <bCaptain Jack> at <j(1672, 3777)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: Hmm��No��I mean that��Oh��I have nothing for you now. Maybe next time. Go back now.

Definitions.Name: "Investigation"

Needs.Description: Obtain some <yEmblem> from <bJack>'s henchmen to prove that you are carrying out an "Investigation".

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Who sent you?  <bDavy>? <bJones>? <bSparrow>?<n><t>Forget it, like it matters. <bAndrew>? Hmm that name seems to ring a bell. Guess he went fishing a few days ago. Look, I have 8,000 crew members, I cannot possibly remember all their names. Everyone of my crew mates has a <yEmblem> of his own name. Why don't you go it look yourself.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The emblem in you hand belongs to my crew, how did the thing goes?<n><t>Wait! Wait! Why is there blood on the emblem? Don't tell me that��I think forget it. Do not investigate any further.<n><t>Darn <bAndrew>... He would not let me have a peaceful day when after he is dead. Look for me again at a later time. I will tell you the whole story.

Definitions.Name: Thundoria Bank

Needs.Description: Bring the signatures of the 4 Great Ones to the <bBanker of Thundoria> at <j(743, 1534)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is...Please wait a moment. Allow me to check...Sorry, we cannot pass you the item just yet.<n><t>According to our regulation, you will have to obtain the signatures of the <bGreat Four>. Bye bye...Next please...
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You bought the signature? Let me check whether if it is fake. Hmm...Well done. Can you tell me how you manage to convince that old fool?<n><t>Ok...Ok...This is the sheepskin that you want. Don't have to be so worry.

Definitions.Name: Will of Andrew
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> Why have you return? My guys have nothing more for you! Leave them alone! <n><t>What? You have gotten hold of <yAndrew's Will>? Only the signature of the <bGreat Four> will grant you access to this! Let me have a look!

Definitions.Name: Secret of the Will

Needs.Description: Look for <bLittle Daniel> at <j(2193, 2730)> to find out the secret of the <yWill>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Haha�� <bAndrew> is always so��weird. You must be wondering why his scibbling makes no sense. It is because this sheepskin has been treated before. Don't look at me, I don't know how to solve this.<n><t>Actually <bLittle Daniel> at <j(2193, 2730)> can do it but don't ever tell him that I send you.

Definitions.Name: Secret of the Will
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Let me have a look. Hmm��this smells like an <yInvisible Ink>. I am surprise that there are people who know how to make <yInvisible Ink>. I can help you concoct a negator. However, you must tell me who told you that I knew how to make a negator.

Definitions.Name: Jack Introduction

Needs.Description: Go to <j(1672, 3777)> and look for <bJack> regarding what has happened today.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What! So the despicable <bJack> told you? Tell him to kill himself, I will not help you. How I wish to forget the formula to concoct the negator. Stay away from me! I will not see you again!

Definitions.Name: Rumour of the Bar

Needs.Description: Get the ingredients of the antidote for <bLittle Daniel> at <j(2193, 2730)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>So you heard it from the tavern? I must be really drunk for it to slip my mouth.<n><t>Forget it, since you are able to find me, it seems that we are fated in some ways. Now, I will tell you the recipe. You are required to find these ingredients, then I will help you create the antidote.<n><t>Listen carefully, I requires 3 <yBloody Polliwog Tails>, 5 <yHearts of Temptest Sea Jelly>, 7 <yDangerous Shark Cartilages> and 9 <yTopaz Dolphin Dorsal Fins>. Go and locate them. Hurry up before I change my mind.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good. I will let you see what the writing on the sheepskin. Hmm��This is it. Take it. I have not done it in a long while. Don't blame me if anything goes wrong.

Definitions.Name: Love Entanglement

Needs.Description: Seek help from <bBarmaid Donna> at <j(2224, 2887)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh my god! You actually ignored my warning! Didn't I ask you not to mention my name?<n><t>Forget it, since <bLittle Daniel> is furious, the only person who is able to pacify him is <bBargirl - Donna>. Only she can help you. She can be found at <j(2224, 2887)>.<n><t>As to why..., you can ask <bBargirl - Donna> for the answers.

Definitions.Name: Love Entanglement
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Didn't I ask you to stay clear from me? Wait��What is that you are holding? A pumpkin head with <bDonna>'s signature! Can you give it to me? I will use the <yInvisible Ink Negator> as a trade.

Definitions.Name: Mystic Diary
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! I haven't seen this kind of writings in a long time. Why are you here yet again? I had thought that I would never see this kind of writings again young man. Unfortunately for you, I have sworn never to translate this sort of language again for anyone. Please leave, it is a cursed language and anyone who gets involved with it will end up with a bad fate.<n><t>Perhaps only the so called <bGoddess> followers will be able to instigate others into taking this kind of risk.

Definitions.Name: Goddess's Follower

Needs.Description: Ask <bClan Chief Albuda> at <j(898, 3640)> about the journal.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Of all the <bGoddess> followers, the most famous should be <bClan Chief - Albuda>��

Definitions.Name: Goddess's Follower
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Quickly get the diary away from me! Get that demonic writings out of my sight! Do not corrupt my eyes.<n><t>I had thought that besides <bHoly Priestess Ada> at <j(862, 3303)>, no one else would be concerned over such devilish writings! Those who study these kinds of languages will never have a good outcome. May the <bGoddess> punish you!

Definitions.Name: Holy Priestess

Needs.Description: Ask <bHoly Priestess - Ada> at <j(862, 3303)> about the journal.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I should warn you not to get involved with whatever <bHoly Priestess Ada> is doing otherwise you'll become an unwelcome person around here. <n><t> (What's wrong with all these old men? Why does the sight of this writings scare them? Maybe I should take up <bAlbuda>'s suggestion and head towards where <bAda> is at <j(862, 3303)>. She seems to be quite knowledgeable in this field, maybe I should try my luck.)>.

Definitions.Name: Testament of the Piety

Needs.Description: Show your determination and kindness to <bHigh Priest - Gannon> at <j(862, 3500)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ever since that incident happened, <bClan Chief Albuda> stopped the entire research related to this kind of language.<n><t>As you can see, I can only continue my research here and not anywhere else. I can translate the contents for you, but you'll have to prove your loyalty towards the Goddess, only those who are kind at heart yet determined can know the contents of the writings. Otherwise, the historical tragedy will once again come forth.<n><t>As for the method, you can ask <bHigh Priest Gannon> at <j(862, 3500)> he will know what to do.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Great, this book is something which anyone who joins the healer group must possess, if you can obtain it, <bHigh Priest Gannon> will definitely approve your loyalty towards the goddess. As for me, I'll fulfill my promise, here, take it, I've already translated it, I hope you will make good use of the contents in it.

Definitions.Name: Testament of the Piety
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Child, ever since you decided to become a Herbalist, I forsaw that you would come to me one day. Your innermost feelings already proves your loyalty towards the goddess. Take this <yRighteous Document> as your proof and use it to do good!

Definitions.Name: Testament of the Piety
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Child, ever since you decided to become a Herbalist, I forsaw that you would come to me one day. Your innermost feelings already proves your loyalty towards the goddess. Take this <bRighteous Document> as your proof and use it to do good!

Definitions.Name: Testament of the Piety
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Child, ever since you decided to become a Herbalist, I forsaw that you would come to me one day. Your innermost feelings already proves your loyalty towards the goddess. Take this <bRighteous Document> as your proof and use it to do good!

Definitions.Name: Testament of the Piety
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Regardless of what class you are, you're still a child of the <bGoddess> and she once told me that you would eventually come to me one day to clear whatever doubt that is plaguing your heart. She has set 10 tests for you.<n><t>Come back to me when you're ready as there will be no turning back once you've begun.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: The First Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you ready? We are about to commence the first test! Lets see how well you do against these <rSteel Mummies> at <j(440, 1440)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You have passed the first round. May the <bGoddess> be with you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Stage 2 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Congratulations for passing the first test! Next, proceed to <j(511, 1721)> and send those <rUndead Warriors> back into their graves to rest in peace.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You have passed stage 2. May the <bGoddess> be with you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Third Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The third test is the <rSkeletal Archer> at <j(919, 1581)>. Look out for their arrows.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you have completed stage 3. May the <bGoddess> bless you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Stage 4 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Round four, <rSkeletal Warrior Leaders>! If you are killed by them, you will suffer eternal damnation and burn in hell for all eternity!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you have completed stage four. May the <bGoddess> bless you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Round 5 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Round five, <rCursed Corpses>! Defeat them so that they may finally be put to rest.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you have completed fifth round. May the <bGoddess> bless you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Round 6 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The sixth test is the <rBloodthirsty Hunter> at <j(445, 1571)>. They have brought much disturbance to the peace of the forest.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you have completed stage six. May the <bGoddess> bless you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Round 7

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The seventh mission is the <rHorrific Cursed Corpse> at <j(360, 1340)>. Do not compare them with the normal cursed corpse, the difference is enormous.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You have completed Stage 7. May the <bGoddess> bless you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Round 8 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The eighth test is <rVicious Pumpkin Knight> at <j(622, 3518)>. Drive these evil beings away.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You have completed stage eight. May the <bGoddess> be with you.

Definitions.Name: Goddess Test

Needs.Description: Round 9 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The second last test is <rTreant Terror> at <j(662, 2460)>. They are an abomination of nature.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you have completed the second last stage. May the <bGoddess> bless you.

Definitions.Name: Mystery Town
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Are you seeking the exact location?<n><t>The original text did not mention anything about it. Not even the name of <pSpring Town>.
