If I hadn't overheard the <bDrunkard Anthony> at <j(2222, 2889)> mentioning it, I would not have been able to make head or tail out of this at all.

Definitions.Name: Spring Town

Needs.Description: Look for <bDrunkyard Anthony> at <j(2222, 2889)> and ask about <pSpring Town>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>However, that drunkard talks nonsense most of the time and nobody knows if his words are true or false. <n><t>(<bHoly Priestess> meant to say that the drunkard seems to know about <pSpring Town> but I remembered having asked him about a location to hunt some shark in which he gave me the location of the North Pole instead. I almost died under the ice as a result of his misdirection. Now, it seems that I have to place my life in his words once again?! Sigh... I really don't know whether to laugh or cry.)

Definitions.Name: Exploration Spirit

Needs.Description: Look for <bLittle Daniel> at <j(2193, 2730)> to obtain the proof and hand to <bDrunkyard Anthony> at <j(2222, 2889)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><pSpring town>! How did you know of this name? No, you will never be able to reach the destination! I'll never tell anyone anything about <pSpring Town>! I do not wish to see the tragedy happen again, unless...I am saying unless...You can prove your strength and ability and that your spirit for exploration can overcome anything that happens on the sea.<n><t>Until you can prove yourself, don't bother looking for me. You are still young with many years to live, I don't know why you would go in search of such a perilous journey.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You've proven yourself. Coughs, actually, I've only heard about <pSpring Town> from others. Whatever happen there, I have got no idea. <n><t>Hold on! What are you doing, be nice now... put down that bottle and we'll talk about things... Sigh young lad, why are you so harsh? You should seek out <bGranny Beldi> about <pSpring Town>, all the tales about <pSpring Town> came from her, I believe she knows something about <pSpring Town> that others do not.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Spirit
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I haven't see you in a long time, you wish to attain proof of your spirit of exploration? You once possessed it, but you gave it for fame, now you wish to regain it?<n><t>Anyway, here, take it and rekindle the passion when you first started on this path. May you possess the passion of the spirit of exploration forever!

Definitions.Name: Exploration Spirit
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I haven't see you in a long time, you wish to attain proof of your spirit of exploration? You once possessed it, but you gave it for fame, now you wish to regain it?<n><t>Anyway, here, take it and rekindle the passion when you first started on this path. May you possess the passion of the spirit of exploration forever!

Definitions.Name: Exploration Spirit
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What? You wish to have a proof of exploration? That is an extremely difficult procedure, if you have the confidence and are willing to take the risk, please let me know.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round 1

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Let me see what you have done for this test...Hmm...Ok...Hmm...Alright! I have already thought of the test in accordance with your performance, so sharpen your weapons and of course, prepare your ship for the test of the great sea.<n><t>Your first target is the <rSakura 13 Warship> found at <j(1950, 1286)>, destroy 10 of them. Oh...And remember that all of the future tests require you to destroy 10 of each. I shall remind you no more.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the first task, if you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Second Cycle.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The next target is <rVampiric Polliwog> at <j(370, 2317)>. The only thing big about them is their heads, it shouldn't be a difficult task.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the second task, if you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Stage 3 Test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Next��the <rTempest Sea Jellys>! Just like its name, they are soft and squishy.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the third task, if you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round 4

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Now, the next target is the crazy <rSilk Shark> found off Ascaron coast at <j(3149, 3836)>. I wonder who gave it that name, no one has even seen them spitting silk!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the fourth task. If you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round 5

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This can be a little cruel, your next target is cute little <rTopaz Dolphin> at <j(2631, 2048)>. I wonder if the topaz on their body is real.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the fifth task, if you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round Six.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Next, the brother of the <rTempest Sea Jelly>, eradicate the <rHurricane Sea Jellys> at <j(1275, 3634)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ok, you passed round 6. I will continue again.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round 7

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The next target is <rMature Ruby Dolphin> which can be found at <j(3785, 1975)>. Its another pitiful monster.  May the gods forgive me.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the seventh task, if you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round 8

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Next target is <rSakura 13 Pirate Command Ship> found at <j(2790, 1286)>. Its much harder this time but since you already made it so far, hang on!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good. You have made it pass stage 8. I will continue.

Definitions.Name: Exploration Test

Needs.Description: Round 9

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Now for the next task, the <rSpiny Bone Fish> at <j(370, 2317)>! They are really an eyesore, destroy them for the good of the rest of the world!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have completed the ninth round, if you are ready, let us proceed with the next.

Definitions.Name: Beldi

Needs.Description: Talk to <bGranny Beldi> at <j(2277, 2769)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I suggest you ask <bGranny - Beldi>. She knows something.

Definitions.Name: Beldi
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What did you say? <bSpring Town>? Ah what a wonderful town name, I haven't heard that name being mentioned for at least 30 years. In the past, I used to tell the tale of this <pSpring Town> to the people but everyone said I was sprouting nonsense and they just laughed it off. Now, here you are standing in front of me, asking ask me about the story of <pSpring Town>? Is this fate?

Definitions.Name: Hometown

Needs.Description: Bring back the items <bBeldi> deposited in Thundoria Bank.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Maybe, I 've spoken too much rubbish. Perhaps, maybe even you won't believe me. I used to live in <pSpring Town>, in a family of four. One day, we sailed out to the ocean to enjoy ourselves, unfortunately, we met with a huge wave and our ship sank. Although I was rescued by sailors, I have since lost contact with my family. As I was very young then and not independent enough, the sailors soon put me in an orphanage in Argent City. When I grew older, I always wanted to go back and look for my missing family but no one wanted to take the risk to go with me. Days passed by and now I'm an old man. I'm too old to travel now but if you are willing to risk your life, maybe you could help me to deliver something. The thing which I speak about is located at <pIcicle Castle>, in a bank. If you promise to do this, I'll tell you where the exact location of <pSpring Town>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I knew you would definitely get my earring back for me, my child. This ear ring is very important to me, it protected me when I was in danger. My sister has a similar one, seeing it reminds me of her. Please bring this back and hand it personally to my sister if she is still alive.<n><t>Take this <yWater Wheel>, if you lose your way, you can use it to find your way out.<n><t>If I can recall correctly, the general location of <pSpring Town> is in the Dark Blue Archipelago towards the south-eastern region. Surrounding this island are <pAutumn> and <pSummer> island. When you see an anchor shaped island, you won't be far off from <pSpring Town>.

Definitions.Name: Earring of Beldi

Needs.Description: Break the record set by Ray.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bBeldi> has told me about your situation. This object is her last hope, I really don't know how someone as weak as you have the confidence to deliver her stuff over safely.<n><t>No matter. Anyway, unless you are able to break Ray's record of killing 100 <rGreat Polar Bears> to prove your ability, otherwise forget about taking Beldi's stuff back.<n><t>These big animals mostly live at <j(3101, 666)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I really didn't expect that you will come back with positive results. Haha, there you go. These are <bGranny Beldi>'s stuff. Make sure you keep it with you. I won't let you off if you lose it!<n><t>By the way, there's a girl by the name of <bMona> over at the Bar, she seems to have a similar flower brooch. If you have the time, please drop by and speak to her.

Definitions.Name: Hometown
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bGranny Beldi> has told me what you've been through. After so many years, there is finally someone courageous enough and willing to help her. The injuries on your body proves your courage. Here, take it, its her last hope, please protect it with all your heart and fulfill granny's wish.<n><t>Also, there's a girl named <bMona> over at <pThundoria Bar>, she seems to have a similar flower brooch, if you have the time please drop by to see her.

Definitions.Name: Hometown
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bGranny Beldi> has told me what you've been through. After so many years, there is finally someone courageous enough and willing to help her. The injuries on your body proves your courage. Here, take it, its her last hope, please protect it with all your heart and fulfill granny's wish.<n><t>Also, there's a girl named <bMona> over at <pThundoria Bar>, she seems to have a similar flower brooch, if you have the time please drop by to see her.

The injuries on your body proves your courage. Here, take it, its her last hope, please protect it with all your heart and fulfill granny's wish.<n><t>Also, there's a girl named <bMona> over at <pThundoria Bar>, she seems to have a similar flower brooch, if you have the time please drop by to see her.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Bring the <rSupplies> back to the <pHaven>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Due to the remoteness of this location, this place has been deserted for quite some time.You said a voice led you here? Then count yourself lucky to be able to be standing here alive.<n><t>Lots of dangerous creatures often appear nearby and the Sakura 13 Pirates would be the worst. They often pretend to be drowning to attract the attentions of the passing ships for help. After which, they will ambush the ship. I think you must have been misled by them earlier on. Our transport ship was ambushed a few days ago! Since you have the ability to get here, why don't you help us recover the <ySupplies> and we will reward you accordingly.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! Although its not replenished fully, it can last me till the next stop. Thank you! This is your reward.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Talk to <bHarbor Operator Whitcombe> at <j(2041, 1355)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I understand that you have gone through a lot of hell to help us recover our supplies. We really shouldn't trouble you anymore. However, you know our situation here, the line of supply has been overtaken by pirates and we do not know when the next supply will arrive. Please inform our fellow comrades from the supply depot to prepare for starvation.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Bring 20 <ySashimi> to <bHarbor Operator - Whitcombe> at <j(2041, 1355)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What? What are you talking about? No food again? I'm thinking of quitting! Not only is the pay low, we often get attacked by pirates! I haven't eaten in three days! Is such suffering worth it?<n><t>Oh man, since you've already been so helpful why don't you help us this one last time?<n><t>There are a fish farm nearby but its guarded by ferocious creatures...Can you get some fishes back for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>See? I knew you'd definitely be able to do it! I don't have anything to reward you with, only a piece of news which you might be interested in.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Go to <pReagen Haven> and look for <bHarbor Operator - Fardell> at <j(3153, 674)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Have you heard about it? You can a create a special potion using the oils from various creatures of the sea, those who consumed the potion can converse in various languages and even communicate with the monsters.<n><t>Don't look at me that way, actually, in truth i have no idea what to do either. Hey don't go yet, I know of someone who knows the recipe, he is the habour operator of the next <pHaven> at <j(3153, 674)>. You can ask him about it, just say that I recommended you. Don't look down on me! I once saved his life.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Damn! He's going around talking nonsense again! If he hadn't saved me once I wouldn't be bothered about him.<n><t>As for the <yPotion of Omni-Relevation>...Yes I do know how to make it, but its very difficult to get the ingredients for the potion. If you can find the ingredients I could help you to make it.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Bring back the ingredient to <bHarbor Operator - Fardell> at <j(3153, 674)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>In order to make the special pill, you'll need a <yFascia Fish Bone>, a <yThick Fish Bone>, 30 <yRotten Fish Bones>, what's with that look of yours? You think it's poisonous? You think I'm lying to you?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> Yes, yes, these are all the ingredients I needed! Please hold on while I make it the potion for you immediately. (Hehe, now you'll be able to hear what the mermaids are talking about)>.

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Obtain <yOmni-Antidote> from <bHarbor Operator - Buni> in <pAerase Haven> at <j(2042, 635)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ah��. I'm not going to make it�� looks like this is my retribution... I shouldn't have stolen your pill. Help me, I'm suffering, please just let me die.<n><t>No... wait wait! You're really going to leave me here alone? Please don't go! Save me! I stole the formula off the <bHarbor Operator - Buni> from <pAerase Haven> at <j(2042, 635)>. There, I've already told you all that I know, please help me!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> Ah! The medicine is so bitter! If not for it being able to save my life I would never eat it! Don't mind me, I just escaped death, it's not my fault for muttering stuff that has no logic.<n><t>What? What return you your money? I don't understand! I'm a little busy, see you later!

Definitions.Name: Wheel of Fate

Needs.Description: Bring the <yOmni-Antidote> to <bHarbor Operator Fardell> at <y(3153, 674)> in exchange for 100,000G.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What? <bHarbor Operator Fardell> already knows how to make the potion of <yOmni-Relevation himself>, yet he stole the one I made for you?<n><t>He deserves it, let him die! He always comes in here and steals the formulas and he doesn't pay when he gets the medicine. Oh, and he still owes me 100000G! Before he dies please ask him to tell me his password to the bank!<n><t>Okay okay! I'm actually quite soft hearted, here is the antidote. Give it to him fast and also tells him that I am waiting for him to repay me the money! Oh, and if you treasure your life, don't trust him anymore and about the potion of...Forget it, I'll wait till you get back.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What? That fellow pretended to be ignorant and doesn't want to admit that he owes me money? Next time I'll poison him and make him mute.<n><t>Let's not talk about him already. About the <yPotion of Omni-Relevation>...

Definitions.Name: Language Barrier

Needs.Description: Talk to <bGranny Beldi> at <j(2277, 2769)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What are these people talking about, I cannot understand a single word...<n><t>I think I should get some help from <bGranny - Beldi> at <j(2277, 2769)>.

Definitions.Name: Language Barrier

Needs.Description: Ask <bBar Waitress - Babara> at <j(1310, 530)> in <pIcicle City> about the potion.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Ah, young fellow, have you been to <pSpring Town> yet?<n><t>WHAT?! You say that you can't understand what are they talking? Didn't you drink a potion of <yOmni-Revelation>?<n><t>Nowadays young people don't pay attention to what old people are talking. Let me tell you one more time! Now listen properly, look for the <bBar Waitress Babara> at <j(1310, 530)> in <pIcicle City>. She may know something. A long time ago, when I was a young and beautiful woman, a stranger gave me the <yPotion of Omni-Revelation>. Do you think I'm still beautiful?

Definitions.Name: Language Barrier
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You want a <yPotion of Omni-Relevation>? You have found the correct person! I specially sell the formula for making the potion, suitable for both young and old.<n><t>The price is reasonable, it's a multipurpose translation potion. It can even translate coded messages into an understandable form. You only need one pill to do all of that! What!? You don't believe me? Do you not believe this lovable and innocent girl?<n><t>What? Are you trying to give me 100,000 to buy the formula and to make me not talk anymore about it? Okay, where's the money?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You really know how to spot treasures. <yPotion of Omni Relevation> is yours.

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Young fellow, you're not bad! To be able to reach this place has proven that you certainly have the ability! If there is something wrong with your weapon, please look for me. I'll definitely help you the best I can.

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hey you! Your clothings look terrible! Quickly let me see. You must have been on a long dangerous task. Before you continoue, why not have some of my meat dumpling? It will certainly satisfy you.

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hi there, distant visitor. My name is Luna, I sell herbs, if you need help, feel free to look me up. Since you come from afar, I shall give you a 20% discount.

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hi friend! If you want to buy some shark fin and bird nest, I'll give you a 20 percent discount, if you want to get other stuff please let me know.

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Leaving <pSpring Town>? Remember to look for me, nowadays, no one ever sets sail out of town besides me.<n><t>Don't leave without me! Remember to look me up if you want to leave <pSpring Town>.

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>We meet again. Want to go sailing?

Definitions.Name: Rare Visitor from Afar
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>IC, IP, IQ card, tell me your secret code, this isn't robbery but if you wish to withdraw your stuff, you'll need to provide us with your secret code.

Definitions.Name: Make the Finishing Point

Needs.Description: <yRed Dye>*5, <yOrange Dye>*5, <yYellow Dye>*5, <yGreen Dye>*5, <yCyan Dye>*5, <yBlue Dye>*5 and <yPurple Dye>*5.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Okay the secret is��Haha! I've tricked you. I only needed this brooch to serve as the eye of dragon painting! Ah! I run out of dye again! Why don't you help me obtain 5 of each different colored dye so that I can finish up the painting? I might even reward you for your help.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What took you so long? My brush has dried up! Now coloring the painting is not going to be easy!

Definitions.Name: Make the Finishing Point

Needs.Description: Bring back 30 vials of <yPure Water> to <bBanker Wang Mo> at <j(3290, 2512)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You know the most important thing about the dragon's eye, is its eyeball. Now that my brush has dried up, it is no longer able to draw a realistic looking eyeball. In order to soften up the brush, I'll have to soak it at least 30 times in <yPure Water>. Hurry up and get me 30 bottles of <yPure Water> or else I'll use my brush and color your face black!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Why were you so slow? The brush has been damaged! I'll need another one!

Definitions.Name: Make the Finishing Point

Needs.Description: Bring back <y10 Fox Tails> to <bBanker Wang Mo> at <j(3290, 2512)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This paint bush was made out of the finest grade of <yFox Tails>. Now that the brush is damaged, the special properties has been lost. To repair it, you will need to bring me 10 <yFox Tails>. If you fail, you better be able to compensate me for it in another way or I'll make a new brush out of your hair!<n><t>Get it from the <rFox Taoists> at <j(3322, 2460)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What a beautiful fox tails! Now I can make a fox tail brush, thanks to you.<n><t>I'm sorry, I didn't mean to lie to you but this brush of mine has actually already been damaged a long time ago. To reward you for your efforts, take this. I hope that it will be useful to you in future.

Definitions.Name: Lost

Needs.Description: Go to <pUnderwater Tunnel> and search for the son of <bBarkeeper - Sang Di>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since you asked, I'm not going to hide it from you any longer.<n><t>Below this town, lies an <pUnderwater Tunnel>. It used to be a water plant but after an earthquake destroyed it, all that's left is rubble. Everyone who worked below it also perished as a result of the quake.<n><t>My son and a group of pirates went down to look for treasure in that hellhole but never made it back. I myself, tried searching for them below, but had no choice but to turn back because of a fire blocking my way. If you wish to risk your life by going down there, please help me find out what happened to my son!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Did a zombie asked you to pass a message to me? It must be my poor son! Speak no more, I already know what he wants you to say to me. Sigh... I knew something terrible like this would happen.

Definitions.Name: Lost
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Please wait! I'm not contagious! I still have feelings! Please listen to my last words... Please tell my mum that I will always love her and tell her to take care of herself. I will be in heaven blessing her.<n><t>My mother is <bSang Di> at <j(3287, 2501)>.

Definitions.Name: Lost

Needs.Description: Look for <bGrocer Luna> at <j(3279, 2501)> to make the <yTalisman>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>From what I know, <bLuna> at <j(3279, 2501)> has a <yTalisman> which is able to retain the souls of zombies. If you have time, please go and speak to her.<n><t>Since I broke up their relationship at that time, I am too embarassed to approach her myself. She'll definitely be able to help. I'm sure!

Definitions.Name: Talisman

Needs.Description: Bring <y20 Talismans of Ghost> to <bGrocer Luna> at <j(3279, 2501)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What?! <b <bHami> > is trapped inside the <pUnderwater Tunnel>? Oh my god! The method which you speak off, requires a <ySpecial Talisman> which only can be made from the combination of various <yTalisman of Ghost>.<n><t>The talismans, which I used the last time, were bought off a merchant a couple of months ago. He hasn't come by in a while so I have no materials! Unless you are able to provide me 20 <yTalismans of Ghost>, I don't think I have any other ways of saving <b <bHami> >!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hurry! I hope there is still time�� Give this special talisman to <bHami>  and ask him to put it upon his head. I hope it works.

Definitions.Name: Talisman

Needs.Description: Tell <bGrocer Luna> at <j(3279, 2501)> that <bUndead - <bHami> > is unable to leave the <pUnderwater Tunnel>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What happened? I remember I was in a coma.<n><t>Why did I suddenly wake up? Is this a special talisman from <bLuna>?<n><t>I always knew that she would be thinking of me, but I can't go back now. Even if my soul is preserved in this body of mine, I will not survive the sunlight. Please tell her to forget about me.

Definitions.Name: Talisman
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What? <b <bHami> > can't leave the <pUnder Water Tunnel>? If that's the case I'll go to him. I can't live without him by my side.

Definitions.Name: Love Miracle

Needs.Description: Bring back the <yGoddess Tear>, <yMermaid Heart> and <yFeather of Paradise>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Young man, I see the pain in your eyes.<n><t>Are you deeply touched by the love between <bLuna> and <bHami> ? Love possess the power to create miracles.<n><t>If you still wish to help them, you must find <yTears of the Goddess> , a <yMerman's Heart> and <yFeathers of Paradise Bird>. With these 3 items, we might be able to help them.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The <yTears of the Goddess> flows freely for the people of this world. It is the universal symbol of love; A <yMerman's Heart> is a full of love for his sweetheart, it is the symbol of pure love; <yFeathers of Paradise Bird> is a symbol of affection. When someone is able to collect these three items and place them together, a miracle occurs according to ancient legends. Fuse these together and make it into a brooch, then give it to <bHami>. A miracle might happen which will allow him to return to a normal person, able to walk under the sun once again.

Definitions.Name: Tear of Goddess

Needs.Description: Go to the depths of <pBarren Cavern> and bring back <yPure Clarion Sand>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> After all these years, someone actually remembers this legend. The <yTears of the Goddess> to be considered literally, it is actually <yPure Clarion Sand> which only be found deep in <pBarren Cavern>. Only the most revered can touch it and only someone who harbors compassion is able to carry it away from its resting place. So far, all the bandits and thieves who have tried getting it has died. Will you give it a try?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Only one with a pure mind is able to obtain this kind of sand in its purest form. The fact that you were able to bring me this sand proves to me that you are a person of that sort.

Definitions.Name: Heart of Mermaid

Needs.Description: Go to <pPalace Ruins> and bring back the <yCrown of the Queen>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>A <yMerman's Heart> actually refers to the <yCrown of the Queen>. I did not think that such a young person like you would be able to understand what it is.<n><t>The <yMerman's Heart> is a diamond which <bWilliam> gave to his wife. Somehow, it was later inlaid on the <yCrown of the Queen> which later on fell into the hands of the enemy along with the royal palace. All trails leading to it has since been lost and it has been rumored that it carrys a Merman's curse. All the Bandits and Thieves who have searched for it in the Royal Palace ruins have been possessed and killed. Do you dare look for it yourself?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You really found <yCrown of the Queen>? Perhaps you will be the first person to make this legend come true.

Definitions.Name: Feather of the Bird

Needs.Description: Go to <pDemonic World> and bring back <yCrystalline Feather>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><yFeathers of Paradise Bird> is a name given to the award that is presented to brave warriors. It is the highest award and title bestowed to people who are able to go into the <pSnowstorm Family's Labyrinth> and retrieve a <yCrystalline Feather> from inside one of the valuable boxes. Many have died trying, do you wish to try?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are the third person who has successfully brought back the <yCrystalline Feather>, back. I cannot tell you who the other two were but you'll find out sooner or later.

Definitions.Name: Love Miracle

Needs.Description: Send the good news to <bGrocer Luna> at <j(3279, 2501)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you saying that as long as this brooch with me, it is possible for me to to return to the world?<n><t>Thank you! Now I may see <bLuna> again. Hurry and tell her the good news for me!

Definitions.Name: Corpse Venom

Needs.Description: Collect 20 <yTalismans of Ghost> to make a <yVenom Ward Amulet>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you being troubled by poison? I haven't made this kind of protective charms in a long time.<n><t>If you can bring me 20 <yTalismans of Ghost>, I can make you 1 protective charm for 5000G. The <yTalismans of Ghost> can be found in the <pUnder Water Tunnel>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Since you've collected enough <yTalismans of Ghost>, I'll help you to make a protective charm for 5000. Now keep away while I make the charm. Don't peep, it's a secret technique, if I catch you peeping, the deal is off! <n><t>Ok, here's your protective charm. If you need another, just get me another 20 <yTalismans of Ghost> and I'll mark another one for you for 5000.

Definitions.Name: Lost
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What? My son is unable to return home? I guess as long as he is not dead�� I'm so sorry for troubling you on this matter. I guess I should let the matter rest, I just feel so sorry for him and <bLuna>. <n><t>Since you've helped me, citizens of <pSpring Town> shall remember you for your good deeds, if there is anything I can help you with, please feel free to approach me.

Definitions.Name: Lost
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What? Has a miracle occurred? Is my son saved?<n><t>Thank you! The people of <pSpring Town> will welcome you forever! Your act of kindness has gained the entire town's approval and you will forever be our honored guest. If there is anything I can help you with, please let me know.

Definitions.Name: Miracle Fruit

Needs.Description: Ask <bYuri> at <j(3195, 2506)> about the mysterious fruit.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Have you eaten a mysterious fruit before?<n><t>I haven't tried one before, really. I haven't. I mean I haven't even heard of anything like it before! <bYuri> at <j(3196, 2509)> must be making up stories again! I knew it! He likes to boast about things.

Definitions.Name: Miracle Fruit

Needs.Description: Ask <bGuard Zhou> at <j(3298, 2534)> about the mysterious fruit.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I'm really irritated by that old hag calling me a big liar. Lets drop the topic! I've seen Pirate King <bRoland> before.<n><t>If you don't believe me, take a look at these scars on my chest. These were the result of our duels a long time ago. You say you want to take a look at the mysterious fruits? The truth is...I haven't seen anything like that for over a year. The last time, Guard Zhou gave one to me to pass sell it to a stranger named "Lu".<n><t>Why don't you go ask <bGuard Zhou> at <j(3298, 2534)> about it?

Definitions.Name: Miracle Fruit

Needs.Description: Investigate <pSeabed Tunnel>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Mysterious fruit? No I haven't seen it. Don't come near me! I promise I won't do it again! Please, don't kill me! I'll leave right now, I don't want anything. I only came here to have fun, I didn't steal your egg! I won't go back to the <pUnderwater Tunnel> again, it's a living hell down there! Anyone who goes down there has never come back, I'm just lucky! <n><t>There is a gap in the sewers, which leads to the <pUnderwater Tunnel>. There's a madman there, he might know a thing or two about your mysterious fruit.

Definitions.Name: Demonic Fruit

Needs.Description: Destroy the <pFruit Residue> and return to <pGuard Zhou> at <j(3298, 2534)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What's that in your hands? Looks familiar, don't come near me! Stay back! Take it away! Take it away! I don't want to see it ever again! <n><t>Take it away before something bad happens!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I feel much better now, I hope I did not give you a scare when I panicked earlier on. If you had gone through the same ordeal I have, you would have panicked too!

Definitions.Name: Letter of Zhou

Needs.Description: Send the <rPink Letter> to <bWang Mo> at <j(3290, 2512)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Back to the topic, you said that the <pUnderwater Tunnel> does not have anymore that�� that kind of fruit?<n><t>Strange, I need time to recall. Could I have given you the wrong information? Why don't you help pass this letter to <bWang Mo> at <j(3290, 2512)> near the bank while I am trying to recall the whole matter? Don't peep inside it and come back once you are done, I should be ready by then.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The letter has been delivered? Did she look at it? What did she said? She ......Oh, coughed, graciousness, I thought I already thought some matters, our proper business.

Definitions.Name: Demonic Fruit

Needs.Description: Ask <bBarkeeper Sang Di> at <j(3287, 2501)> about the <yDemonic Fruit>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You should have seen the huge <rIcy Dragon> once you entered the <pUnderwater Tunnel> but that does not matter as it is not important.<n><t>Regarding the Strange Fruit you mentioned the other time, it is actually a <yDemonic Fruit>. Rumor has it that anybody who consume it will gain demonic powers, but will lose an entire life of happiness. I do not believe this until I met the <rIcy Dragon> in the tunnel.<n><t>Oh, there is somebody who has experienced the power of the <yDemonic Fruit>. Do not judge her by her appearance as she is much older than she look.<n><t>However, I don't think she will admit to having any relation to a <yDemonic Fruit>. I have told you what I have known and it will be up to you on what to do next.<n><t>By the way, I did not mention that she is the <bTavern Keeper>.

Definitions.Name: Tear of Dragon
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><yTear of Dragon>? I haven't heard of such a thing in ages! From the size of the thing you mentioned, I think you must certainly have met that child. Forget it, whatever we say or do is pointless, what's past is past.<n><t>Do you wish to know more about the <yTear of Dragon>? Well I have two options for you. One, you sell me the gem and pretend that nothing else has happened. Two, I'll tell you all the things I know about this gem but you'll have to promise me you'll keep me informed about it all once you've solved the mystery.

Definitions.Name: Sale of Dragon's Tear

Needs.Description: Exchange the <yDragon's Tear> for 200,000G with <bTavern Keeper Long Er> at <j(3302, 2501)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Give me the gem, I'll buy it off you for <y200,000G> so that you can pretend that all this never happened. Don't think about it anymore, <y200,000G> is not easy to come by just like that.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Have you think it through? That is right! Why would you want to lose 200,000G for something unrelated to you? Right? Hehe sell the <yTear of Dragon> to me now!

Definitions.Name: Secret of Dragon's Tear
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>How did you manage to get hold of the <yTear of Dragon>? Its a good thing that you did not try to use it.<n><t>What the legend describes is real. However, there is one important point that was left out. The blood and tears that you shed must be for others!

Definitions.Name: Holy Water

Needs.Description: Go to <pDark Blue Island> at <j(3800, 550)> and use <yGlass Bottle> to collect the seawater.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Pain and suffering is also a gift by the gods. It is only through the pain and hardship that one experiences that he is able to grow unceasingly. However, when a person shoulders too much of others pain and sorrow, it will affect him severely and therefore the <rIcy Dragon> was created to wash away a person's pain and tears. However, people started abusing this idea. And so a curse was made to turn people into <rIcy Dragons> should they try to abuse the kindness of the gods. <n><t>Your friend probably did not know of this. If you wish to help him, travel to the <pMagical Ocean> at <j(3800, 550)>. The sea water nearby contains the blessings of the <bGoddess> which is able to cleanse him of the curse. Bring the water back to me and I'll teach you how to use it to save your friend.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Wow, that was quick. Let me take a look to make sure that you've collected the right sea water.

Definitions.Name: Redemption

Needs.Description: Use the <yHoly Water> on the <yTear of Dragon> to release the soul trapped in it.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Cleanse your friend with this blessed water together with the <rTear of Dragon> and he'll be set free.

Definitions.Name: Love Letter of Zhou

Needs.Description: Help <bBanker - Wang Mo> bring back 1 set of <yTrendy Clothes> from <bCommerce - Yuri> at <j(3196, 2509)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is...Wait! Don't go! You have read this letter, haven't you?<n><t>Maintaining your silence doesn't help, you are already betrayed by the intense sweating. Actually I came to silence the witness but since I see much honesty in you, I will give you a chance to repent. I heard that there is many new goods at <bYuri>'s place at <j(3195,2506)>, help me obtain one and I shall spare your life.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Yes! Just what I wanted. I'll let you off on account of this piece of clothing. But if I were to catch you sprouting nonsense, I'll kill you with my bare hands.

Definitions.Name: Letter of Zhou
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>��Again? That guy...I really don't know what to say about him.<n><t>Oh, I'm sorry! I wasn't talking about you. Please go back and tell him to give it up, he'll understand.

Definitions.Name: New Goods
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>How did you know I've got new supplies? Looks like you're an expert too. I'm also expecting the arrival of the new supplies, but the ship which sailed out along with us have not arrived yet and I'm too worried to be happy. If you're willing to sail out to the sea to check it out, I could give a free shirt for your trouble.

Definitions.Name: Buy New Clothes
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> You don't intend to go to sea for me? Very well, I shall not force you then. I'll give you a 20 percent discount for this. 100000G what do you say? I'm an honest person, does it look like I'm out to cheat you of your money?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Actually I was hoping that you would be willing to go to sea for me, but, since you are willing to part with 100000G, there's nothing much I can do..

Definitions.Name: Roland

Needs.Description: Wait around for <bBarkeeper Sang Di> at <j(3287, 2501)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you asking about <bRoland>? <bRoland> is the hero of all legends. All the girls in our city idolizes him and he is the role model for all the young guys...<n><t>I will tell you more once I have <pcollected all my debts>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Woah! All the accounts have been settled. Come listen, let me continue where we previously left off.

Definitions.Name: Tragedy

Needs.Description: Investigate around <pMagical Ocean> at <j(3757, 1248)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do you know why <bOldman Blurry> is not willing to help you with the translation? That's because, after reading an article that he translated, his beloved grandson left <pArgent City> in search of the hidden city that was mentioned. Since then, he has never returned and that is why <bOldman Blurry> no longer wishes to do any more translations.<n><t>He was such a lovable young boy and he would visit me often. The last news I heard was that his grandson sailed towards the <pMagical Ocean> <j(3757, 1248)> before he went missing. Could you do me a favor and go investigate? Take my <yUnderwater Detector>, it'll help you with your search.

Definitions.Name: Tragedy

Needs.Description: Bring the <yLetter in a Bottle> to <bBlurry> at <j(2272, 2700)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hmm, I understand this writing. It looks like our friend has run into some pirates. <n><t>Take this to <bOldman Blurry>, it may come as a shock to him but I guess we all have to face the hard fact.

Definitions.Name: Tragedy
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I knew this would happen�� However, I am somewhat comforted that you gave me this letter. At least I now know what has become of him.

Definitions.Name: Past
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>An ancient logbook? I think I might have seen it somewhere before. However, since it wasn't worth anything, it was distributed out among everyone. You can try asking them for it.

Definitions.Name: Demand for Payment

Needs.Description: Help <bSang Di> collect the debt from <bLong Er, Luna, Yuri, Wu Xin, Cloud, Bill and Shuang>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What? You're interested in helping me to collect my debts? That's wonderful! It isn't much actually, just 2,000,000G. Everything is recorded in this book. If you can collect it all, I'll give you the information you need.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I must thank you. Its really 2 millions. Did they cause you any trouble?<n><t>This gift is for you. Keep it well.

Definitions.Name: Demand for Payment
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, are you here to collect the debt on behalf of <bSang Di>? You're just on time, here's 100000 as capital and here's 100000G as interest.<n><t>(*Sweat* 100000G interest? What kind of business is <bSang Di> running?

Definitions.Name: Demand for Payment
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, look at me. I'm just a poor old man. Do you think I have enough to repay her? If it weren't for my wive falling gravely ill I wouldn't have run into such a huge debt with her. How about this? Could you take this 100000G and help me pay the interest? It's not that much, 100000G will do.

Definitions.Name: Long Er's Debt

Needs.Description: Go to <bBanker Wang Mo> at <j(3290, 2512)> to take 200000g.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh darn�� my memory must be failing me. I've been busy recently with my work. Could you do me a favor and run over to the bank? I'll inform Wang Mo for you? If I remember correctly, the total amount inclusive of interest is 200000G.

Definitions.Name: Long Er's Debt
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Are you here to collect money on behalf of <bLong Er>? HERE! A total of 200000G to be exact. However, I'll need you to pay 200G as administration fees.

Definitions.Name: Demand for Payment
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What? You want it now? Didn't we have a 3-month agreement on this? I was supposed to use this money for my wedding arrangement. Could you leave some behind? What? An interest of 300000G? Ah forget it. Problem is I've already spent some of the money and the wedding ceremony has yet to commence. Since, I have yet to receive any valuable gifts from my relatives, can you make do with the current amount I have?

Definitions.Name: Grocer's Debt

Needs.Description: Go to <pUnderwater Tunnel> and collect 3 <yTorn Corpse Wrap>, 3 <yDamaged Corpse Wrap> and 3 <yIntact Corpse Wrap> from the zombies.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Lately, there is a demand for <yTeleport Tickets>. However I am out of materials to capitalize on this opportunity. If you can head down to the <pUnderwater Tunnel> and get me some materials, I will be able to return your money from the sales.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Haha! With these I'll be able to make more tickets! Here, I've borrowed 400000G  from the bank as I'm very confident that I'll make be able to make a huge profit from the ticket sales alone.<n><t>Oh yes! Here's another 20000G. It's my gratitude to you for doing me this favor.

Definitions.Name: Shuang's Debt

Needs.Description: Help the <bPhysican> send the herbs to <bNavy Commander> in <pThundoria Castle> at <j(713, 1416)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Can you wait just a few more days? I just need to get this batch of goods transported over to the <bNavy Commander> in <pThundoria>. It's all good to go, I'm just waiting for someone to deliver them for me and I'll be able to receive 400000G as payment.<n><t>If you are willing to run this errand for me, I will be able to repay you quickly.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Has the goods been delivered? That's good. The money should be credited to my account any time now, let me have a look.<n><t>Oh here, payment has been made. Here's the 400000G I owe and on top of that, here's an extra 20000G as a way of thanking you for your effort.

Definitions.Name: Shuang's Debt
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh? I haven't seen you before, I was expecting the same person from the previous shipment. But nonetheless, if all the goods are accounted for I will be able send payment immediately. You may leave now, don't worry I will send payment as soon as I am done inspecting these goods.

Definitions.Name: Yuri's Debt

Needs.Description: Get 5 <yCrystal Balls> from <rFox Spirit>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> I would be able to return the money by now if the 5 <yCrystal Balls> that I was looking after did not go missing. Now I have to use all my money to pay as compensation because of my negligence. Could you help me to look for the missing <yCrystal Balls>? If you find them, I'll be able to repay you immediately.<n><t>My suspicion is that a <rFox Spirit> stole the <yCrystal Balls>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh my! How did you manage to find it? You're my hero! Here's the 400000G which I owe the old lady. To thank you, here's an extra 20000G.

Definitions.Name: Roland

Needs.Description: Wait for <bBarkeeper - Sang Di> at <j(3287, 2501)> to deposit the gold.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have 2 million gold to deposit into the bank.<n><t>Talk to you later.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Its easy to save when you are old��

Definitions.Name: Retrospection

Needs.Description: Talk to <bPhysician Daisha>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>That was an incident that happened a long time ago, an unpleasant memory that I would rather not think about. <bRoland> was the greatest pirate at that time, his charming smile always full of mystery...Ahh! I have a headache just thinking about it. Here! Take this necklace and continue on your adventure. You will gradually unravel the mystery. Go to <pIcicle City> and find a young man named Daisha. Who knows there might be some shocking surprises in store for you.

Definitions.Name: Retrospection
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh god,I have insomnia everynight!

Definitions.Name: Daisha's Nightmare

Needs.Description: Look for <bHocus Pocus>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I can't get to sleep everynight. I have been having nightmares recently. I really can't fathom the meaning of these nightmares. I need to get some advice on this, but unfortunately, I'm pretty tied up this few days. Can you help me ask <bHocus Pocus> at <j(3262, 2502)> about this?

Definitions.Name: Daisha's Nightmare
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You come to obtain a divination for <bDaisha>? I already foretold that you will come today!

Definitions.Name: Mischief of Fox Taoist

Needs.Description: Kill 10 <rFox Taoists>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Usually, I don't help others in divination, but you have the necklace as proof and you look sincere. So.. I'm going to make you an exception just this once.<n><t>###..**##%! It's the <rFox Taoist>. Go kill 10 <rFox Taoist> at <j(3322, 2460)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have quite a good performance. I feel like making you my disciple.

Definitions.Name: Unravel the dream of Daisha

Needs.Description: Find <bDaisha> to help him unravel the meaning of his dreams.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There is no need to thank me. Its always a pleasure to help someone in need. Go to <pIcicle City> and look for <bDaisha> at <j(1352, 499)>.

Definitions.Name: Unravel the dream of Daisha
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Really? I finally can have a good sleep tonight! Take these money as a reward. You are talented.

Definitions.Name: Belinda's nightmare

Needs.Description: Look for <bBanker Belinda> at <j(1360, 519)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Would you mind helping me again? My pretty neighbour, <bBelinda> at <j(1360, 519)> seems to be having some problems lately.

Definitions.Name: Belinda's nightmare
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Was it <bDaisha> who told you? I'm so touched. There's actually someone who cares for me.

Definitions.Name: Rescue Belinda

Needs.Description: Look for <bHocus Pocus>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I didn't sleep well last night, now I'm too tired to do anything. Can you help me get a divination from the fortune teller at <j(3262, 2502)>? Remember to come back and tell me the outcome.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for being so kind. This is something to show my appreciation. I happened to hear that the fortune teller at <j(3262, 2502)> is looking for you. He might have something important.

Definitions.Name: Mytho Crystal Ball

Needs.Description: Remember! Bring back 2 <yAzure Crystals> and 3 <yPerfect Crystals>!

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I give divinations only when my conditions are met. I'm making the most powerful <yCrystal Ball> ever to be depicted in the legends, but I'm still lacking of 2 <yAzure Crystals>that can be found on <rFeral Blood Polliwog> at <j(2550, 400)> in Ascaron, and 3 <yPerfect Crystals> that can be found on <rHorrific Cursed Corpse> at <j(360, 1340)> in <pAscaron>. You wouldn't reject me now, would you?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I predicted that you would be back, but I didn't know that you would be so fast.

Definitions.Name: Mischief of Fox Spirit

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rFox Spirit> and return!

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>###...**##%! This time, its the <rFox Spirit> at <j(3306, 2444)> on <pSpring Island> causing trouble. Do not let them off, kill 5 of them!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Go back and let <bBelinda> at <j(1360, 519)> know about this piece of good news.

Definitions.Name: Spirit of Roland

Needs.Description: Find <bSang Di> to inquire about <bSpirit of Roland>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I admire people who are kind and brave like you. I have looked into your soul, and can see that you are defintely a man of substance. You carry within you, the will of the great Roland. If you want to know more, I suggest that you ask <bSang Di> at <j(3287, 2501)> of <pSpring Town>.

Definitions.Name: Spirit of Roland
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Why is there always someone mentioning about the Pirate King <bRoland> in front of me? Its such a headache!

Definitions.Name: Heal Sang Di

Needs.Description: Bring 1 <yHealer Robe> from <rTerra Soldier Leader>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I seemed to have fallen sick lately. I have simply no strength left in me. Will you take pity on me and help me find a <yHealer Robe>, as I can no longer move around without aching all over. I have heard that wearing it will cure me of my sickness. If not I won't be able to do anything.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for helping an old granny like me!

Definitions.Name: Highly Nutritious Product

Needs.Description: Hunt <rChimera> and bring back 1 <yChimera Horn>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do I look better now? If someone can help me find 1 highly nutritious <yChimera Horn> from <rChimera> at <j(662, 2460)> in <pAscaron>, I should be able to recover and remember some things.. Won't you be this someone...?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>That's more like it, way to go!

Definitions.Name: Bloodstone

Needs.Description: Find <bSupermun> for <yBloodstone>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The recipe of the <yMemory Soup> is a family secret. It cannot be passed on to outsiders so easily. Unless you help me find what I have been looking for for a very long time, the <yBloodstone>. A few days ago, I received news that the <yBloodstone> is with <bSupermun> at <j(1080, 3086)>. Come and find me once you have the Bloodstone!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bSupermun> is an idiot. He doesn't know what is a <yGem> at all, and he dares to hold a fair? This stone has a very high value. It is one of the highest grade among <yJit Bloodstone>...Oh forget it, its useless to tell you all these anyway.

Definitions.Name: Invitation Letter

Needs.Description: Send the <yInvitation Letter> to <pMagical Ocean>'s <bBanker Judis>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have to show my respect to the <bMerman Prince>, but I wasn't interested in that stone and have given it to <bJudis> at <j(906, 3539)>. Coincidently, I have a Gem Fair coming up and would like to invite him. Help me send the <yInvitation Letter> to him. I'll mention about this in the Invitation Letter. I'm sure he'll help you...If he is please with you.

Definitions.Name: Invitation Letter
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>How can you take back something that you have given away? Its atrocious! As if I care! But since you are not as good-looking as I am, I guess I can help you��

Definitions.Name: Cooling Black Pearl

Needs.Description: Obtained 1 <yBlack Pearl> with trememdous cooling powers.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I never thought that the <bMerman Prince> would give you the <yMemory Soup> so easily. Oh! I almost forgot something very important. The <yMemory Soup> is extremely hot. It can only be drunk after it has cooled down considerably. You will need to get 1 <yBlack Pearl> that can help to lower the temperature of the soup.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The use of the <bBlack Pearl> is very important. Your sense of adventure is most respectable!

Definitions.Name: Amber Tear

Needs.Description: Help <bMysterious Granny> deliver the <yAmber Tear> to <bLanga> in <pShaitan City> at <j(852, 3549)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Young man, <yMemory Capsule> has a very important message. Only those that are really kind and good have the right to know.<n><t>Although I'm old now, I was actually very pretty when I was young. I even had a prince interested in me. But I only have <bLanga> of <pShaitan City> in my heart. Come to think of it, I have not seen him for a very long time. Can you help me give this <yAmber Tear> to him?

Definitions.Name: Amber Tear
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you. I know how she feels too but unfortunately, things don't always go according to what the heart desires. Even if she continues to wait for me, I'm still unable to be with her. Send word to her to let things be as they are.

Definitions.Name: Restore Past

Needs.Description: Obtain <yRestoration Potion> from <bDitto>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Unfortunately, the past is gone. Even though the candle has been found, the enchantations on it is gone. If you really want to know, ask for a <yRestoration Potion> from <bDitto>. Come back to me when you have gotten the <yRestoration Potion>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I poured half on the candle, chanting: May love be everlasting.<n><t>Do you have any impression? I was once the person you love...Its all in the past now. I don't wish to say anymore. Bring the other half back to <bGannon>.

Definitions.Name: Let go off love

Needs.Description: Give the <yLotus Clover> to <bMinelli>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bMinelli> must be very sad. You are really very cruel. If your happiness is based on her pain, then I won't help you. If theres really no helping it, it will be best to let her completely forget it...Here's a <yLotus Clover>.

Definitions.Name: Let go off love
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>By releasing me to save you, I agreed.

Definitions.Name: Piety Treasure Map

Needs.Description: Give the <yTreasure Map> to the <bMerman Prince>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You are here to ask me about <yBrimstone>? That was a long time ago. It was kept a secret because of the catastrophe that it may cause. Therefore it will not be easy for you to learn the whereabouts of the <yBrimstone>.. Unless you can swiftly deliver this <yTreasure Map> to <bMerman Prince> at <j(1254, 3491)> of <pMagical Ocean>.

Definitions.Name: Piety Treasure Map
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Actually, what he have given you is just a normal piece of marked paper, not a treasure map. You never try to open it, which means that you are a very trustworthy person. I'll reveal the secret to you: <yBrimstone> consist of <yMoonstone> and <ySunstone>. Theres only 3 person who knows the secret of the <yBrimstone> in the whole world. I have a piece of <yMoonstone>. Here take it.

Definitions.Name: Whereabouts of Sunstone

Needs.Description: Find out more from <bPhysician Ditto>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Shouldn't you be on your way? Alright, since you are so determined, I'll reveal a clue to you.. You can inquire about the <ySunstone> from <bDitto>. Here, take this <yRecommendation Letter> as proof.

Definitions.Name: Whereabouts of Sunstone
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Only a few people in the world knows the secret of the <yBrimstone>. The two of them don't trust anyone easily. Congratulations on passing their test.

Definitions.Name: Kill Mummy
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bKentaro> needs you to kill 1 <rHorrific Cursed Corpse>. Come and find me when you have succeeded.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Welcome back! Brave warrior!

Definitions.Name: Mask of Zorro

Needs.Description: Look for <bKentaro>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bKentaro> ask for you to go and find him at <j(1894, 2798)> when you have killed the <rHorrific Cursed Corpse>. Here is a <yMask of Zorro> to prove that you have successfully completed the task. This item will be very useful in the future.

Definitions.Name: Mask of Zorro
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Our meeting was an accident brought by an idiot...I hope you won't disappoint me.

Definitions.Name: Enchanted Pouch

Needs.Description: Look for <bGeneral William> in <pArgent City> to safekeep the <yMask of Zorro>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although the evil has been removed, the <yMask of Zorro> is still too stained with evil to be trusted. Its dark powers must not be allowed to awaken. The only way is to use a <yEnchanted Pouch> on it. <bGeneral William> at <j(2277, 2831)> will help. I have already sent a letter to him. Bring the mask to him.

Definitions.Name: Enchanted Pouch
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Looks like you are not greedy enough to want to possess the mask. Good for you! This <ySacred Amulet> is what <bKentaro> wants me to give to you to cure the curse. Bring it to <bSang Di> at <j(3287, 2501)> at <pSpring Town> to fulfil your quest.

Definitions.Name: Sang Di's guidance

Needs.Description: Talk to someone who can tell you about the various classes.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The Truth is for you to sought yourself. I can tell you an important news: Sought the one who can show you the road to your Class.

Definitions.Name: Sang Di's guidance
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bSang Di> is always giving me trouble!

Definitions.Name: Sang Di's guidance
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bSang Di> is always giving me trouble!

Definitions.Name: Sang Di's guidance
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bSang Di> is always giving me trouble!

Definitions.Name: Sang Di's guidance
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bSang Di> is always giving me trouble!

Definitions.Name: Daniel's Suggestion

Needs.Description: Talk to Harbor Operator Gregory.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Happiness always gets blown away. Even if you have experienced a lot in life, there are still times when you don't know what to do. At times like this, I'll go on a sea voyage. Why don't you give it a try? <n><t>Go on a journey to <pSalva Haven> at <j(194, 1718)> in <pDeep Blue>. Find and talk to <bHarbor Operator - Gregory>.

Definitions.Name: Gannon's Suggestion

Needs.Description: Talk to <bMinelli>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hope is always easily crushed.<n><t><bMinelli> at <j(1244, 3186)> will tell you what to do.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The <bEnlightened One>'s identity is shrouded in mystery. I'm not very sure of it myself. You can ask <bLanga> of <pShaitan City>, <pArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie> and <pIcicle City>'s <bReyno>. But time is the essence. You can only ask one of them.

Definitions.Name: Top Disciple

Needs.Description: Find the one who told you about the <bEnlightened One>. Hint: <bGregory, Minelli, Ray or Peter>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The <bEnlightened One> is very eccentric. He only address those whose soul and skills are strong. Find the one who told you about him. He will conduct a few tests for you in my stead.

Definitions.Name: Top Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><pArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie> says he's not familiar with your class. Allow me to test if you are suitable to be his disciple in his stead.

Definitions.Name: Top Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><pArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie> says he's not familiar with your class. Allow me to test if you are suitable to be his disciple in his stead.

Definitions.Name: Top Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bLittle Daniel> is very busy. He has requested that I test if you are capable of being his disciple.

Definitions.Name: Top Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I'm currently the <bHigh Priest>'s secretary. I'm here to test if you are suitable to be his student in his stead.

Definitions.Name: Initial Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rTerra Captain> at <pAscaron> for <bPeter>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The fulfilment of dreams need realistic training. First kill 5 <rTerra Warrior> at <j(314, 2641)> in <pAscaron>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are now a qualified beginner disciple. Keep it up!

Definitions.Name: Lv2 Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rEvil Undead Warrior> in <pAscaron> for <bPeter>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I once taught some disciples. They can't even kill 5 <rEvil Undead Warrior> at <j(580, 2121)>. I had them thrown out. Do you want to try?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Your performance is still acceptable. At least, you won't be expelled!

Definitions.Name: 3rd Grade Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 6 Evil Pumpkin Knights in <pAscaron> for <bPeter>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>For your next challenge, kill 6 <rEvil Pumpkin Knights> at <j(340, 1581)> in <pAscaron>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are getting closer and closer to your dream!

Definitions.Name: Initial Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <pSeabed Tunnel's> <rBaby Icy Dragon> for <bRay>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><pIcicle City> is getting colder. Why don't you go kill 5 <rBaby Icy Dragons> at <j(348, 436)> in <pUnderwater Tunnel> to warm up.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I can feel your temperature getting warm.

Definitions.Name: Lv2 Disciple

Needs.Description: Hunt 5 <rMad Tribal Villager> in <pAscaron> and return to <bRay>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You are getting warm! Kill 5 <rMad Tribal Villagers> at <j(561, 2334)> in <pAscaron>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Your temperature is getting warmer..

Definitions.Name: 3rd Grade Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 6 <rWerewolf Warrior Leader> in <pAscaron> for <bRay>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Still need to get warmer! Kill 6 <rWerewolf Warrior Leaders> at <j(472, 2484)> in <pAscaron>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Your temperature is continuing to rise.

Definitions.Name: Initial Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rEvil Undead Warrior> in <pAscaron> for <bMinelli>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Recently, there have been complaints of <rEvil Undead Warrior> at <j(580, 2121)> in <pAscaron> being too ugly and scaring the city. In place of the <bHigh Priest>, I now bestow upon you, the title of Environmental Warrior. Go eliminate them.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Although its not their fault for being ugly, but they shouldn't scare people like that!

Definitions.Name: Lv2 Disciple

Needs.Description: Hunt 2 <rBewitching Siren> in <pMagical Ocean> and return to <bMinelli>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I can't stand the <rBewitching Siren> at <j(1014, 2550)> in <pMagical Ocean>. They think they are so beautiful. Humph! think they are more beautiful than me? Humble them by killing 2.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Way to go!

Definitions.Name: 3rd Grade Disciple

Needs.Description: Kill 3 <rDark Blue Siren> at <pDeep Blue> for <bMinelli>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rBewitching Siren>'s cousins <rDark Blue Siren> at <j(1038, 2317)> from <pDeep Blue> has announced that they want to exact revenge for their cousins. Its imperative that they do not harbor such thoughts. Eliminate them!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Lets see who still dares to show off in front of me!

Definitions.Name: Initial Disciple

Needs.Description: Collect 2 <yShining Fish Bone Rack> for <bGregory>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I want to build 2 light houses at the harbor, but its too far for eletricity to be connected. Rumor has it that <yShining Fish Bone Rack> can give off organic rays. Help me acquire 2 from <rFeral Fish Bone> at <j(900, 1308)> found in <pMagical Ocean>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>All the sea travellers will be grateful to you!

Definitions.Name: Lv2 Disciple

Needs.Description: Obtain 2 <yBewitching Siren Crystals> from <rBewitching Siren> at <j(1014, 2550)> in <pMagical Ocean> and bring to <bGregory>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Theres another problem. I don't wish for the monsters in the ocean to be able to see the rays too. They will follow the rays and hide near to light house to attack Ships. Can you block off part of the ray by getting some <yBewitching Siren Crystals>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>To kill a monster require stuff from the monster. This is called...called...Cough...cough��Lets not talk about these...Thank you.

Definitions.Name: 3rd Grade Disciple

Needs.Description: Look for 99 <yElven Fruits> from <rMystic Shrub> and give to <bGregory>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>For your help, I have decided to make your test easier. Find 99 <yElven Fruit>. I want to make <yFruit Juice>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It is said that drinking this fruit juice grants immortality. Remember to keep this a secret!

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple

Needs.Description: <t>Talk to <pArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You have reached my expected qualifications. Now go and find <bArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie>.

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The swiftness in which you accomplish your tasks will be the envy of all pirates!

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple

Needs.Description: <t>Talk to <pArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie>.

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The swiftness in which you accomplish your tasks will be the envy of all pirates!

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple

Needs.Description: <t>Talk to <pArgent City>'s <bChairman Ronnie>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You are now a qualified disciple of the <bHigh Priest>. Look for <bRonnie> in <pArgent City> now.

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The swiftness in which you accomplish your tasks will be the envy of all pirates!

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You are already <bLittle Daniel>'s qualified disciple, go find <bRonnie>.

Definitions.Name: Qualified Disciple
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The swiftness in which you accomplish your tasks will be the envy of all pirates!

Definitions.Name: Grandeur Oracle

Needs.Description: <t>Look for <bTailor Bebe> in <pArgent City> at <j(2265, 2704)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Find the 8 servants of <bGod> to get some ominous revelation and return to me.

Definitions.Name: Grandeur Oracle
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>My true identity is the servant of <bWater Deity>��

Definitions.Name: First Gate

Needs.Description: Hunt 2 <rFeral Fish Bone> at <j(900, 1308)> in <pMagical Ocean> and return to <bTailor - Bebe>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bWater Deity>'s instruction is at the faraway 8th Gate. First accept my first test of God.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You can receive the blessing of <bWater Deity> wherever there is water.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to First Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Go to <pIcespire Haven> and look for <bMaster Kerra> at <j(2664, 654)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Find <bMaster Kerra> at <j(2664, 654)> in <pIcespire Haven>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to First Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have unknowingly went on the path to getting close to God.

Definitions.Name: 2nd Gate

Needs.Description: Kill 2 <pMagical Ocean>'s <rFeral Ruby Dolphins> at <j(866, 2171)> for <bMaster Kerra>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>First Gate is only a small warm-up. Do not be conceited. Come and pass the 2nd Gate: Challenge of the servants of <bFire Deity>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You can receive the protection of <bFire Deity> wherever theres fire.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 2nd Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Look for <bMarcus> at <j(789, 3112)> in <pOasis Haven>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Find <bMarcus> <j(789, 3112)> at <pOasis Haven>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 2nd Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are still a normal human after passing through 2 doors.

Definitions.Name: 3rd Gate

Needs.Description: Kill 2 <pMagical Ocean>'s <rBewitching Siren> at <j(1014, 2550)> on behalf of <bMarcus>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am the servant of <bWind Deity>. I wonder if you are afraid of meeting the challenge.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Fret not when your hair gets blown messy by the wind, because its the loving caress of the <bWind Deity>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 3rd Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Go to <pSkeleton Haven> and look for <bXeus> at <j(2138, 545)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Find <bXeus> at <j(2138, 545)> in <pSkeleton Haven>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 3rd Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Warrior, the 4th Gate is not as simple as you think.

Definitions.Name: 4th Gate

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rBeardy Pirate Fighter> at <j(1588, 1708)> in <pDeep Blue> for <bXeus>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My secret identity is the close aide of <bEarth Deity>. Ssssh! Congratulation on passing the 3rd Gate. It will be easy to pass mine.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Praises of you can be heard throughout the whole land. You are a real powerful Hero!

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 4th Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Go to <pThundoria Castle> and look for <bDoctor Masa> at <j(773, 1549)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Find <bDoctor Masa> at <j(773, 1549)> in <pThundoria Castle>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 4th Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Welcome to the 5th Gate!

Definitions.Name: 5th Gate

Needs.Description: Kill 2 <rSiren Archer> in <pDeep Blue> at <j(3634, 3808)> and return to <bDoctor Masa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The first snowflake of 2088 will come later than expected. This is what I, servant of the <bSnow Deity> predicts.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>What...You got through 5th Gate?!

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 5th Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Go to <pHubble Haven> and look for <bDannis> at <j(136, 3432)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bDannis> at <j(136, 3432)> of <pHubble Haven> is waiting for you.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 5th Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Youngster, take my word. Never do anything wrong, or retribution will catch up with you one day. I remembered plucking all the chest fur off a <rBear Cub> when I was young, and yesterday I was caught by a monster and burned of all my chest hair...Sob...

Definitions.Name: 6th Gate

Needs.Description: Kill 6 <rWhite Bobcats> in <pLone Tower 1> and return to <bDannis>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bThunder Deity> is my master. Here is the 6th Gate. Your mission is to kill 6 <rWhite Bobcats> at <pLone Tower 1>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I guarantee that when the <bThunder Deity> gets angry and strikes everyone, he will be a little off target so as to avoid you.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 6th Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Look for <bZurbi> at <j(1037, 671)> in <pAtlantis Haven>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Bring along my blessings and find <bZurbi> at <j(1037, 671)> in <pAtlantis Haven>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 6th Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>After the 6th gate...you are still a normal human!

Definitions.Name: 7th Gate

Needs.Description: Kill 7 <pBarren Cavern>'s <rTerra Captain> at <j(1392, 3066)> and return to <bZurbi>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My Lord, <bLightning Deity>, is forgiving. 7th Gate is where the game starts.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Looks like you are not so ordinary after all.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 7th Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Find <pSolace Haven>'s <bLinda> at <j(515, 2437)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Find <bLinda> at <j(515, 2437)> in <pSolace Haven>.

Definitions.Name: Goodbye to 7th Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Forgiveness and love is the weapon to conquer the world!

Definitions.Name: Instructions for last Gate

Needs.Description: <t>Bring the <yOracle> to <bLanga>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Here is the <yOracle>. Bring it to <bLanga> for your answer.

Definitions.Name: Instructions for last Gate
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>To be able to get the <yOracle> shows that you have put in more effort than a normal man could.

Definitions.Name: Perfect Pirate Mission

Needs.Description: Kill 10 <rEvil Pumpkin Knight> at <j(340, 1581)> in <pAscaron> for <bReyno>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Every well-known pirates have looks and brains. They also symbolises Courage and Strength. Find the mission that I have for you to prove that you are a perfect pirate.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good.

Definitions.Name: Perfect Pirate Mission

Needs.Description: Obtain 2 <yRoyal Swords> from <pAscaron>'s <rPalace Guard> at <j(435, 1690)> for <bReyno>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although I'm a trader, I have always wish to be a courageous knight and uphold peace for royalty and beauty. Errm can you help me get 2 legendary <yRoyal Swords>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Strong.

Definitions.Name: Perfect Pirate Mission

Needs.Description: Kill 3 <rDark Blue Siren> at <j(1038, 2317)> in <pDeep Blue> for <bReyno>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I heard that because <bDannis> did something wrong when he was young, his chest hair was recently burnt. It's frightening just to think about it because i too did a lot of wrong things when I was that age. Come to think of it, I once removed the tail scales of a <rLittle Siren>. Although it was wrong of me, but it was a case of whoever strikes first.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Never do anything wrong. Do not lie to me especially.

Definitions.Name: The mystery has been solved

Needs.Description: <t>Bring the <yStone of Meng> to <pIcicle City Haven>'s <bWeird Grampa> at <j(808, 373)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Very good! You have fulfil the requirements to meet with the <bEnlightened One>. He is actually <bWeird Grampa>. This <yStone of Meng> was a gift from him. Show it to him and he will oblige you on my account.

Definitions.Name: The mystery has been solved
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't bother me, I'm having some problems. I won't give face to anyone!

Definitions.Name: The mystery has been solved

Needs.Description: <t>Bring the <yStone of Meng> to <pIcicle City Haven>'s <bWeird Grampa> at <j(808, 373)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Very good! You have fulfil the requirements to meet with the <bEnlightened One>. He is actually <bWeird Grampa>. This <bStone of Meng> was a gift from him. Show it to him and he will oblige you on my account.

Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't bother me, I'm having some problems. I won't give face to anyone!

Definitions.Name: The mystery has been solved

Needs.Description: <t>Bring the <yStone of Meng> to <pIcicle City Haven>'s <bWeird Grampa> at <j(808, 373)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>With your intelligence now, you have earned the right to see the <bEnlightened One>. He is actually <bWeird Grampa>. This <yStone of Meng> was a gift from him. Show it to him and he will oblige you on my account.

Definitions.Name: The mystery has been solved
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't bother me, I'm having some problems. I won't give face to anyone!

Definitions.Name: Dispute of the Old

Needs.Description: <t>Look for <bGranny Dong>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You are asking who annoyed me? Ask <bGranny Dong> at <j(795, 363)> in <pIcicle City Haven> and you will know the answer.

Definitions.Name: Dispute of the Old
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Why did I quarrel with him? Does it mean that I'm old, I can no longer uphold the truth? After choosing <rHello>, answer my question.

Definitions.Name: Granny's Intellect

Needs.Description: Click on <rHello Again!> and answer question from <bGranny Dong>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since you are a person of talent, I'll ask you another question.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Solve more intellectual questions and you can be as clever as me.

Definitions.Name: Cure infectious disease

Needs.Description: Make 1 <yLv3 Grenade> for <bGranny Dong>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You actually answered such a simple question wrongly. You must have been infected with <bWeird Grampa>'s senile disease. You need to undergo surgery to recover. Go learn how to make <yGrenade> now.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Not bad, it might be a misunderstanding that you have been infected.

Definitions.Name: Manual Healing

Needs.Description: Make 1 <yLv3 Flash Bomb> for <bGranny Dong>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You actually answered such a simple question wrongly. You must have been infected with <bWeird Grampa>'s senile disease. You need to undergo surgery to recover. Go learn how to make <yFlash Bomb> now.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Not bad, it might be a misunderstanding that you have been infected.

Definitions.Name: Guardian of Truth

Needs.Description: <t>Look for <bWeird Grampa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You have been appointed <bGuardian of Truth> by the great <bGranny Dong>. Go and talk to <bWeird Grampa> and let him think it over.

Definitions.Name: Guardian of Truth
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You mean <bGranny Dong> has admitted failure? You aren't joking with me, are you? Wahaha looks like the truth is in the hands of wise men like me, though we are far and few. You are hereby appointed <bGuardian of Truth> by the great <bWeird Grampa>!

Definitions.Name: Guardian of Truth

Needs.Description: <t>Look for <bWeird Grampa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You have been appointed <bGuardian of Truth> by the great <bGranny Dong>. Go and talk to <bWeird Grampa> and let him think it over.

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Curse

Needs.Description: Get <yPassword AB> from <rDeathsoul Gunboat> for <bWeird Grampa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You seems to be idling. Why don't you give me a hand? I have always wanted to research on the remedy for ancient curses. According to sources, there is a card with ancient curse incantations on <rDeathsoul Gunboat> at the <pCaribean>. I would like very much to research on it.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hurry and take a look! There's like nothing on it...Could it be the <yHeavenly Book>?

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Curse

Needs.Description: Defeat <rDeathsoul Speed Boat> and obtain <yPassword BC> for <bWeird Grampa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Theres nothing special about this curse. But since there is <yPassword AB>, then there must be <yPassword BC>. Find it for me so that I can make something out of this.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hurry and give it to me, I have a feeling that I may be on to something.

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Curse

Needs.Description: Obtain <yPassword CD> from <rDeathsoul Soldier> and give to <bWeird Grampa>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My research shows that I still need something called <yPassword CD>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't give me that look.. I really do have a feeling that I'm going to discover something this time.

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Curse

Needs.Description: Get <yPassword DE> from <rDeathsoul Soldier> for <bWeird Grampa>.
