Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You don't look stupid, why didn't you bring back <yPassword DE> as well? Now I can't continue with my research.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I can feel your discontentment..

Definitions.Name: Seal Research Outcome

Needs.Description: Wait for <bWeird Grampa> to tell you his research results.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I'll let you know the results later��
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>These cards have actually nothing to do with the curse. I have been tricked! Don't worry, I'll still give you something.

Definitions.Name: Wandering Creatures

Needs.Description: Talk to <bBerry> at <j(1893, 2812)>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The deep forest is a dangerous place to be in with ferocious bears on the prowl.<n><t>However, my nephew, <bBerry>, lives in the <pAbandoned Mine Haven> located at the edge of the forest. Could you visit him on my behalf and see if he's doing alright, brave adventurer?

Definitions.Name: Wandering Creatures
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I am fine. The bear cubs are not as dangerous as what my uncle thinks. In fact, I love playing with them.

Definitions.Name: Late Arrival

Needs.Description: Talk to <bMarcus> at <j(789, 3112)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi! You've come at the right time! I am on close terms with the merchants from the desert. They travel annually to our city to do trading. However, there has been no sign of them and they are very very late.<n><t>Could you look for <bMarcus> in <pOasis Haven> and find out what's keeping them?

Definitions.Name: Late Arrival
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, the recent, sandstorms are preventing us from traveling, so we have to postpone the date. Don't worry we'll definitely come by Argent City. It's good business!

Definitions.Name: Tundra Exploration

Needs.Description: Look for <bNana> at <j(798, 369)> for greater challenges.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi my friend, you have progressed rapidly. These little animals are no longer your match.<n><t>I heard <pIcicle Haven> is looking to recruit new adventurers. Why don't you give it a try? I'll write you a recommendation letter to <bNana>.

Definitions.Name: Tundra Exploration
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I have faith in your abilities since you <bPeter> recommended you.<n><t>You should thank him for his recommendation.

Definitions.Name: To the Desert!

Needs.Description: Look for <bKavosky> at <j(779, 3098)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Gracious me! I have not seen someone as new as you progress so quickly.<n><t>Sadly, these monster at the outskirts of Icicle city are no longer a threat to you. If you are interested, I can recommend you to <bKavosky> at <pOasis Haven> he's in need of a helping hand.

Definitions.Name: To the Desert!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I need your assistance. Please stay around and help out. Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Argent's Invitation

Needs.Description: Talk to <bKentaro> at <j(1894, 2798)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Listen to me, my friend. Icicle city is a very cold place to be in and is not good for your health if you aren't used to it.<n><t>People from <pAbandoned Mine Haven> has been requesting help from me lately.<n><t>If you don't mind, could you travel there and look for <bKentaro>?

Definitions.Name: Argent's Invitation
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I have faith in your abilities since <bPeter> introduced you.<n><t>You should be grateful for his recommendation.

Definitions.Name: Stir of the Tundra

Needs.Description: Look for <bJernis> at <j(803, 352)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey! You've arrived at the right time.<n><t><bJernis> is in trouble at <pIcicle Haven> and is in need of your help.<n><t>Since it there's nothing much here for you to do, why don't you make a trip there?

Definitions.Name: Stir of the Tundra
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Since you are recommended by Odessis, I have faith in your abilities.<n><t>Stick around and I will make the necessary arrangements.

Definitions.Name: Trade Embargo

Needs.Description: Look for <bMarcus> at <j(789, 3112)>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi, I need your help. I am in charge of delivering these supplies to <pOasis Haven>. However, wolves has been constantly attacking travelers lately. Could you send a message to <bMarcus> at Oasis Haven and see if he can think of some way for me to reach him safely?

Definitions.Name: Trade Embargo
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>So grateful to you! Without these supplies, we won't last till next month.

Definitions.Name: Warrior Recruitment

Needs.Description: Talk to <bKentaro> at <j(1894, 2798)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Listen to me, my friend. Shaitan city is a dusty place to be in and is not good for your health.<n><t>The <pAbandoned Mine Haven> has been requesting help from me lately.<n><t>If you don't mind, could you travel there and look for <bKentaro>?

Definitions.Name: Warrior Recruitment
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, so <bResline> asked you to come. Actually, I don't really trust her judgment.<n><t>But since you are here...Oh well...

Definitions.Name: Asha Followers

Needs.Description: Talk to <Granny Dong> at <j(795, 363)>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You've arrived just in time!<n><t>My good friend, <bGranny Dong>, moved to <pIcicle Haven> 10 years ago to spread the knowledge of medicine. However, the chill there is taking a toll on her health.<n><t>I need the help of a courageous adventurer to make the journey to send my blessings to her.

Definitions.Name: Asha Followers
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for conveying the blessings of the High Priest. I am feeling better already!

Definitions.Name: Jungle Exploration

Needs.Description: Talk to <bDurian> at <j(1535, 3071)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi, I can see that you have a passion for exploration.<n><t>However, this is not the right place for you. Seek out <pDurian> at <pRockery Haven>. He has some challenging tasks for you.

Definitions.Name: Jungle Exploration
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Although you are recommended by <bWenona>, if you are not suitable for the job, I will entrust any tasks to you.

Definitions.Name: Journey to the East

Needs.Description: Look for <bSolaru> at <j(1202, 3179)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, I know you.<n><t>Your reputation has spread far and wide in this desert. This Haven is too small for a person of your stature.<n><t>How about going to <pBabul Haven> and putting your ability to good use? <bSolaru> is currently in need of a person with your talents.

Definitions.Name: Journey to the East
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, I've heard a lot about you. <bMarcus> has a flair for scouting talents.<n><t>Please stay around here and I'll inform you if I need help with any tasks at hand.

Definitions.Name: In Search of a Bodyguard

Needs.Description: Talk to <bUlkar> at <j(1059, 661)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi, you sure looked bored. Is it because you are unable to find a worthy opponent here? If that is the case, let me introduce you to a businessman named <bUlkar> at <pAtlantis Haven>.<n><t>His trade route lies between dangerous forests and seems like a good job for the likes of you!

Definitions.Name: In Search of a Bodyguard
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Since you are recommended by <bFey Fey>, I will make arrangements for you to aid us in the escort.

Definitions.Name: Forest Exploration

Needs.Description: Look for <bAlexandis> at <j(1526, 3089)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, I can see that you are a person who likes to take risks.<n><t>Too bad you are at a wrong place, there is nothing of excitement here.<n><t>How about I recommend you a place called <pRockery Haven>. I have a friend named <bAlexandis>, he'll definitely give you some exciting errands.

Definitions.Name: Forest Exploration
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bKentaro> rarely praises anybody.<n><t>Since he trusts your ability, I will find a challenging task for you.

Definitions.Name: Dangerous Times

Needs.Description: Talk to <bSolaru> at <j(1202, 3179)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi, I was just about to look for you. My friend, <bSolaru>, was badly injured by sand bandits a few days ago while he was out looking for treasure. He is now recovering at <pBabul Haven>.<n><t>The trip there is too dangerous for me to make. Could you regards to him on my behalf?

Definitions.Name: Dangerous Times
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I'm fine. Its just that I cannot move as fast as I usually can just yet. Don't worry, I'll probably be well again in a few days.<n><t>Thank you for your concern!

Definitions.Name: Reinforcement for Atlantis

Needs.Description: Look for <bZurbi> at <j(1037, 671)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hello. I believe the monsters here are not longer your match. You have been a great defender of our small haven all this while.<n><t>However, one of my friends in <pAtlantis Haven> is in greater need of your abilities. <n><t>Can you look for <bZurbi> see how you can help him out?

Definitions.Name: Reinforcement for Atlantis
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! We're need of some help.<n><t>Please stay around!

Definitions.Name: Awakening

Needs.Description: Look for <bAlexandis> at <j(1526, 3089)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Youngster, if you stay here, it will only be a waste of your time.<n><t>Why don't you go and explore the world while you are still young? My student, <bAlexandis>, is currently residing in <pRockery Haven>.<n><t>If you tell him that I sent you, he will surely welcome you.

Definitions.Name: Awakening
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh you were sent here by my <bWeird Teacher>? Please make yourself at home.

Definitions.Name: Desert Exploration

Needs.Description: Talk <bMomo> at <j(1209, 3196)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi, I can see that you have a passion for exploration. However, you have come to the wrong place. Seek out <bMomo> at <tBabul Haven>.<n><t>She has some challenging task for you.

Definitions.Name: Desert Exploration
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Even though you are recommended by <bNana>, if you are not capable, I will have to turn you down.<bNana>.

Definitions.Name: Journey to the South

Needs.Description: Look for <bGasardis> at <j(1028, 649)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Youngster, if you stay here, it will only be a waste of your time. Why don't you go and explore the world while you are still young? My student, <bAlexandis>, is currently residing in <pRockery Haven>.<n><t>If you tell him that I sent you, he will surely welcome you.

Definitions.Name: Journey to the South
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Sigh, that strange old man still likes to order me around...<n><t>Oh well, forget it and since you are already here, you might as well stay around.<n><t>I'm still lacking in manpower here anyway.

Definitions.Name: Dream Sea

Needs.Description: Talk to <bAlena> at <j(2247, 2858)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh dear, don't tell me that you have yet to explore the ocean!?<n><t>Let me introduce you to <pArgent City> <bMaritime Assistant - Alena>. She can teach you all you need to know.

Definitions.Name: Dream Sea
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't worry. With my help you will be out at sea in no time!!

Definitions.Name: Navy Registration Now Open!

Needs.Description: Talk to <bAlena> at <j(2247, 2858)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Aye my friend. Have you not been to sea before? I guess its about time you did.<n><t>Let me introduce you to <pArgent City>'s <bMaritime Assistant - Alena>. She can teach you all you need to know about sailing.

Definitions.Name: Navy Registration Now Open!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't worry. With my help you will be out at sea in no time!!

Definitions.Name: The Navy Office

Needs.Description: Talk to <bAlena> at <j(2247, 2858)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh dear, don't tell me that you have yet to explore the ocean!?<n><t>Let me introduce you to <pArgent City> <bMaritime Assistant - Alena>. She can teach you all you need to know.

Definitions.Name: The Navy Office
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Don't worry. With my help you will be out at sea in no time!!

Definitions.Name: World's Finest Merchant

Needs.Description: Talk to <b<bTrader Chiroro>> at <j(2331, 2821)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Finally you have arrived! I am on good terms with <bChiroro>, the Trader in <pArgent City>. Recently, he wishes to take in some students to pass on his knowledge of sea commerce.<n><t>If you are interested in learning more about sea commerce, go and see <bChiroro>.

Definitions.Name: World's Finest Merchant
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You want to be the best trader?<n><t>Good! I expected that much from you.

Definitions.Name: Argent Trade Center

Needs.Description: Talk to <bTrader Chiroro> at <j(2331, 2821)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Finally you have arrived! I am on good terms with <bChiroro>, the Trader of <pArgent City>.<n><t>Recently, he wishes to take in some students to pass on his knowledge of sea commerce.<n><t>If you are interested in learning more about sea commerce, go and see <bChiroro>.

Definitions.Name: Argent Trade Center
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You want to be the best trader?<n><t>Good! I expected that much from you.

Definitions.Name: Sea Commerce

Needs.Description: Talk to <bTrader Chiroro> at <j(2331, 2821)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Finally you have arrived! I am on good terms with <bChiroro>, the Trader of <pArgent City>.<n><t>Recently, he wishes to take in some students to pass on his knowledge of sea commerce.<n><t>If you are interested in learning more about sea commerce, go and see <bChiroro>.

Definitions.Name: Sea Commerce
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You want to be the best trader?<n><t>Good! I expected that much from you.

Definitions.Name: Ambushed Swordsman

Needs.Description: Talk to <bKentaro> at <j(1894, 2798)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh dear!<n><t>Even someone as skilled as <bKentaro> got hurt by a monster inside the <pAbandoned Mine Haven>.<n><t>I am quite worried about the situation down there. Can you go to <pAbandoned Mine> and take a look?

Definitions.Name: Ambushed Swordsman
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I enraged those moles by accident while in the mine and got injuired.<n><t>Now my wound has recovered.

Definitions.Name: Traversing

Needs.Description: Send a message to <bWaala> at <j(1136, 2778)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Dangerous creatures lie in wait on the pass through the <pAndes Forest> to <pValhalla Haven>. Many people do not dare to venture there.<n><t>However, my son is doing research at the area. Can you take pity on a frail old woman like me and pass a message to my son, <bWaala>?<n><t>I wish that he will come and visit me.

Definitions.Name: Traversing
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Did my mother say that? Oh my, looks like I have been too engrossed in my work.

Definitions.Name: The Labyrinth Mystery

Needs.Description: Send a message to <bMas> at <j(1346, 451)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><pIcicle Castle> used to be very majestic. However, the rocky structures have start to corrode over the years.<n><t>Monsters have also started to dwell beneath the castle and recently, there are cases of missing people. <b<bMas>>, the Royal of <pIcicle Castle> need my son, Waala, to investigate this matter. However, my son is busy with his research.<n><t>Can you tell <b<bMas>> to look for someone else?

Definitions.Name: The Labyrinth Mystery
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh��Since Waala cannot make it, I will find other people.<n><t>Thank you for sending the letter over.

Definitions.Name: Mine Exploration

Needs.Description: Talk to <bGreg> at <j(1883, 2805)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Due to centuries of mining, the Abandoned Mine near Argent City is like an underground labyrinth.<n><t>Lots of creatures has start to grow in there after so many years.<n><t>Perhaps you might find some challenging monsters in there. Go and see <bGreg> at the <pAbandoned Mine Haven>, she can tell you more about the place.

Definitions.Name: Mine Exploration
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I have faith in your abilities since <bPeter> introduced you.<n><t>You should be grateful for his recommendation.

Definitions.Name: Waala's Crisis

Needs.Description: Talk to <bWaala> at <j(1136, 2778)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What took you so long?!<n><t>My dear <bWaala> is doing research at <pValhalla Haven>. However, he has lost his supplies and medicine along the way.<n><t>Can you help me deliver these items and check on him?

Definitions.Name: Waala's Crisis
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Water...Water...Ah...I feel better now.<n><t>Thank you! I'll be fine after a short rest.

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Discovery

Needs.Description: Send a message to <bIcicle Chairman Reyno> at <j(1294, 498)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, I found a map of Icicle castle by accident while researching ancient tomes.<n><t>The chairman of Icicle, <bReyno> will be very interested to learn about this. Can you pass a message to him?

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Discovery
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is an amazing discovery! Thank you for informing me!

Definitions.Name: Mine Labyrinth

Needs.Description: Talk to <bGreg> at <j(1883, 2805)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Due to centuries of mining, the Abandoned Mine near Argent City is like an underground labyrinth. Lots of creatures has start to grow in there after so many years.<n><t>Perhaps you might find some challenging monsters in there.<n><t>Go and see Greg at the Abandoned Mine Haven, she can tell you more about the place.

Definitions.Name: Mine Labyrinth
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Even though <bDurian> recommended you, if you are not suitable for the job, I will entrust any tasks to you.

Definitions.Name: Search for Talent

Needs.Description: Talk to <bGuiderius> at <j(1123, 2766)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi. My friend, <bGuiderius> is looking for a reliable person to help him out at <pValhalla Haven>. Since he has entrusted me with this request, I am not going to disappoint him.<n><t>Therefore, I have decided to recommend you. There will be a lot of challenging monsters. Are you ready?

Definitions.Name: Search for Talent
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I have faith in your abilities since Ulkar recommended you.<n><t>I will assign you some important tasks should anything arise.

Definitions.Name: Labyrinth Exploration

Needs.Description: Talk to <bIcicle Chairman Reyno> at <j(1294, 498)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My friend, I believed that the monsters here are no longer your match. Why don't you make a trip to <pIcicle City>?<n><t>The Chairman of Icicle city, <bReyno>, is currently looking for fighters to deal with the monster threat that's plaguing the city.<n><t>If you are willing, I can write you a recommendation letter.

Definitions.Name: Labyrinth Exploration
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Even though you are recommended by <bZurbi>, if you are not capable, I will have no choice but to turn you away.

Definitions.Name: Til We Meet

Needs.Description: Send a message to <bHoho> at <j(2142, 556)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Praise to the gods! My friend, <bHoho> managed to escape death after a deep cut from the katana of a <rSkeleton Warrior>. <n><t>I wanted to visit him but the horrific monsters at <pSkeleton Haven> are preventing me.<n><t>Please do me a favor and visit <bHoho> on my behalf.

Definitions.Name: Til We Meet
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thanks a lot! Most of my friends were terrified to visit me after I moved here.

Definitions.Name: Oriental Mentor

Needs.Description: Look for <bMaster Kerra> at <j(2664, 654)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Dear adventurer! I have been looking for my teacher, <b<bMas>ter Kerra>, for many years around Skeleton Haven but to no avail. Recently, I heard that she has moved to <pIcespire Haven>.<n><t>If you are going there, can you tell her that I have already acquired the "Heart of Will"?

Definitions.Name: Oriental Mentor
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for visiting me. Looks like my beloved student has finally graduated!

Definitions.Name: Occupation Change

Needs.Description: Visit <bDocter Chivo> at <j(630, 2091)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh dear! Can you help me out? My sister, <bDoctor - Chivo>, used to live in Shaitan city. Recently, she moved to <pChaldea Haven> but that place is so isolated, it does not even have a water source!<n><t>Can you visit her on my behalf?

Definitions.Name: Occupation Change
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Haha! My brother sure likes to poke his nose into everything. Actually, I enjoy living here in this place.

Definitions.Name: Thundoria Navy

Needs.Description: Meet up with <bMallack> in Thundoria Castle at <j(706, 1465)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I heard that <pThundoria Castle> is recruiting adventurers. There should be lots of tasks there for you to do.<n><t>I can recommend you to Guard Captain <bMallack> if you are interested.

Definitions.Name: Thundoria Navy
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hi, do you wish to stay here temporarily?<n><t>No problem! Just bear in mind not to break any rules.

Definitions.Name: Deep Deep Forest

Needs.Description: Visit <bOld Cuwen> at <j(529, 2458)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Deep forest of Ascaron, are many tribesmen. One of my friend, Old Cuwen, stays at the nearby <pSolace Haven>. He send letters to me often, asking me to visit him.<n><t>However, I cannot leave due to my busy work schedule. Can you pay him a visit on my behalf?

Definitions.Name: Deep Deep Forest
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for visiting. I cannot believe that Sonny still remember me after such a long time.

Definitions.Name: Honey Combs Heist
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>As the saying goes, nab the leader and you will get the rest. Killing those <rBarbaric Bee> will not help much but it's better than not doing anything about them at all.<n><t>Can you go to their lair and steal 5 <yBeehives>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hehe! My idea is useful, right?

Definitions.Name: Bee Eradication
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh my...These <rBarbaric Bees> are becoming wilder. I only passed by the flowerbed where they have been collecting their nectar when they started attacking me.<n><t>Now my face is swollen badly, it simply peeves me!<n><t>Can you please destroy 10 <rBarbaric Bees>? Teach these wild bees a lesson!<n><t>They can be found around <j(1623, 3139)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Haha! This should teach those <rBarbaric Bees> that I am not somebody to be trifle with!

Definitions.Name: Unsettling Dream
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ah, I am just about to look for you! For the past 2 days, I have been unable to sleep because of the sounds made by <rOwlie>. Every time I lie down on bed I would hear the "Hoot" of the <rOwlie>.<n><t>I am old and I needs sleep. This can't go on, please help me get rid of 10 <rOwlies>. They can be found at <j(1384, 3065)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you. I think I will be able to sleep peacefully from now on.

Definitions.Name: Scholar Owlie
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My eyes are must be seeing things...Yesterday I actually saw an <rOwlie> holding a book with its claw! It can't be that its reading the book? This is all too weird!<n><ts>orry to bother, but could you obtain 5 <yOwlie's Claws> and return  here? I wish to observe this strange occurence!<n><t>Usually, these <Owlies> appear around <j(1384, 3065)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hmm��? This talon is similar to talons of other owls. Strange��am I going nuts?

Definitions.Name: Cunning Owl
Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>orry, can you help me? I was reading a book two days back when an <rOwlie> flew pass and tore out a few pages of my book. I need these <yLost Pages> urgently.<n><t>Can you retrieve them back for me?<n><t>It should be lying around their nest itself.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Temptation of BBQ Tails
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is the biggest favour I have ever asked! You must promise me!<n><t>Really? You agreed? Then get me 5 <yShort Boar Tail>! I have been drooling over the notion of eating some <yShort Boar Tail> for a very long time!<n><t><rTusk Battle Boar> can be found at <j(1384, 3065)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh my! Thanks a lot! Hehe!.

Definitions.Name: Tusk Boar's Resistance
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I had a shock this morning when I opened the window, there were many <rTusk Battle Boar> running around my yard!<n><t>Look at these big sized beasts, running around in packs and spoiling everything in my yard! I can't take this lying down!<n><t>Please help me kill 10 <rTusk Battle Boars>! They can be found at <j(1384, 3065)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ha! Now my garden is free of those pesks. Thank you!

Definitions.Name: No More Odour!
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend! There is a weird scent around here, can you smell it? Oh, it must the scent of those <rAir Porky> nearby.<n><t>These pigs have become strange lately, they no longer emanate fragrant smell but instead gives off a weird odour, I think its best that we get rid of them now.<n><t>Can you please hunt and kill 10 <rAir Porky> for me? They can be found at <j(1414, 2896)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done!

Definitions.Name: Unusual Satchet
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I believe that the incidents where the <rTusk Battle Boar> became aggressive and the weird odour of the <rAir Porky> are closely related.<n><t>I still require more evidence to prove it. Help me collect 5 <yUnusual Satchets> from the <rAir Porky> so I can study it. <rAir Porky> can only be found at <j(1414, 2896)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I finally understand. Its this <yUnusual Satchet> that makes the nearby boars go wild!

Definitions.Name: Missing Gold Coin
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My friend, you should know me! I am always a honest merchant! However, <rBandits> have rob me of my <yGold Coin Pouch>!<n><t>I am no match for them! Could you help me get back my <yGold Coin Pouch> from their hideout?<n><t>I guess its hidden within one of their treasure chest.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are my saviour!<n><t>I wonder how am I going to survive without my pouch!

Definitions.Name: The Terrible Bandits
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend! Its time for you to show your skills! A group of menacing <rBandits> encrouches in the area nearby, robbing everyone of their money and goods!<n><t>Quickly capture 10 <rBandits> and bring them here to claim your reward!<n><t>Those outlaws can be found at <j(1043, 3066)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Woah! Nicely done! Here are your rewards!

Definitions.Name: Burning of Stramonium
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Rumor has it that <rStramonium> is a kind of flower that possess intelligence. They sway and dance in tune with the music played.<n><t>I don't believe such things exist as I never seen it before.<n><t>Can you please obtain 2 <yStramonium Sharp Spike> so that I can conduct my research on it. These weird plants are rumored to be found at <j(1414, 2896)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! With these, I will be able to carry on with my research.

Definitions.Name: Eradicate Stramonium
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The people of the Shepherd Plains regard the <rStramonium> as a demonic flower. Its branches are filled with thorns and it is able to move freely, quite an eerie sight.<n><t>I hope you are willing to destroy 20 <rStramoniums> so as to let the people here live in peace. It is rumored that these weird flowers are found at <j(1414, 2896)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done! The villagers are grateful to you!

Definitions.Name: The Contest
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend! You came at the right time! A new exciting competition is being held here!<n><t>You only need to defeat 10 <rRookie Boxeroos> to win prizes!<n><t>Now that we are short of manpower, can you proceed to the location alone? The competition  location is at <j(1117, 2923)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Woah! Nicely done! Here are your rewards!

Definitions.Name: Boxing Gloves
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Friend, can you lend me a hand?  Its my brother's birthday in the next few days and he wishes to have a <yBoxing Gloves> as a birthday present.<n><t>But I can't get it in such a rural place. There's no other choice, can you please snatch 1 <yBoxing Gloves> from <rRookie Boxeroo>.<n><t>Can you help me please? I heard these <rRookie Boxeroo> are having a boxing competition at <j(1117, 2923)>! This is a golden opportunity!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! It must have been hard on you to rob a <rRookie Boxeroo>.

Definitions.Name: Grass Tortoise's Tradegy
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I hate the <rMature Grass Tortoise>! Every time I see these slow lumbering creatures, I get very irritated.<n><t>They are generally a waste of time!<n><t>I would if I could help them walk faster! Woah, these creatures shouldn't even exist!<n><t>Go kill 10 <rMature Grass Tortoise> now! Those creatures have been crawling around for half a century already but are still at <j(1198, 3116)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This feels great! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Stealing Tortoise Eggs
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend, let me tell you a secret! The price of <rMature Grass Tortoise> is very high in the current market now!<n><t>However, I can't handle these large monsters myself.<n><t>Can you please go to where <rMature Grass Tortoise> lay their eggs and steal 10 <yTortoise Egg>.<n><t>When the money arrives, I will share half of it with you, how about it? It is said they can be found at <j(1198, 3116)>.<n><t>(Search carefully when you are at the area of the mature grass tortoise, you should be able to find their nest within those bushes, the eggs are inside the nest.)
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Haha! I will make a fortune with these! I will not forget your help.

Definitions.Name: Smuggle Tortoise Shells
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>For the past few days, I been using <yTortoise Egg> from the <rMature Grass Tortoise> to raise many grass tortoise and then selling them for a high price.<n><t>Now, turtle shells are becoming the market hottest commodity.<n><t>Can you please collect 5 <yWell-Formed Tortoise Shells> for me? I will prepare to smuggle them to <pIcicle City>.<n><t>These guys move really slow and I think they can be found at <j(1198, 3116)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are very efficient! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: A Terrible Curse
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hehe, my friend, let me tell you a secret. Recently I have learnt a new kind of curse and I am going to use it on my enemy <bKentaro>.<n><t>However, I am still lacking some <yRazor Sharp Tusks>. Can you get 10 <yRazor Sharp Tusks> from the <rMad Boar> for me so that I can finish this curse!<n><t>These <rMad Boar> can be found at <j(910, 2971)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thunder! Fire! Hulala! Haha! I finally completed the curse! You are doomed, <bKentaro>!

Definitions.Name: Boar Independence Day
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ah! I simply hate these <rMad Boars>! These boars are organising some independence day activity! <n><t>To commerate their escape from the slaugterhouse, groups of them have been marching around in the streets!<n><t>Can you please go kill 10 <rMad Boar> so we can have some peace around here!<t>They are gathering at <j(910,2971)> at this very moment!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The world is a better place to be in now! Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Boar Challenge
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi, have you just arrived here? Don't you wish to display your strength to the people here?<n><t>I have a way for you to prove your valor to the villagers.<n><t>Kill 5 <rMad Boars> at <j(911, 2973)> that has been plaguing our village.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done, my friend!

Definitions.Name: Expensive Herbs
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, my friend, I lost several expensive herbs while on the way here.<n><t>These herbs were meant to replace the shortages in the warehouse.<n><t>But now I have nothing to show for!<n><t>Please take a pity on me and go to the plains where <rGrassland Elk> resides and pick 6 <yPrecious Herbs> for me. Wheres the plains?...I remembered!<n><t>It is just nearby at <j(1360, 2683)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for your kindness! I will remember it always!

Definitions.Name: Secret of the Grassland Elk
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I don't get it, why does the <rGrassland Elk> here run so fast and their reaction is so agile?<n><t>Please go and collect 5 <yRigid Deer Hoofs> for me as I wish to see whats the difference between it and the other elks. These springly animals seems to be living at <j(1360, 2683)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I cannot see any differences. They look just like any other hoofs��

Definitions.Name: Deer Skin Coat
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend, to be honest, I was once a pirate before. I only escaped here because I was defeated by the <rJack Black>'s pirate crew!<n><t>I wish to wear a suit made of <yTop Grade Deer Skin> so I believe you will help me get 5 <yTop Grade Deer Skin>.<n><t>Why not? Because if you refuse to, I am going to give you a lesson you will never forget!<n><t>Go now to <j(1360, 2683)> and get the deer skin from <rGrassland Elk>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hehe! You are skillful indeed! Well done!

Definitions.Name: White Owlie
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I hate those <rWhite Owlies>! They are making loads of noise during the day, giving me a big headache!<n><t>I will go crazy if this continues! If you don't mind, help me kill 5 <rWhite Owlies> and let me have a quiet time for a few days. Those evil creatures can be found near <j(1360, 2683)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you very much! I can lead back my peaceful life again.

Definitions.Name: Revenge
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, I am glad you came, I have a favour to ask of you! I lost a batch of expensive herbs but do you know why? It because of those <rWhite Owlies> who using their <ySharp Beak> to tear open the luggages, taking the medicine back to their nest!<n><t>To exact revenge on these <rWhite Owlie>, please kill them for me and remove their <ySharp Beak> and return it to me!<n><t>Their nest seems to be at <j(1360, 2683)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hahaha! Now I am satisfied!

Definitions.Name: Pursue of the Wolf
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rGrassland Wolf> are fearsome animals, I have never seen anything more threatening to the safety of human than them!<n><t>I am requesting you to kill 5 <rGrassland Wolves> so as to drive away the wolves packs and make this a safe place!<n><t>It seems that the wolve packs are gathered at <j(1143, 2705)>.<n><t>Remember, don't not get surrounded by them as these wolves attack in packs.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Woah! Nicely done!

Definitions.Name: Cruel Massacre
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I told you before I was a evil pirate! Now im still as cruel as before.<n><t>I have taken a dislike to <rGrassland Wolf>. I want you to kill these wolves and retrieve 5 <ySwift Wolve Claws> for me to decorate my room, haha!<n><t>It is said that these wolves pack can be found at <j(1143, 2705)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hmm��This fits nicely into my room! Heh!

Definitions.Name: Boxing Trouble
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Wait a moment! Can you help me? While I was walking home from work last night, I was attacked by a bunch of <rBerserk Boxeroos>!<n><t>They will attack anybody aimlessly. Please put a stop to them by hunting 5 <rBerserk Boxeroos> at <j(1161, 2639)> please.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! Thank you very much!

Definitions.Name: Lucky Magical Stone
Definitions.BeginTalk: <tss>hh, this is a secret between me and you, I don't wish for a third party to know!<n><t>Where the <rBerserk Boxeroo> resides lies a miraculous <yLucky Magical Stone>, it is said to be a very powerful talisman capable of protecting the wearer.<n><t>Go quietly and retrieve 3 <yLucky Magical Stones> and pass it to me. I think the stones can be found at <j(1161, 2639)>. Search carefully among the bushes.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! So these are the <yLucky Magical Stone>! Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Investigation of Slowpoke Snail
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am surprised that even though <rSlowpoke Snails> move very slowly, they are still able to avoid danger all the time.<n><t>Do they have radar on their body or some kind of sensor? Could you collect 5 <yShort Snail Feelers> from <j(1227, 2742)> for me to investigate?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! I see! The <yShort Snail Feeler> itself acts as a radar for the snail!

Definitions.Name: The Slowpoke Snails
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I hate <rSlowpoke Snails>!<n><t>They are so SLOW! Time is so precious for a busy merchant like me yet they are practically wasting precious time!<n><t>They should not exist in this world!<n><t>Kill 10 <rSlowpoke Snails> at <j(1227, 2742)> for me and I will reward you greatly!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This feels great! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Fallen
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Everything in this world is a gift from Goddess Kara. But, these people have turned their back on her teachings, ignoring the spritual energies and focusing only on technology.<n><t>I have decided to use the power of curse to punish those who have sinned against the Goddess's ideals even though this will lead me to fall away from the path.<n><t>Friend, please obtain 5 <yStrange Candles> from the Mud Monster to help me finish the last rites. These weird monsters can be found at <j(934, 2747)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for all that you have done for me!

Definitions.Name: Song of the Stinging Beak
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend, listen up, I have a cruel but rewarding job for you.<n><t>An unamed person from a rich and powerful owns a <rStinging Beak>. He does not wish to see any <rStinging Beak> other than the one in his cage so he ordered the destruction of the others.<n><t>You only need to kill 10 of them and you will be rewarded greatly. <rStinging Beaks> can be found at <j(935, 2687)>!<n><t>How about it, are you willing to take this job?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Very good! This is your reward. I will look for you again if there are anymore tasks for you.

Definitions.Name: Mysterious Cape
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I wish to make a mantle out of pure feathers! Hey, this idea ain't too bad after all!<n><t>I was once a pirate and everything that I need was done by my followers, so I won't have to go and collect these feathers myself.<n><t>Although you might be clumsy, I will let it pass so go and collect for me 5 <yGlossy Feathers>.<n><t>You can start looking for it at <j(935, 2687)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Yeah! I got a new mantle to wear now!

Definitions.Name: Trading Fake Gems
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Frankly speaking, most merchants are not honest and neither am I.<n><t>Recently someone tried to order some crystallized egg from the boars.<n><t>However, I do not have the means to obtain such an item.<n><t>Can you please get me 3 <yFearsome Tortoise Egg Shell>.<n><t>I will add some finishing touches to them and sell these fakes to the ignorant customer, haha! <n><t>These tortoise can be found at <j(969, 2587)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hoho! This is your share of reward! Please keep this a secret.

Definitions.Name: Emerald Fog
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The weather is too hot for me and ulcers are growing all over in my mouth. I can't even eat properly, its really irritating.<n><t>Please obtain 5 <yGreen Moss> from the <rThickskin Lizard>, from which I will apply on the ulcers for relief. They can found at <j(732, 2697)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I am feeling much better now.

Definitions.Name: Search for Velvet Stone
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My friend <bMas> is a very cultured person, recently he has been trying to renovate his suite at <pIcicle City>.<n><t>However, the temperature at <pIcicle City> is chilling and he is unable to find what he needs.<n><t>I think the <ySlippery Rock> from the <rRock Golem> may suit his needs so can you get for me 5 <ySlippery Rocks> from the <rRock Golems>? It is said that these fearsome creatures appear at <j(682, 2592)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>These should be the rocks <bMarcusa> is looking for!

Definitions.Name: Weird Collector
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This world is filled up all kinds of people.<n><t>I know a guy named <bChang> who is a collector of body parts.<n><t>He likes to collect all kinds of body parts.<n><t>This time round, he wants me to find 5 <yLong Lizard Tongue>.<n><t>Where can I find it! My friend, can you go instead and help me get 5 <yLong Lizard Tongue>? I heard from others that these tongues can be found at <j(892, 3273)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Now everything is completed. Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Playful Lizard
Definitions.BeginTalk: My friend! I can no longer stand those <rHopping Lizards>. They are urinating all over the desert and making the place stink!<n><t>Can you kill 10 <rHopping Lizards> for me? Those dirty creatures can be found near <j(892, 3273)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! Thank you so much!

Definitions.Name: Hopping Lizard Secretion
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I discovered that the weird smells from the desert are from the <rHopping Lizard>. However it is not their droppings that emitted the odour.<n><t>Currently as of now, I still do not understand the entire issue, can you please go to where the <rHopping Lizard> appears and get me 5 bottles of <yHopping Lizard Secretion> so that I can study it.<n><t>They can be found at <j(892,3273)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh my! It's the mating season for <rHopping Lizard>. That explains the smell.

Definitions.Name: Expel the Wolves
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am terrified of <rWolf Cubs>, they often appear in packs in the desert and that leaves me shivering with fear.<n><t>Can you please think of a way to reduce the <rWolf Cubs> population? Try killing 10 <rWolf Cubs>.<n><t>Heh, lets just do it this way, so will you help me hunt 10 <rWolf Cubs>! They usually appear at <j(687, 3093)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you so much! Reducing their population will make traveling safer.

Definitions.Name: Wolves Massacre
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ah, I have a friend <bChang> who is willing to spend large amounts of money to collect weird body parts. He self proclaims as a living arts collector, something which I don't agree with.<n><t>This time round he is paying a high price for 5 <yWolf Cub Claws> from <rWolf Cub>. What a cruel job!<n><t>I can't bring myself to do this. However, he is paying a very high price for it so if you are interested, I will hand over the job to you.<n><t>These pitiful animals can be found at <j(687, 3093)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Have you done so already? Here is your much deserved reward.

Definitions.Name: Clearance of Killer Cactus
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Abomination! This is definitely an abomination.<n><t>As a merchant I travel a lot, when I first arrived here I saw so many walking <rKiller Cactus>.<n><t>This is too weird! I can't believe that plants can actually walk! Oh my god, please kill 10 <rKiller Cactus> so that I can have a peace of mind.<n><t>They can be found at <j(884, 3156)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I feel so much better!

Definitions.Name: Bitter Medication
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The dry air of the desert makes people uncomfortable. I do have a secret recipe that when used, it can make travellers feel a tad bit better.<n><t>However this remedy requires <yLarge Cactus Tuber> from <rKiller Cactus>.<n><t>I don't have the capability to defeat these monsters so can you please obtain 5 <yLarge Cactus Tubers> for me? These monsters are often found at <j(884, 3156)> frolicking under the sun.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! Now we can help those tourists!

Definitions.Name: Cactus Water Pouch
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, look what I discovered! The secret of <rKiller Cactus>'s ability to survive in the desert without drinking for long periods of time!<n><t>It because they have a <yCactus Water Pouch> which has very good elastcity to contain water which helps the <rKiller Cactus> through the periods of dry spells.<n><t>However i don't fully understand the materials which the bag is made of, can you help me get 5 <yCactus Water Pouch> back? <rKiller Cactus> can be found at <j(884,3156)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This research might be useful to mankind!

Definitions.Name: Rolling Melons
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I wonder who planted so many <rGigantic Melons>. Now hat they are overrunning the desert, what a sight for sore eyes.<n><t>Can you please get rid of 10 <rGigantic Melons> at <j(687, 3093)>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! You are skillful indeed!

Definitions.Name: Bitter Fruit
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The <yBitter Fruit> from <rGigantic Melons> is bitter and extremely juicy.<n><t>Recently, using bitter fruit as a beverage seems to be the current trend for youngsters.<n><t> Everything I put up is sold immediately and I have run out of stock. Can you please get me 5 <yBitter Fruits>?<n><t>You can get them from the <rGigantic Melons> at <j(687, 3093)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! These are your rewards!

Definitions.Name: Legend of Phantom Tree
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Rumor has it that <rPhantom Tree> symbolizes impending doom.<n><t>Although it might not be true, these <rPhantom Trees> still reek of evil. Please chop down 10 <rPhantom Trees> at <j(885, 3027)> and put the villagers to ease.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done!

Definitions.Name: Treant Holiday
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>When the roots of the <rPhantom Tree> is near a water source, it will expand and absorb all of the water it can hold, so the tree can survive in the desert. I am curious about this ability.<n><t>Can you find 5 <yPhantom Tree Roots> for my research? They normally grow at <j(885, 3027)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This Phantom Tree Root is too complicated! I cannot analyze it!

Definitions.Name: Unparallel Evil
Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>ob��sob��I am only a helpless woman. Yet <rSand Brigands> robbed me of my family treasure.<n><t>That <yJade Bangle> is a gift from my deceased grandma. Please get it back for me! It's very important to me! They have an encampment at <j(716, 3290)>.<n><t>It might be hidden inside one of their barrel.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh dear! I don't know how I can ever repay you!

Definitions.Name: Flush out the Bandits
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rSand Brigands> are getting out of hand nowadays. Not only did they rob merchants, they also robbed helpless women and children.<n><t>The villagers have come up with a reward to get rid of them. Will you help us to hunt down 10 <rSand Brigands> at <j(716, 3290)>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Great! Here is your reward.

Definitions.Name: Vicious Hungry Wolves
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am recruiting warriors to fight against <rStarving Wolves>.<n><t>They are keeping travelers away!<n><t>If you can kill 10 <rStarving Wolves> at <j(718, 2938)>, I will reward you accordingly.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Great! This is your reward.

Definitions.Name: Rebellion of Sandy Tortoise
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I don't know what happened to the <rSandy Tortoises>, they are on a rampage and are attacking anything they see!<n><t>Can you help me kill 10 <rSandy Tortoises> at <j(1197, 3270)>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done!

Definitions.Name: Moving Garden
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rSandy Tortoise> is a slow but huge creature. Their hard shells provide a shelter for many plants in this desert.<n><t>I need a type of seed that can be found in the shell. Can you collect 5 <yDesert Seeds> from <j(1197, 3270)> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ya! These are the seeds I am looking for!

Definitions.Name: Preparation
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am preparing to send a caravan to <pArgent City> for trade.<n><t>However, I have to get pass a Sand Bandit camp midway. I am afraid that they might rob me.<n><t>Can you get rid of 10 <rSand Bandits> at <j(1339, 3300)> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! Now I can get to Argent City safely to do some trading.

Definitions.Name: Mushroom Soup
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ah...Everytime I see these <rSandy Shrooms> jumping around, my mind will instinctively conjure up an image of boiling mushroom soup!<n><t>I love that thick sweet smelling aroma of that soup! Please go and obtain 5 <yUmbrella Mushrooms> from the <rSandy Shrooms> and let me have a taste!<n><t><rSandy Shrooms> can be found at <j(1334, 3438)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Cream of mushroom soup made from <yUmbrella Mushrooms> is delicious!

Definitions.Name: The Runaway Shroom
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I love doing my own gardening.<n><t>For the past 2 days, while I was strolling in my gardens, I felt that something was missing.<n><t>Then I realised it was my <rSandy Shrooms>! I have no idea where they ran to but I can't have my garden without any Sandy Shrooms!<n><t>Can you please go to where the <rSandy Shrooms> are and get me 5 <yDesert Spore>? These <rSandy Shrooms> are usually found at <j(1334, 3438)>.<n><t>These spores are rather easy to find. Look for the white patches within the bushes.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great!<n><ts>oon I will have <rSandy Shrooms> in my garden again!

Definitions.Name: Magical Usage for Mud
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, my friend, you come at the right time! The desert's yearly mud slinging contest is about to start, please help me aquire 5 <yPolluted Mud> from the <rMudman> at <j(1438, 3414)>.The result of the mud contest means a lot to me for this is most important event in the desert!<n><t>I will definitely prepare enough mud for battle.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Goddess bless you!

Definitions.Name: Mudman Sleepy Head
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Grr, my whole body is full of mud, all because of <rMudman>'s range attacks!<n><t>These despicable <rMudman> not only occupied the limited water sources in the desert, they also abuse their status and power, attacking anyone who comes close to the water source.<n><ts>uch corrupted beings! Will you go and teach these Mudman a lesson? Hunt 10 <rMudman> at <j(1438, 3413)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done!

Definitions.Name: Dangerous Raiders
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The <rSand Raiders> have ruled the desert for many years and have yet to meet someone of their match.<n><t>I plead with you, my brave warrior! Remove this threat for us! Defeat 10 <rSand Raiders> at <j(1027, 3011)> please!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Brave adventurer! Welcome back!

Definitions.Name: Spider Clearance
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh no! While I was playing along the beach just now, a huge <rMan Eating Spider> came crawling towards me!<n><t>Please save me from them and defeat 10 <rMan Eating Spiders> at <j(1093, 2948)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are great! Even such a huge <rMan Eating Spider> is not your match!

Definitions.Name: Walking Wolf
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am curious why the <rFeral Wolf> at <j(1473, 3295)> can move on two legs like a human. Also, their fur is red.<n><t>I believed they are an evolved species. Can you help me find <y5 Huge Wolf Claws> for my research?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ah��I still cannot find the reason behind the change!

Definitions.Name: Golden Spider
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Dear friend! You've come at the right moment! <rMan Eating Spiders> snatched away my <yGold Pouch>!<n><t>It seems that they have a love for gold. Please help me retrieve my <yGold Pouch> from them!<n><t>They must have hide the pouch in the money box near <j(1093, 2948)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>At last, I've gotten back my stolen Gold Pouch! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Master Key
Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>hh! Please be quiet about this.<n><t>My friend is going to elope with Nana due to her parents disapproval of their marriage.<n><t>I wish to give them my blessings with a gift. I believe that some Master Keys will be handy in their escape. Please help me find 2 <yMaster Keys> from <rCavalier> at <j(1255, 2974)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you my friend!

Definitions.Name: Capture the Head
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>As the saying goes, nab the leader and you will get the rest.<n><t>Arresting those <rSand Bandits> will not help much. However, if you nab the <rSand Bandit Leader> at <j(1170, 3026)>, it will throw the rest of them into confusion disarray!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hehe! My idea is useful, right?

Definitions.Name: Challenge Cavalier
Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>and Raiders are feared in the desert. However, <rCavaliers> are much more ferocious than them.<n><t>Prove your valor by defeating 10 <rCavaliers> at <j(1255, 2974)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It must has been tough for you. Well done nevertheless!

Definitions.Name: Lizard Crown
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although I hate people who wear clothes made from the skin of <rLizard King>, I need to find myself 10 <yLizard Crowns> as the market has a demand for them now. Will you help me?<n><t>Those lizards can be found at <j(1507, 2970)>. However the drop rate are quite low so you might need more patient.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! This is your share of profit!

Definitions.Name: Sailer Cap
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey! Hold on for a moment! Can you lend me hand? Yesterday I saw a cute and cuddly <rSailor Penguin> nearby. I fell in love with its <ySailor Penguin Cap> and I have been thinking about it ever since!<n><t>Can you please get me 2 <ySailor Penguin Caps> from <rSailor Penguins> at <j(995, 365)>. I really love that cap!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh my! This is cute! Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Heart of Naiad
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rNaiad> is a peaceful creature. It does not disturb travelers nor like to be disturbed.<n><t>The <yHeart of Naiad> can bring serenity to anyone who possesses it. Can you bring 2 <yHearts of Naiad> to me?<n><t>Naiad often resides near <j(1079, 518)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you. This is the <yHeart of Naiad > I am looking for.

Definitions.Name: Perfect Crystal
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Crystal dug from mine often have flaws on them. However, <rNaiad> is able to form a <yFlawless Crystal>. These <yFlawless Crystals> are high in demand in the black market.<n><t>Can you get 5 <yFlawless Crystals> for me? I pay dearly for them!<n><t><rNaiad> can be found near <j(1079, 518)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Look at the glow of these <yFlawless Crystals>!

Definitions.Name: Suffering of Elk
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have a strange habit. I love to listen to the groans of <rElk> in suffering. The more they groan, the happier I will be.<n><t>I will reward you greatly to kill 10 <rElks> at <j(885, 333)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good work! This is your reward.

Definitions.Name: Overweight
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I will not let you hurt those Horned Penguins if I can help it.<n><t>But they have been a pest to the villagers around here. They always sneak into kitchens and steal the food there.<n><t>Please kill 10 Horned Penguins at <j(885, 333)> as a warning to them.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I believed that the Horned Penguins will be careful of whom they steal from next time.

Definitions.Name: Think Too Much
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There is a legend on this frozen land which speaks of hanging 2 <ySquirt Handkerchiefs> by the window and within 2 years, the person you missed most will return to your side.<n><t>Due to objections by my family, I have not met my love for a long time.<n><t>Can you help me get 2 <ySquirt Handkerchiefs> so that I can wait for the day that my love returns to me? You can search for them at <j(738, 426)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I will hang them on my window right away!

Definitions.Name: Troublesome Bat
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rSnowy Bats> nearby have been emitting a ultrasonic sound wave. These sound waves make lots noises causing the nearby <rSnowmen> to go berserk. For the safety of the village, we have to get rid of 10 <rSnowy Bats>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Its for our own protection that we have to resort to this.

Definitions.Name: Witchcraft Ingredient
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have been trying to master a spell that allow me to see the future.<n><t>However, I still lack of ingredients. Can you get 5 <yBat Fangs> at <j(743, 358)> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Now, everything is completed.

Definitions.Name: Polution of Squity
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The <rSailor Squidys> are getting out of hand! They keep polluting our water supply with their ink! How are we supposed to drink from the lake when the water has turned black with their ink!<n><t>Can you get rid of 10 <rSailor Squidy> at <j(657, 411)> please?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I think it worked out in the end.<n><t>Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Squidy Cap
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You can say that I am a greedy person. I still want <ySquidy Caps> even after you have given me those <ySailor Penguin Caps>.<n><t>They just look so cute! Please help me again by finding 2 more <ySquidy Caps> at <j(657, 411)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! This <ySquidy Cap > is so cute!

Definitions.Name: Clearance of Shrooms
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I hate all type of Shrooms! I will cook all of them if given the chance!<n><t>There is a bunch of these pesky Shrooms nearby at <j(952, 550)>. Can you get rid of 10 <rSnowy Shrooms> for me please?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I feel better now.

Definitions.Name: Snowy Mushroom
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My appetite is not so good as I am getting old. Therefore, I am unable to take anything oily or I'll fall ill.<n><t>Can you get 5 <ySnowy Mushrooms> at <j(952, 550)> for me to cook a nutritious meal?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh this taste good! You should try it too!

Definitions.Name: Slow Slow Snail!
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rSnowy Snails> are so slow yet they always like to move infront of me. They almost make an old person like me tripped for a few occasion.<n><t>Can you kill 10 <rSnowy Snails> at <j(657, 334)> for me please?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! This time round there will not be any <rSnowy Snails> blocking the way!

Definitions.Name: Flowery Stone
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Beneath the shell of <rSnowy Snail> lies a very rare <yFlowery Stone>.<n><t>It is a magical stone that Goddess Kara created to allow human to understand the language of flowers.<n><t>Can you get 5 <yFlowery Stones> for my research? Those snails appears near <j(657, 334)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I can continue the research once more!

Definitions.Name: Snail Feeler
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The deep forest is so big, yet the weird collector, <bChang>, requested me to look for <yFrozen Snail Feelers>.<n><t>It's like looking for a needle in a haystack! Can you help me look for 5 <yFrozen Snail Feelers>?<n><t>The snails might appear near <j(657, 334)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Now everything is completed. Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Search for Snowy Heart
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Wait please! My nephew has contracted a strange illness recently and is dying. Only the <yGlacier Heart> from a <rNaive Snow Doll> at <j(1055, 738)> can save him.<n><t>Please be so kind and get me 5 <yGlacier Hearts>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh you are back! Thanks a lot!

Definitions.Name: Naive Snow Doll
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It is rumored that <rNaive Snow Doll> can summon the evil <rSnow Lady> to bring disaster.<n><t>Even though there is no truth to this, it is better to be safe.<n><t>Can you kill 10 <rNaive Snow Dolls> around this village at <j(1055, 738)>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! You are very trustworthy. I will look for you again.

Definitions.Name: Cavern Little Bears
Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>cientifically speaking, animals like bears usually hibernate during extreme cold temperature. However, as <rSnowy Bear Cub> has been living in such cold temperature for many years, they have slowly evolved to the point where by they don't need to hibernate anymore.<n><t>This evolution have brought much problems to those who are placed in charge to look after the forest such as us. We were attacked by these agressive <rSnowy Bear Cub> whenever we patrol the forest.<n><t>Can you help us solve the problem by killing 10 <rSnowy Bear Cub> at <j(958, 661)>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I never knew you are so skillful!

Definitions.Name: Snow Tears
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I came from the desert looking for the <rSnow Lady>. It is said that they look like the Goddess Kara. I wish to see one but I can't find any trails leading to them.<n><t>Can you find me 5 <yPerfect Snowflakes> to prove that they existed?<n><t>It is rumored that they appeared near <j(873, 646)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <ts>o this is the legendary <yPerfect Snowflake>. Its so beautiful!

Definitions.Name: Snow Crystal
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend, have you heard the latest news? Now the most profitable item on the black market is <ySnowy Crystal> used by <rSnow Lady>to create snowstorms! I know stealing from <rSnow Lady> isn't a good thing. However, money matters more than anything else!<n><t>I am offering a high price for you to go <j(873, 646)> to steal 5 <ySnowy Crystals> from the <rSnow Lady>. Are you willing to go? (The crystals are within the forest where the snow lady appears, pick it up immediately if you see one!)
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are great even though you are not that experienced!

Definitions.Name: Wailing Snow Lady
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Its good that you are here! Have you seen the <rSnow Ladies> nearby? They are so dangerous!<n><t>When they gets angry, they may even summon a snow storm upon this land!<n><t>Please get rid of these menace by killing 10 <ySnow Ladies>! They are near <j(873, 646)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It has been hard on you. Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Punish the Wolves
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Help! I have been chased by a pack of <rSnowy Wolves>! This is so scary!<n><t>Please save me by killing 10 <rSnowy Wolves> at <j(965, 775)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh, thank you! You are my saviour!

Definitions.Name: Nutritious Tortoise
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You've come at the right time my friend!<n><t>I feel like eating Herbal Jelly recently but they can only be found on Battle Tortoises at <j(891, 750)>.<n><t>I am no match for them anyway. Can you help me get 5 Herbal Jelly back?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Yummy! This is the how good Herbal Jelly should taste like.

Definitions.Name: Long Nose Tortoise
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My friend! I have just seen a fearsome creature loitering around here.<n><t>They look like tortoises yet have a elephant tusk on their back. I heard from the native here that they are called <rBattle Tortoises>.<n><t>Can you kill 10 Battle Tortoises at <j(891, 75)> to curb my fear?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are a trustworthy person! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Brute Crabby
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh my god! A bunch of wild <rArmored Crabs> have robbed me of my goods!<n><t>How dare they! Can you help me teach them a lesson?<n><t>Kill 10 <rArmored Crabs> at <j(994, 857)> as a warning to them please!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hoho! Now those <rArmored Crab> will fear us.

Definitions.Name: Crab Egg Sauce
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> When I moved to this chilling place, I was hoping to eat some fantastic egg sauce.<n><t>I heard that <yArmored Crab Eggs> make a great sauce. Please get 5 <yArmored Crab Eggs> for me. Their lair is at <j(994, 857)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! You are such a nice person!

Definitions.Name: Gourmet Critic
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>As the <rNorthern Snail> stay on this iceland, when it die the meat will be frozen forming into <yFrozen Conch Meat>. It is actually a very delicious dish that I wish to eat. <n><t>Can you get 5 pieces of <yFrozen Conch Meat> near <j(802, 750)> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! This is just what I needed!

Definitions.Name: Collect Heart of Purity
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey friend, can I have some of your time? My friend is becoming interested with mythical beings, he asked me to collect 5 Heart of Purity from the Snow Spirit. Can you go and help me collect 5 of it?<n><t>You can find the Heart of Purity from the <rSnow Spirit> at <j(1060, 805)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! Nowadays people are no longer as helpful as you.

Definitions.Name: Buggy Snow Doll
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rFragile Snow Dolls> are constantly posing a threat to the villagers.<n><t>Can you kill 10 <rFragile Snow Dolls> at <j(908, 842)> for us?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Heh! You have done well. We will work together again in the future.

Definitions.Name: Primal Snowman
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi! Want to prove your valor? Now there is a chance! Villagers are terrified of the huge <rYetis> nearby.<n><t>Kill 10 <rYetis> at <j(1495, 667)> to prove your courage!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Heh! You have done well. We will work together again in the future.

Definitions.Name: Lost Mystery
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There have been a lot of missing cases near <pIcicle City> and I suspect that it has something to do with the <rYetis> at <j(1495, 667)>.<n><t>Can you help me collect 5 <rYeti Nails> for my investigation?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <ts>trange��these bloodstains does not belong to a human��

Definitions.Name: Win Win Pig!
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Ouch!Ouch! Those cuts on my face are caused by <rCombat Piglets>.<n><t>They get aggressive over anybody with a weapon. Please put a stop to these by killing 10 <rCombat Piglets> at <j(1453, 560)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Nicely done! This is my reward for you!

Definitions.Name: Playful Snow Doll
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am the chairman of <pIcicle city> and have to take responsibility for the safety of travelers.<n><t>Recently, <rPlayful Snow Dolls> have been attacking anybody they see.<n><t>Please kill 10 <rPlayful Snow Dolls> at <j(1746, 530)> to make our road safe once more!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Now the road is safe without these <rPlayful Snow Dolls>.

Definitions.Name: Soul Gem
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The amount missing cases is increasing! We need to do something! People seems to disappear near places where <rPlayful Snow Dolls> appeared.<n><t>Can you get 5 <ySoul Gems> from the <rPlayful Snow Dolls> at <j(1746, 530)> for my investigation?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh my god! So those missing people are being sucked into these <rSoul Gems>!<n><t>I need to warn the city!

Definitions.Name: Slaughter of Innocent
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I want you to kill 10 <rBattle Tortoises> for me! No special reasons! I just don't like the looks of them.<n><t>I will reward you greatly.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done. This is your reward.

Definitions.Name: Unhealing Wound
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have been attacked by <rSkeletal Warriors> recently. Even though my wounds are not deep, it hurts greatly in this chilling place.<n><t>I heard that <yHeated Tortoise Shell> from <rSnowy Tortoise> at <j(2165, 462)> is effective in curing this kind of wounds. Please get 5 <yHeated Tortoise Shells> for me please!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Thank you! Now I feel much better.

Definitions.Name: Fallen Lamb
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey, have you seen those <rCrazy Sheeps>? I heard that they were mutated animals totally different from that created by the female goddess Kara!<n><t>They can be taken as the embodiment of evil.<n><t>My friend, if you believe in Goddess Kara, please help to destroy 10 <rCrazy sheeps>, they can be found at <j(226, 590)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thanks for your help!

Definitions.Name: Scorpion Poison
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi! You have come at the right time! My girlfriend, <bNana> has fallen into a coma after getting stung by a <rFerocious Scorpion> at <j(2370, 548)>.<n><t>I need 5 vials of <yScorpion Blood> to revive her but I cannot leave as I need to look after her. Can you help me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! <yScorpion Blood > is effective! Nana has awakened!

Definitions.Name: Pioneer
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi! You have come at the right time!<n><t>I plan to bring my girlfriend, <bNana> to <pIcicle City> for a holiday. However, our route has been blocked by a bunch of ferocious <rPolar Bears>.<n><t>Can you kill 10 <rPolar Bears> at <j(1981, 530)> for us? 189=<t>You must kill 10 <rPlayful Snow Dolls>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I can go on my vacation now!

Definitions.Name: Phantom Sword
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Hi! Do you know why these <rSnowy Tusk Boars> are always roaming around <j(2269, 590)>? It is because they are the guardians of a legendary weapon, the <yPhantom Sword>.<n><t>I am very interested in this sword. Please get it for me!<n><t>It should be stuck inside a rock.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Woah! This is an amazing sword!

Definitions.Name: Warrior Soul
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Maybe its because I can see things that normal people can't, I often hear wails from the spirits of the <rUndead Warriors>.<n><t>Thsee sound of suffering comes from the souls trapped in the body of those <rSkeletal Warriors>.<n><t>By destroying their skeletal body forms, we will be able to free their souls.<n><t>My friend, are you willing to help me? Kill 10 <rSkeletal Warriors> at <j(2269 ,470)> to save their souls.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I am sure that those <rSkeletal Warriors> will thank you for their release.

Definitions.Name: Vampiric Monster
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>In the <pSilver Mine>, there is a creature that lives off blood of human. They are the <rVampire Bats>.<n><t>The miners are terrified of them. Can you do us a favor by killing 10 <rVampire Bats> in Silver Mine 2 so that we could mine in peace?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for your help!

Definitions.Name: Miner Mole Safety Helmet
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><bLulu> and me want to go to the <pSilver Mine> to have fun.<n><t>However, both of us do not have any safety helmets so the worker refused to let us in.<n><t>Can you please go to Silver Mine 2 and get us 2 <yMiner Mole Safety Helmets> from those <rMiner Moles>? Help us please, we really want to go inside <pSilver Mine> to play!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! I can play with <bLulu> now!

Definitions.Name: Weird Mud
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It was such a shock! I was attacked by a mould of mud as I was entering <pAbandoned Mine>. My God, I never knew even mud has a life of their own!<n><t>Can you please collect 5 <ySticky Mud Cakes> from them as I wish to study it. These weird creatures can be found at <j(934, 2747)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh dear! These <rMud Monster> have such complicated internal!

Definitions.Name: Revenge of the Mud
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I went to <pSilver Mine> to dig for stones.<n><t>Out of nowhere, a <rMud Monster> appeared and flung mud on my new shirt.<n><t>Argh, I can't take it! Can you kill 10 <rMud Monsters> at <j(934, 2747)> as a revenge for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you! Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Miner Mole
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>When I am exploring <pAbandoned Mine>, some <rMiner Moles> attacked me suddenly! Their razor sharp claws wounded me deeply.<n><t>Can you take a revenge for me by getting rid of those <rMiner Moles>? Please kill 10 <rMiner Moles>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you. I feel so much happier!

Definitions.Name: Ninja Sword
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rNinja Mole> uses a very unique weapon. They called it the <yNinja Sword>.<n><t>It is a highly accurate and damaging weapon which I am very interested in.<n><t>Can you go to <pAbandoned Mine 2> and get 10 <yNinja Swords> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh! Thank you! I love this <yNinja Sword >!

Definitions.Name: Test

Needs.Description: Help <bSimon Gilter> at <j(646, 2088)> to get rid of 5 <rTribal Warriors>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>ince this is your first time to Chaldea, I am sure that you are looking around for a challenge.<n><t>Why don't you kill 5 <rTribal Warriors> to prove your valor? They are at the southeast of this Haven.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Good! At least you are not a coward.

Definitions.Name: Test

Needs.Description: Help <bSimon Gilter> at <j(646, 2088)> to get rid of 30 <rTribal Warriors>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Killing 5 <rTribal Warriors> is easy. Can you kill 30 <rTribal Warriors>?<n><t>You can reject if you are afraid.
Definitions.ResultTalk: You are great! This is the reward you deserve!

Definitions.Name: Hidden Agenda

Needs.Description: Bring back 12 <yTribal Shields> for <bSimon Gilter> at <j(646, 2088)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Good! Good! I can see your potiential from the previous tasks that I've entrust you to. I believe that you have also collected some <yTribal Shields> as well.<n><t>Are you willing to give me 12 <yTribal Shields> for my collection?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh my! This is so beautifully crafted from the hands of those cruel <rTribal Warriors>.<n><t>Let me admire these...

Definitions.Name: Enthusiast

Needs.Description: Bring 5 <yWithered Roots> to <bAzur Breeze> at <j(622, 2106)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hi! I am a artist who carve figurines out of old roots. However, the forest nearby is full of monster and I cannot find any suitable roots for my art!<n><t>Please help me collect 5 <yWithered Roots>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: I can feel my inspiration coming now!

Definitions.Name: Sampling

Needs.Description: Kill 5 Treant and bring 1 <yWithered Root> back to <bSa Mori> at <j(628, 2095)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do you know how to make a candle of unending flame? It is made from a special root that can only be found in the forest east of this haven. However, there are many monsters along the way.<n><t>Could you kindly collect 1 <yWithered Root> and kill 5 <rTreants> please?
Definitions.ResultTalk: This is just what I needed!

Definitions.Name: Never Dying Candle

Needs.Description: Bring 15 <yWithered Roots> for <bSa Mori> at <j(628, 2095)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have just completed the research of making a candle of unending flame. I am prepared to start mass producing these candles.<n><t>Can you get me 15 <yWithered Roots>? I promise to share the profits with you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Haha! I can start production with these roots right away! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Black Monster

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rDark Mud Monsters> and bring 1 <yUsed Candle> to <bSa Mori> at <j(628, 2095)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Recently, I saw a lot of dark monsters with candles on their head. Is it a new form of cult for the monster? I believe this isn't any good news. However, I am more interested in their candles.<n><t>Can you kill some <rDark Mud Monsters> and get me their <yUsed Candle>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: This is weird. The candle burns without ever burning itself out! How mysterious!

Definitions.Name: Candle Research

Needs.Description: <t>Help <bSa Mori> at <j(628, 2095)> to obtain 10 candles for the research

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hey! You're still around! Thanks for your help the last time. I have finished up the <yUsed Candle> for research.<n><t>Can you get 10 more <yUsed Candles>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: This is great! I can continue my research again!

Definitions.Name: Rock Golem

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rSturdy Rock Golems> and bring 1 <yShimmering Rock Fragment> back to <bCarin Livingstone> at <j(626, 2100)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Recently, <rSturdy Rock Golems> are attacking everybody they encounter and many villagers have been hurt.<n><t>Dear adventurer! Please help me dismantle some <rSturdy Rock Golems> and collect some sample back for investigation!
Definitions.ResultTalk: You found this <yShimmering Rock Fragment> on them?

Definitions.Name: Velvet Stone Research

Needs.Description: Bring 6 <yShimmering Rock Fragments> to <bCarin Livingstone> at <j(626, 2100)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>orry, I was too to notice you! Regarding the <yShimmering Rock Fragments> you brought back the other time, I accidentally lost it as it is too small.<n><t>Can you get me another 6 <yShimmering Rock Fragments>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: I am sure I have seen these <yShimmering Rock Fragments> somewhere��

Definitions.Name: Validity

Needs.Description: Kill 5 <rUndead Warriors> and bring their helment back to <bCarin Livingstone> at <j(626, 2100)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I believed that I have found some evidence regarding the strange behavior of <rSturdy Rock Golems>.<n><t>However, I cannot confirm this and I need a <yUnyielding Helmet> from <rUndead Warrior>. Can you collect 1 <yUnyielding Helmet> and kill 5 <rUndead Warriors> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: I knew you can do it! Pass me the <yUnyielding Helmet> now.

Definitions.Name: Unyielding Helmet

Needs.Description: Bring 10 Immortral Helms to <bCarin Livingstone> at <j(626, 2100)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You've come at the right time! Look at this helmet!<n><t>I bet you cannot recognize it. It is the <yUnyielding Helmet> you bought me the other time. I have done some enhancements with the <yShimmering Rock Fragment> and this is the final product! Get me 10 more <yUnyielding Helmets> and I can start producing more!
Definitions.ResultTalk: With these, I can make more shimmering helmets! Hee! How can I allow <bSa Mori> at <j(628, 2095)> to reap the profits alone.

Definitions.Name: Disintegration

Needs.Description: Kill 20 <rElite <rWerewolf Warriors>> to prove your valor to <bColonel Maxi> at <j(653, 1505)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Are you here for visiting? If yes, you have come at the wrong time. Thundoria is under seige from monsters, especially those <rElite <rWerewolf Warriors>>.<n><t>If possible, can you help us kill 20 <rElite <rWerewolf Warriors>> to reduce their strength?
Definitions.ResultTalk: Well done! You have successfully vanquished the enemies!

Definitions.Name: Bloodied Hammer

Needs.Description: Bring 10 <yBloody Hammers> to <bWesley> at <j(741, 1563)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am a weapon collector who only collects high quality weapons.<n><t>Recently, I saw <rElite <rWerewolf Warriors>> wielding <yBloodied Hammers> as weapons. I wish to have them for my collection.<n><t>Please collect 10 <yBloodied Hammers> for me!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Look at these <yBloodied Hammers>. Only weapons collected from battlefield are of value.

Definitions.Name: First Ingredient

Needs.Description: <bFreya> at <j(651, 1585)> requires 8 <yMummy Nails> for research

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If you have no business here please leave. Do not disrupt my experiment! The people who share the same passion me have already died. But never mind, I just need a few important ingredients for my experiment to be a success!<n><t>Go get me 8 <yMummy Nails> for the first type of ingredients for the experiment now!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Take your hands off, do not mess around with my experiment! You can go now.

Definitions.Name: Vengence

Needs.Description: Kill 15 <rIron Mummies> on behalf of <bMallack> at <j(706, 1465)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: Damn those <rIron Mummies>! They killed my wife and turned her into one of themselves! Because of this, I cannot bear to kill them as I do not know wish to harm what was formerly wife!<n><t>Please help me release her soul! Kill 15 <rIron Mummies> please!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Thank you! Finally, my wife can rest in peace.

Definitions.Name: Third Ingredient

Needs.Description: Collect 8 <yHuge Stramonium Thorns> as the 3rd ingredient for <bFreya>'s research at <j(651, 1585)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is not the first time we're talking to each other so I'll spare you the formalities.<n><t>I need the third type of ingredients now. Get me 10 <yStramonium Thorn> now. If you don't know where to find, go north-west of the city and search.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Good! Two more to go before completion. You can go now. I'll call on you when I need help.

Definitions.Name: Second Ingredient

Needs.Description: <bFreya> at <j(651, 1585)> requires the 2nd ingredient. Get her 10 strands of <yMummy Hair>.
