Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Just like what I've said before. I need a few ingredients for my experiment. <yMummy Nails> are just one of them.<n><t>I need the second type of ingredients now. Go get me 10 strands of <yMummy Hair>.<n><t>Remember! Only those from <rSteel Mummies>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Don't move! Give me that strand of hair that's stuck on your clothes!

Definitions.Name: Repel Spirit

Needs.Description: Help <bMallack> at <j(706, 1465)> to kill 15 <rSteel Mummies>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My anger has ceased as I only wished for my wife to find peace in heaven. However, as long as those mummies exist, the villagers will never have a peaceful day.<n><t>Please kill 15 <rSteel Mummies>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: You've done it! I am impressed with your courage and skill.  Here is your reward.

Definitions.Name: Tribal Invasion

Needs.Description: Get rid of 5 <rTribal Shamans> and 15 <rAgile Tribal Villagers> and report back to <bColonel Maxi> at <j(653, 1505)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><rElite <rWerewolf Warriors>> have steered clear of our city for now. However, the <rtribesmen> are still lurking around and disrupting our peace!<n><t>Help us by killing 5 <rTribal Shamans> and 15 <rAgile Tribal Villagers>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Haha! Lets see what those <rtribesmen> do can now!

Definitions.Name: Battle Reward

Needs.Description: <t><bGuard - Sonny> at <j(711, 1414)> requires 5 <yTribal Masks> and 5 <yMysterious Bones>. Bring to him to prove your worth

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You tell me that you are the hero that defeated those <rElite <rWerewolf Warriors>> and <rtribesmen>?<n><t>Don't make me laugh! Show me proof then! Bring me 5 <yTribal Masks> and 5 <yMysterious Bones> as evident!
Definitions.ResultTalk: You are really a hero! This is what you deserved!

Definitions.Name: New Weapon

Needs.Description: Get <bColonel Maxi> at <j(653, 1505)> the required <yBroken Angel Wand> and <yDented Sacred Bow> for the weapon research

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>As the war with the monsters continues, we need to invent new weapons to deal with them effectively. We need 1 <yBroken Angel Wand> and 1 <yDented Sacred Bow> for the research.<n><t>Can you get them from the <rGuardian Angels> and <rForest Hunters>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: Although these weapons are damaged, it is more than enough for our research.

Definitions.Name: Fallen Angel

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rGuardian Angels> and report back to <bGuard Nisson> at <j(711, 1414)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Have you seen the <rGuardian Angels> outside our city?<n><t>Do you think that they are even fit to be called angels? Please put these fallen angels to rest.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Poor angels! I hope that they can return to heaven one day.

Definitions.Name: Expedition

Needs.Description: Kill 8 <rVicious Undead Warriors> and 8 <rDeadly Skeletal Archers> and report back to <bColonel Maxi> at <j(653, 1505)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The monsters outside the city have been defeated. However, enemies hiding in the <bSacred Snow Mountain> are still on the move. We will organise another war expedition! Are there any brave man who are willing to join?<n><t>Our targets this time round are the <rUndead Warrior> and <rSkeletal Archer>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: We were succesfully thanks to you, our hero!

Definitions.Name: Fallen Helmet

Needs.Description: Help <bWesley> at <j(741, 1563)> to collect 5 <yFallen Helms>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Did you participate in the war expedition recently?<n><t>The <rVicious Undead Warriors> that were killed drop <yFallen Helmets> which is just what I've been looking for. Can you get me 5 <yFallen Helmets>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: They are a such beauties! Haha!

Definitions.Name: Fourth Ingredient

Needs.Description: <bMorpheus - Freya> at <j(651, 1585)> requires a new ingredient now. Get her 8 <yComplete Ribs>...

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The fourth type of ingredient is a <yComplete Rib>. It can only be found off <rDeadly Skeletal Archers>.<n><t>Not a single person has returned from their lair. Are you brave enough to bring me their <yComplete Ribs>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: I am impressed with your capability. Good!

Definitions.Name: Test of the Sacred Forest

Needs.Description: Kill 10 <rForest Hunters> to pass the test of <bCindy> at <j(740, 1451)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There is a challenge waiting for you. Are you brave enough to defeat 10 <rForest Hunters>? May the goddess be with you!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Congratulations! You have passed the test!

Definitions.Name: Last Ingredient

Needs.Description: Bring 10 <ySkeleton Bone Fragments> for <bFreya> at <j(651, 1585)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You can't give up now! It's already too late! I will kill you if you dare! However, if you help me, I will share the secret of immortality with you.<n><t>I need the last type of ingredient now! Get me 10 <ySkeleton Bone Fragments> from <rCursed Corpse>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Nobody can stop me now! I will reach immortality soon!

Definitions.Name: Hidden Shadow

Needs.Description: Kill 10 <rCursed Corpse> and report back to <bGuard Captain Mallack> at <j(706, 1465)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have been investigating the case about those mummies and have found out that the <rCursed Corpses> have been manipulating them all along.<n><t>Please put a stop to this evil and defeat those <rCursed Corpses>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: May light shine upon us now that those <rCursed Corpses> are destroyed!

Definitions.Name: Last Enemy

Needs.Description: Kill 10 <rSkeletal Warrior Leader> and bring 1 <yWarrior Leader Token> to <bColonel Maxi> at <j(653, 1505)> to prove your bravery

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The war expedition has been a success. Now the enemies have gathered near the western shores. However, we are unable to break through their defense.<n><t>Maybe you can give it a try by killing 10 <rSkeletal Warrior Leaders>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: The last of the enemies have been destroyed by you! You are our war hero!

Definitions.Name: Phantom Blood Test

Needs.Description: Kill 15 <rBloodthirsty Hunters> to pass the test of <bCindy> at <j(740, 1451)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Forsake the light and dwell into the darkness of your soul! Nobody possesses the power that you have within. Embrace darkness and release the power now! Defeat 15 <rBloodthirsty Hunters> to prove that you deserve the power!
Definitions.ResultTalk: You will walk in darkness and remain invincible from now on!

Definitions.Name: Dark Bow

Needs.Description: <bWesley> at <j(741, 1563)> requires 5 <yDark Bows>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t><yBloodied Hammer>, <yFallen Helmet> and others are only rubbish. If you ask me, the only treasure will be a <yDark Bow>.<n><t>If you can help me obtain 5 <yDark Bows>, I will reward you greatly!
Definitions.ResultTalk: This mysterious darkness is a form of beauty��

Definitions.Name: Repel Snowman

Needs.Description: Kill 15 <rcumbersome snowman> and report back to <bFardey> at <j(2680, 657)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There was a recent attack by the snowman. Although there were similar incidents in the past, this attack was well organised for some unknown reason. Will you help us defend against these snowman?<n><t>Of course, we will let you handle weaker ones first. The <rcumbersome snowman> appears at <j(2471, 502)>. So, are you willing to take up the job?
Definitions.ResultTalk: I can sense your courage from the way you repel those <rSnowmen>. Well done!

Definitions.Name: Werewolves Invasion

Needs.Description: Help <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)> to kill 15 <rWerewolf Warriors>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It seems to be season of the werewolves again. Children will not be safe with them around. Please help us get ird of these <rWerewolf Warriors>!<n><t>They can be found near <j(2580, 553)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Thank you for keeping our children safe!

Definitions.Name: Rubbish Collection

Needs.Description: Help <bMekkilon> at <j(2662, 648)> to collect 5 <yRusty Broadswords>, 5 <yBroken Hammers> and 5 <ySlipshod Wooden Sticks>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Don't belittle this pile of junk for they are worth quite a bit of money. I will give you a reward if you bring me 5 <yRusty Broadswords>, <yBroken Hammers> and <ySlipshod Wooden Sticks> each.<n><t>You can get them from the <rWerewolves> at <j(2580, 553)>, the <rCumbersome Yeti> at <j(2811, 565)> and the <rHorrific Snowman> at <j(2471, 502)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Haha! Now I can use these to cheat <bWesley>!

Definitions.Name: Upgrade Battle

Needs.Description: <bFardey> at <j(2680, 657)> requires you to kill 15 <rSnowmen>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The war has escalated to another level! Now we are facing attacks from ferocious <rSnowmen>!<n><t>Would you accept the task to kill 15 <rSnowmen>?<n><t>They are camping at <j(2587, 455)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Thank you for not letting us down!

Definitions.Name: Giant Broadsword

Needs.Description: Collect 5 <yGiant Broadswords> for <bMekkilon> at <j(2662, 648)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Remember me? Now I need 5 <yGiant Broadswords>. Get them for me and I shall reward you.<n><t>They can be found on the <rSnowmen> at <j(2587, 455)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: These <yGiant Broadswords> will make good money. Haha!

Definitions.Name: Repel Yeti

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rCumbersome Yeti> and report back to <bFardey> at <j(2680, 657)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You might have defeated those <rSnowmen>. However, these <rCumbersome Yetis> are far more formidable compare to them.<n><t>We are training new recruits to kill these <rCumbersome Yetis>. Show off your skill by killing 12 <rCumbersome Yetis> at <j(2811, 565)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: There is nothing to be proud of. More challenges await you!

Definitions.Name: Snail Hunting

Needs.Description: Kill 20 <rSteel-Shell Snails> and bring back 6 of their <ySteel Feelers >to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The supplies we have here come from hunting. However, it is not as easy as you think.<n><t>Do you want to join us? Hunt down 20 <rSteel-Shell Snails> at <j(2733, 651)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Good! This show that you have the potential to be a hunter.

Definitions.Name: New Invader

Needs.Description: Defend the Haven by killing 12 <rUndead Archers> and report back to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Just after the <rWerewolf Warriors> attacks died down, the <rUndead Archers> started a new wave of attack! Is this the curse of <pIcespire Haven>?<n><t>Help us again! Please defeat those invader at <j(2746, 451)>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Those band of <rUndead Archers> escaping are comical. Thanks for your help.

Definitions.Name: Skeleton Accessory

Needs.Description: Collect 10 <yDeath Arrows> for <bSasha> at <j(2678, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The arrows of <rUndead Archers> at <j(2746, 451)> seems to be decorated with some beautiful bones.<n><t>Can you get me 10 <yDeath Arrows> for collection?
Definitions.ResultTalk: This fits so beautifully! Thanks!

Definitions.Name: Deep Venture

Needs.Description: Kill 12 <rSnow Yetis> and report back <bFardey> at <j(2680, 657)> for a reward.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The training of the recruits are over. We are now going to real battle. We will venture deeper to destroy the <rSnow Yetis>.<n><t>Are you with us? You will have to kill <rSnow Yetis> at <j(2855, 451)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: You are daring to venture so deeply.

Definitions.Name: Giant Wooden Stick

Needs.Description: Help <bMekkilon> at <j(2662, 648)> to collect 10 <yGiant Wooden Sticks>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I heard that you are going to attack those <rSnow Yetis>. Can you bring 10 <yGiant Wooden Sticks> back for me? They usually appear at <j(2855, 451)>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: I can foresee shining coins in my pocket soon!

Definitions.Name: Enemy's Rear

Needs.Description: <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)> requires you to kill 12 <rElite Skeletal Archers>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You have been of great help to us all! We don't wish to trouble you anymore. However, we do not have the strength to fight anymore and <rElite Skeletal Archers> are camping nearby waiting to attack us. Can you kill those <rElite Skeletal Archers> for us again?
Definitions.ResultTalk: These remind me of the good old days. Ah...

Definitions.Name: Glory of the Past

Needs.Description: Bring back 8 <yRuptured Ribs> to <bKevin Wolf> at <j(2688, 628)> to fulfill his wish

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Have you seen the <rElite Skeletal Archers>?<n><t>In the past, they used to be no match for me. But now, I am just a fragile old man. Can you do me a favor and get me some of their <yRuptured Ribs> as a memento?
Definitions.ResultTalk: These remind me of the good old days. Ah...

Definitions.Name: Hunt for Infant Dragon

Needs.Description: Hunt 10 <rInfant Icy Dragons> and bring 1 <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragment> back to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You have done well on the last trip. This time we are going to hunt <rInfant Icy Dragons>. You have to be very careful if not you will become the hunted instead. Kill 10 <rInfant Icy Dragons> and get 1 <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragment>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: This is a beautiful fragment! I guess this is what <bSasha> wanted all along

Definitions.Name: Puzzle of the Crystalline

Needs.Description: Bring 5 <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragment> to <bSasha> at <j(2678, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I heard that you participated in the hunt for <rInfant Icy Dragons>. I believed that you have seen the <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragment>.<n><t>If its possible, can you collect 5 <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragments> for me?
Definitions.ResultTalk: The <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragments> look so pure and beautiful��

Definitions.Name: Crystal Heart

Needs.Description: Bring <bSasha> at <j(2678, 631)> 5 <yPure Crystals>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>As stated in the legends, combiningg the <yHeart of Ice Crystal Fragment> with a <yPure Crystal> yields a <yCrystalline Heart>. The <yCrystalline Heart> is a symbol of eternal purity.<n><t>Can you get 5 <yPure Crystals> from the <rWater Fairies>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: This way when combine the pieces together, I can get the <yCrystalline Heart> that I had always dreamed for.

Definitions.Name: Hunt for Polar Bear

Needs.Description: Kill 8 <rGreat Polar Bears> and bring back 3 <yRazor Bear Tooths> to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Listen to me! In the past, many have perished while hunting ferocious <rGreat Polar Bears>. Those who are change their mind may withdraw now! If not, go forth and hunt these beast down!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Look at this, it's a <yRazor Bear Tooth>! Many have been slain by it.

Definitions.Name: Snowman Warlord

Needs.Description: Help <bFardey> at <j(2680, 657)> to defeat 16 <rSnowmen>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although the battle with <rSnowmen> is still fresh in our mind. This time, we will have to deal with <rHorrific Snowmen>.<n><t>Let us set forth and end this once and for all! Kill 16 <rHorrific Snowmans>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: You have done what others did not have the courage to achieve. Brave indeed!

Definitions.Name: Fearsome Sword of Giant

Needs.Description: Collect 5 <yFearsome Swords of Giant> for <bMekkilon> at <j(2662, 648)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hoho! Its you again!<n><ts>ince you have fought with those <rHorrific Snowmen>, can you get me 5 <yFearsome Sword of Giant>?
Definitions.ResultTalk: So... This is the legendary <yFearsome Sword of Giant> they used��

Definitions.Name: Werewolf Archer

Needs.Description: Kill 20 <rWerewolf Archers> and bring back 5 <yBroken Werewolf Bows> to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>There is a cluster of <rWerewolf Archers> gathering near the outside of our village. Whatever their motives are, it can't be good.<n><t>Please bring along your weapon and teach them a lesson!
Definitions.ResultTalk: You have done us another favor! Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Last Yeti

Needs.Description: Kill 15 <rHorrific Yetis> and return to <bFardey> at <j(2680, 657)> for a reward.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>We are now facing the greatest enemy of all time, the <rHorrific Yetis>. Nobody has survived an attack from it before.<n><t>Will you be the first? Bring your weapon and go forth!
Definitions.ResultTalk: When the last of the <rHorrific Yetis> fall, nothing in this world will be able to stop you.

Definitions.Name: Fearsome Staff of Giant

Needs.Description: Bring 5 <yFearsome Staffs of Giant> to <bMekkilon> at <j(2662, 648)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I'm surprised that you are still alive. Have you brought back 5 <yFearsome Staff of Giant>? I will buy them from you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: The best weapons of the Yetis��

Definitions.Name: For Honour

Needs.Description: Kill 10 <rElite Skeletal Warriors> and bring back the <yMark of Warrior Honor> to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <ts>ome people go to war for peace, others for honor. To prove yourself worthy, defeat those <rElite Skeletal Warriors>.<n><t>For honor and glory!
Definitions.ResultTalk: Take this, honorable warrior and you will be remembered forever!

Definitions.Name: Hunt for Lizardman

Needs.Description: Hunt 15 <rLizardmen> and return to <bNeila> at <j(2675, 631)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Our hunt should have ended with the <rGreat Polar Bears>. However, a group of <rLizardmen> have been causing havoc and robbing any traveler they see.<n><t>Put a stop to this! There will be a great reward for them!
Definitions.ResultTalk: At last somebody managed to deal with those pesky <rLizardmen>.

Definitions.Name: Lizard Man Axe

Needs.Description: Collect 5 <yLizardman Axes> for <bMekkilon> at <j(2662, 648)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am low in supply for <yLizardman Axes>. Can you bring me 5 <yLizardman Axes>?<n><t>I promise to pay you well.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Let me examine these axe before I pay you.

Definitions.Name: Drunkyard Secrets

Needs.Description: Buy 1 Coconut Wine for Drunkyard in Argent Bar at <j(2222, 2889)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: I have not taste any wine for a long time...Young fellow, wine is like oxygen to me! I cannot live without it! <n><t>Can you buy a bottle of good wine for me from the bar in Argent? I will tell you a secret if you do it.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Hmm�� This is indeed a good wine! It's been a long time since I have tasted such quality! Do you want some? Ah�� ZZzzzZZZzzz.

Definitions.Name: Another Cup Please!

Needs.Description: Argent Drunkyard at <j(2222, 2889)> requires a bottle of Drunken Dreams and 20 Sashimi.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh my...The last drop of my wine is gone! But I am still thirsty for more...<n><t>Young adventurer, get me the famous "Drunkern Dream" from Argent bar. Faster!<n><t>Some Sashimi too will be nice...
Definitions.ResultTalk: Ah��Good wine! I will tell you the secret now.<n><t>When I was young around your age, I gathered a group of enthusiastic adventurers like you and me. We went on a sea expedition once and salvage an ancient looking compass. We sail towards the direction it was pointing and suddenly, a hugh whirlpool appears in front of our ship and suck us into the portal.<n><t>Through the portal is a small island with a forsaken city in the middle of it. Piles of treasures litters the street of the city!<n><t>However, none of us are able to leave with any treasures. Anyone who tried to take any treasure from the city was killed by undead souls and skeletons that appeared out of nowhere! It is so scary! Only me and Little Daniel escaped that calamity.<n><t>You want me to bring you there? NO! I will never set foot on that cursed place ever again! Look for Little Daniel, he knows the way to get to the Forsaken City. Leave me with my wine...zZzz...

Definitions.Name: Drunken Dreams
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Oh...Drunken Dreams? It must be that drunkyard who told you about it.<n><t>It requires special brewing ingredients that consist of Stramonium Flower, Rainbow Fruit and Strange Fruit. Get me these and I will brew one for you. However, it needed to be contained in a Snowy Trumpet Shell to make it tasty. Get me Snowy Trumpet Shell too.<n><t>And also a fee of 2000G for my effort.
Definitions.ResultTalk: Yes! These are the stuff. Looks like you are really determine. Take this wine that the Drunkyard wanted.

Definitions.Name: Skeleton of Sorrow Warrior
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since the drunkyard send you here, I will help you. I have been there before. You will need an Ancient Generator to enter. Bring me 10 Robot Core and I will make it for you.<n><t>By the way, can you collect some bones for my research while you are there.
Definitions.ResultTalk: So these are the carcass of those undead.<n><t>I can feel them calling out to me! I wonder what is this mysterious force behind this. I will need to do an indepth research.<n><t>Maybe I might discover some secret!

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Worries

Needs.Description: Relay Blacksmith's message to Elizabeth.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My beloved was kidnapped! I will go save her myself! Damn those Deathsouls! I will rip you to pieces!<n><t>Sorry, forgive me for my outburst. If you seen Elizabeth, tell her do not be afraid for I will save her.<n><t>Even if it cost me my life!

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Worries
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Did Mark sent you to me?<n><t>I know...I love him too...Always do...��.

Definitions.Name: Elizabeth's Love Keepsake
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I would like you to pass this necklace to him...Oh no! Where is my necklace?<n><t>Oh dear! I think I have dropped it on the Skeletar Pirate Ship! It is an important keepsake between me and Mark!<n><t>Can you retrieve it back for me please.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Yes, this is the one. Thank you for getting it back for me.

Definitions.Name: Necklace of Love

Needs.Description: Help Elizabeth pass the Necklace of Love to Blacksmith Mark.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It is done. I have written my message within this necklace<n><t>Can you help me pass this necklace to Mark? May the Gods protect you!

Definitions.Name: Necklace of Love
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You found Elizabeth? Let me go save her now,<n><t>Wait, where is our necklace? Let me check.

Definitions.Name: Blacksmith's Promise
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To save my goddess, we will need a very unique weapon. Are you able to help me with that?<n><t>This weapon only drops from Deathsoul Officer which I believe you are able to deal with easily.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This should be the weapon that Elizabeth is talking about. Its really special from the way I look at it.

Definitions.Name: Unique Weapon

Needs.Description: Bring the unique weapon from the Blacksmith to Jack Arrow.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This weapon seems to lack something, the feeling is not there. It feels strange to wield.<n><t>Sigh...Can you bring to Jack Arrow and let him take a look.

Definitions.Name: Unique Weapon
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Let me have a look! This weapon has a dark curse on it.<n><t>Only a man of evil can wield it...Mark is just too kind...

Definitions.Name: Pirate Vs Navy

Needs.Description: Help Jack Arrow send a message to Wellington.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I requires you to make a trip to the Navy. Tell Wellington about the current situation.<n><t>I believed that he will make a suitable judgement.

Definitions.Name: Pirate Vs Navy
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Jack is not dead yet? What! He dares to request my aid? How daring of him!<n><t>Hmm...Deathsoul Officer's Captain Token?<n><t>Seems like we are on the same side after all. I will consider Jack's suggestion.

Definitions.Name: General's Confession of Love
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Damn those Deathsoul! My Proposal Ring is stolen by them!<n><t>Why took my ring of all things?<n><t>Damn! I spent quite a fortune to make it. Please get it back for me as soon as possible. It seems that they are escaping by the Spirit Ship.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thanks God! I can propose to Elizabeth now since I have the ring!

Definitions.Name: General's Confession of Love

Needs.Description: <t>Help Wellington by giving the Proposal Ring to Elizabeth and observe her reaction.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>How do I say this...I like a girl...I want to propose to her...<n><t>But I am shy...Can you help me pass this ring to her...Observe her reaction please...<n><t>I will be grateful to you....If she accepts my love...Oh right..... Her name is Elizabeth.

Definitions.Name: General's Confession of Love
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>General Wellington...Its not worth it��.

Definitions.Name: Elizabeth's Prayer

Needs.Description: Help out the Blacksmith on behalf of Elizabeth.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I don't feel good.<n><t>It seems that something has happened to Mark. I am quite worry, can you go over and check on him?<n><t>I will pray for his safety!

Definitions.Name: Elizabeth's Prayer
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Did Elizabeth sent you?<n><t>How is she getting on? I encounter some minor problem here but tell her not to worry.

Definitions.Name: The Curse
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The treasures we collected have been stolen from us by the dead spirits on the Black Jewel and they also set an evil curse on it.<n><t>I need you to find and return these cursed treasures to me, then I will proceed to lift the curse from the treasures.<n><t>How about it, it shouldn't be a problem.<n><t>Go forth and kill those from the Black Jewel. I know this is a extremely difficult mission, I will reward you handsomely once it is completed.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t> Let me have a look...This is a powerful curse indeed. Let me try to undo it.<n><t>!^($......%*#oa2......1&s?~*#^%!...... (Blacksmith starts to chant in some weird language...Scary!) Good! The curse is undone!

Definitions.Name: The Curse

Needs.Description: Tell Jack Arrow oh behalf of the Blacksmith that the curse has been broken.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>We have undone the curse of coins that those Deathsoul pirates have been relying on.<n><t>Without their treasures and source of power, they will not be able to resist our army!<n><t>It is time to make a decisive attack on them! However, please inform Jack Arrow about our plans first.

Definitions.Name: The Curse
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I've got it. We will begin attack soon. Are you with us.

Definitions.Name: The Real Captain
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Battle draws near! Wait for me Baborosa! Let us settle this once and for all!<n><t>My friend, if you can get back the Captain's Token from Baborosa, I will reward you greatly!<n><t>Let him know who is the real captain of the Black Jewel!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>This is great! I am the captain of the Black Jewel once again!

Definitions.Name: The Gift

Needs.Description: Send a gift on behalf of Jack to congratulate Elizabeth on her marriage to the Blacksmith.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Everything has finally ended. I heard that Mark and Elizabeth has gotten married at last.<n><t>I have not sent them my gift yet. Can you do it on my behalf? Why don't I sent it myself?<n><t>...Have you heard of an NPC who will do his own task.

Definitions.Name: The Gift
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Wow...A gift from Jack! Let's open it!<n><t>What!!! Only a skeletar emblem...What a miser!

Definitions.Name: Undeserving Love

Needs.Description: Help Elizabeth return the ring to Wellington.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Help me once again please...<n><t>Return this ring to General Wellington and I hope he can understand my feeling.

Definitions.Name: Undeserving Love
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>There will be no turning back now...<n><t>Why make a promise if it cannot be kept...<n><t>Sorrow is the only thing left...

Definitions.Name: Wellington's Blessing

Needs.Description: Send the gift of Wellington to Elizabeth.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have thought it through. I should sent them my blessing instead since they truly love each other.<n><t>Please hand this gift of mine to them.

Definitions.Name: Pet Event

Needs.Description: Kill 10 Fox Taoist for the fortune teller.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Want a beautiful pet? Then you will have to take my test.<n><t>Go outside of town to kill 10 Fox Taoists and bring back the Exorcism Bell.<n><t>I will give you a chance to obtain a beautiful pet.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are quite fast!<n><t>If you are lucky, the chest will contain the pet you wanted.

Definitions.Name: Pet Event

Needs.Description: Help <bOld Man Blurry> at <j(2272, 2700)> to kill 20 <rForest Spirit>, 20 <rLittle Squidy>, 10 <rMud Monster>, 10 <rStramonium> and 10 <rRookie Boxeroo>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Want a beautiful pet? Then you will have to take my test. Go outside of town to kill  10 Fox Taoists and bring back the Exorcism Bell. I will give you a chance to obtain a beautiful pet.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are quite fast!<n><t>If you are lucky, the chest will contain the pet you wanted.

Definitions.Name: Love Revival

Needs.Description: Requires a <yReverse Love Potion> to moist a <yWithered Heart>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Child, if you heart is empty and lifeless, look for the <yReverse Love Potion>. I will restore your heart to its former glory!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Very good child, this is the <yLove Reversal Potion>. Drink it, and face rebirth bravely.

Definitions.Name: Bloodied High Heels
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Why is there always someone getting hurt recently!

Definitions.Name: Verify with the Patroller
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Yes, this Medical Report comes from me. The injury seems to be caused by a high heel shoe and the victim is a skinny man. However, I do not know the cause of the injury. It seems that <bGuard - Michael> in Shaitan City at <j(959, 3549)> is also investigating this matter.

Definitions.Name: Verify with the Patroller
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Its not easy being a patrol guard, theres always trouble and little pay!

Definitions.Name: Investigation to the Case of the High Heels
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Hmm...I have been investigating for some time about the incident you brought up. This is a very troublesome issue. Both parties claim to be the victim, insisting that the opposite party started the fight. What a problematic case! Look, this is the medical report of the lady boss, although the details are abit vague, they still can be used as clues.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Only those who are brave dare to uphold rightness!

Definitions.Name: Weapon of the Case of the High Heels
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Surprisingly the weapon used is this High Heels. I will safekeep it with me to keep it from harming other people. Thank you!

Definitions.Name: Little Mystery Man

Needs.Description: Search for Eastern town's mysterious guardian.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Judging from your reputation, I am sure that guy will not reject you...However, I did not say that he has part of the fragment.

Definitions.Name: Little Mystery Man
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I'm already this fat, and yet I'm still recognizable?!

Definitions.Name: Simple Mission
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I never like to trouble others, help me find 30 <yGigantic Stramonium Flower>, 30 <yQuality Caviar>, 30 <yCompressed Energy III> as a gift, hehe...
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>These are the ingredients in making Mao Wine! I gave those away when I quit drinking to go on a diet.

Definitions.Name: Day of Abstinence
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This is really a good wine...But it is too troublesome to brew on my own. Go get me a few bottles more.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Good wine! Good wine!

Definitions.Name: Day of Abstinence
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Someone famous once told me, to see how the taste of <yDukan Wine> and <yMao Wine> differs, you need to taste it yourself. You don't mind getting me a few bottles of <yDukan Wine>, do you?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Only <yDukan Wine> can relieve woes!

Definitions.Name: Day of Abstinence
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>After tasting them, I think Mao Wine would suit me more. I think I would need to stock up 20 bottles in the wine cellar. You think so too, don't you?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Wine gets better as it gets older... Ah...

Definitions.Name: Day of Abstinence
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I need to quit drinking! I think I have been drinking too much lately. I have signs of internal bleeding. Nobody stop me! I heard that Ginseng Wine is a good remedy for internal bleeding. Hmm...You know what i mean?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I have not tasted Tiger Bone Tonic in a long time��

Definitions.Name: Seek out Demonic Guide

Needs.Description: Search for <pDemonic World's> <rMysterious Guardian>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To express my thanks, I will give you this piece of fragment that symbolize Virtue. In my drunken state, I remember seeing a guy in <pDemonic World> having part of this fragment as well. You will have to look around to complete the piece. I heard that rebirth enable you to redistribute your stats...

Definitions.Name: Seek out Demonic Guide
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I may be the guide of <pDemonic World> but I do not conduct tours. I only give directions, as I often get lost...

Definitions.Name: Caribbean 1 day tour

Needs.Description: Kill <rDeathsoul Commander>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The incident happened a long time ago. This fragment has given me endless nightmares. I wish to return it before I retire, however, I have no means to get to <pHeaven>. Have you been to the <pCaribbean>? If you can defeat <rDeathsoul Commander>, I will consider giving this fragment to you.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The scenery of Caribbean is beautiful, but the monsters are too fearsome!

Definitions.Name: Carribean 2 days tour

Needs.Description: Kill <rBarborosa>!

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I wonder why do I hate those from the Caribbean. It would be better off if all are dead... Especially that <rBarborosa>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I knew you would want to start a killing spree in Carribean.

Definitions.Name: Caribbean Tour 2

Needs.Description: Kill <rKraken>!

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I can see that you aren't satisfied with a 2 days tour of Carribean Island. No need to thank me, I've already applied for another tour for you. Hehe! Kill the irritating <rKraken>!
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The world was never this beautiful. Your ability has convinced me. Here take this Shard of Love and I hope that you will find your purest love.

Definitions.Name: Who is the Guardian

Needs.Description: Search for the next guardian.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My friend, seek it out fast, rebirth will allow you to soar above the rest! I vaguely remembered that Icicle City do have a guardian��

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>You need to be at least Lv 40. Don't tell me you cannot do it.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are so slow, I need to go out for a date soon.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Did you know that my friend has a <yGatherer Emblem>? If you wish to get it, prepare for yourself for some test.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I suspect you could actually gather alien matter.

Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Saving a damsel in distress does not happen daily. Moreover, he seldom appears.

Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are so slow, I need to go out for a date soon.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do you know that my friend has a Gatherer Emblem? If you wish to get it, prepare for yourself for some test.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The minimum is Lv 50. Do not tell me you cannot do it.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are so slow, I need to go out for a date soon.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do you know that my friend has a Gatherer Emblem? If you wish to get it, prepare for yourself for some test.

Needs.Description: Look for <bMerman Prince Hassan> in Shaitan at <j(1254, 3491)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>It takes intellect to become a pirate, to go around eating for free and having fun along the way, so you have to differentiate between important person and those who are not.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Do you know that I am the most handsome fellow here, and also the fastest swimmer!

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 2

Needs.Description: Look for <bStrawberry> in Icicle at <j(1010, 350)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I prayed to the gods to turn me into a tree that she will pass by and rest upon daily. Indeed she do pass by that tree daily, but I have been turned into a fish��

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 2
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hi! My ambassador!

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 3

Needs.Description: Look for <bOldman Blurry> in Ascaron at <j(2272, 2700)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I look like a normal being on the outside. However, if you believe it to be so, may the lord bless you.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 3
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>A simple person can always find happiness��

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 4

Needs.Description: Look for <bMusician Shamel> in Shaitan at <j(664, 3093)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Jealous of me? The wise are often inspired by music. Visit <bMusician - Shamel>. He is wiser than me.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 4
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Blurry is the Enlightened One!

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 5

Needs.Description: Look for <bLulu> in Icicle at <j(2668, 634)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My dream is to create a paradise on earth with music. Do you have a dream as well? Is it the same as <bLulu's>?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 5
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I wish to have lollipops daily��

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 6

Needs.Description: Look for <bGregg> in Ascaron at <j(526, 2432)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If only I have lollipops to eat daily and the beautiful sister next door to accompany me to Ascaron to visit a friend whom I have never meet��

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 6
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are a friend of <bLulu>? Is <bLulu? well?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 7

Needs.Description: Look for <bLamb Welly> in Shaitan at <j(898, 3683)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I love to get to know strangers from afar. But there is this guy <bWelly> who keep telling me that he is a lamb. Could you check it out for me?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 7
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You never tell her? I used to be a normal lamb. It is only recently that I learnt how to speak human.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 8

Needs.Description: Look for <bDoctor Minoseva> in Ascaron at <j(1004, 2973)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Do you want to be a TOP Hero? Let me introduce you to somebody. He is a challenging person!

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 8
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>It is ok that human misunderstood me, as they always quick to judge by the appearances. However, even sheeps are the same now. What is happening in the world now?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 9

Needs.Description: Look for <bFey Fey> in Shaitan at <j(797, 3129)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My kindness often goes unnoticed. I do not have a pair of charming eyes like <bFey Fey>. Please send my regards to her.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 9
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bDoctor �C Minoseva> is a quiet but nice person.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 10

Needs.Description: Look for <bElizabeth> in the <pTreasure Gulf> at <j(616, 965)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Don't talk about her anymore. I wish to meet this person named <bElizabeth>. I have picked up a floating bottle a couple of days ago and in it contains an invitation to a dance.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 10
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Somebody got my invitation? This is great! Thank you for bring me this good news.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 11

Needs.Description: Look for Thundoria Castle's <bNavy HQ - General Ken> at <j(808, 1521)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>My dance is going to start soon! Yet I have to fetch <bWang Rong>. Can you help me invite <bNavy HQ - General Ken>?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 11
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I never reject invitation from a beautiful lady, hehe��

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 12

Needs.Description: Look for <bMomo> in Shaitan City at <j(1209, 3196)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I promised to write a poem for <bMomo> in Shaitan. However, I am sick at the moment so could you tell her that I will send her a draft after I am well enough to start composing.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 12
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>He is so tough yet he has fallen sick. Poor general.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 13

Needs.Description: Look for <bBerry> in Ascaron at <j(1893, 2812)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Actually my friend idolize the general and wishes to get a copy of his manuscript. If you are free could you inform him for me? Thank you.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 13
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>So the General also do falls ill?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 14

Needs.Description: Talk to <bWynne> of Icicle City at <j(1380, 523)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>How I wish that the general will recover faster. Thank you. Let me introduce you to <bWynne>.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 14
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I used to be beautiful before I fallen out of love.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 15

Needs.Description: Look for <bDon Pitt> in Ascaron at <j(1113, 2779)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I am very  weak now. Please help me deliever a message to <bDon Pitt>. I will put in a good word for you at <bCindy> if you will do me the favor.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 15
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>My dear <bWynne> is looking pale! What should I do?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 16

Needs.Description: Look for <bOracle Moonlight> in Icicle at <j(2134, 555)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Actually I haven already forgiven her. However, I have been so busy that I forgot to write to her. Please help me inform <bOracle �C Moonlight> that I will look for her soon.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 16
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>He has done right. If I could give in in the past, I would not have lost my loved one.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 17

Needs.Description: Look for <bDurian> in Ascaron at <j(1535, 3071)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>All is in the past. What worries me most is <bDurian's> greedy appetite.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 17
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I am satisfied with my illness. It is keeping me slim.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 18

Needs.Description: Look for <bNana> in Icicle at <j(798, 369)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Having some many to be concern over my illness can be irritating at times. Please help me send a message to <bNana> in <pIcicle Haven> and tell her that I am well.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 18
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Actually I am quite jealous of her.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 19

Needs.Description: Look for <bAzur Breeze> in Ascaron at <j(624, 2105)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I have been busy composing poems nowadays. Please help me send a message to <bAzur Breeze >.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 19
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Ah��Wrinkles! Ah��

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 20

Needs.Description: Look for <bAbaddon Teleporter> at <j(690, 1043)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If I am so wise, I would have knew how did that sea monster find our ship during that time. And I would not have request the help of that person��Please help me tell him that I have not forgotten about him.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 20
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>That happens many years ago, I am surprised that he still remembers.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 21

Needs.Description: Look for <bHeaven Teleporter> at <j(474, 1054)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Want to do me a favor? Hmm��I miss the Heaven Teleporter�� And also the money he stole from me. Please remind him so.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 21
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>So petty, its only a small sum.

Definitions.Name: TOP Hero 22

Needs.Description: Look for <bCindy> at <j(740, 1451)>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Congratulations, you have completed the arduous TOP quest. I heard <bCindy> is looking for you.

Definitions.Name: TOP Hero 22
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have passed TOP test, I will award you with an emblem.

Definitions.ResultTalk: <t><bTutu> is always creating trouble for me.

Definitions.Name: Tough? Or irritating?

Needs.Description: Talk to Sa Mori (628, 2095) in Region Ascaron.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The bar isn't doing too well lately, we need to advertise but we don't have the money. Can you please help us advertise a bit while making new friends outside town?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Bar? You've found the right person. Look at my body shape and you can tell I can drink a lot, I'm very proud of this.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 2

Needs.Description: Find Shaitan's Holy Priestess�� Ada(862, 3303) for a chat.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Thank you for you help. I'm not sure if you'll be passing by Shaitan, but I'm very worried about my friend Ada, she's always staying in a place full of beasts and pray for them to turn good. She wants the beast to eat vegetable not meat, hope she'll succeed.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 2
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Hi! May Kara bless you! May the world best things be blessed upon you. May happiness be always around you��..

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 3

Needs.Description: Head to Skeleton Haven and talk to Tae (2128, 540).

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>All thanks to the Goddess's blessing that allows me to live in harmony with these wild animals. I'm not a expert on drinking, why don't you ask Tae.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 3
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>The dream where I want to change into a sea creature has no chance to come true at all, is kind of regretful. I'm a fish, the air in the water��.. Swimming back and forth��..

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 4

Needs.Description: Help Tae to visit Granny - Beldi (2277, 2769).

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Use wine to get rid of my problems? NO! This does not fit my sunshine boy image. If Granny - Beldi knows about this, she'll no longer send me any cakes. For that tasty cake, I hold my grudge.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 4
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Really? Tae thought of me again? I think he misses the cakes I bake more, hoho.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 5

Needs.Description: Talk to Trader - Yuka (2519, 2397) at Cupid Isle

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I'll hurry and bake some cakes for Tae, but when it comes to bar, is not my age anymore. Thank you for asking though, maybe Trader - Yuka would be interested.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 5
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I'm scared to miss good things like drinking wine, but good thing granny still thinks of me, haha. I really miss eating granny's cake as I grow up.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 6

Needs.Description: Talk to Harbor Operator - Odie (738, 3803) at Karmas Haven.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Once I'm finished with moving these goodies I'll be going to the bar, hope my drinking friend Harbor Operator - Odie also can come.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 6
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>To a man, drinking means a chance to go on a date with a girl..

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 7

Needs.Description: Talk to Coral Vendor - Lamon (2061, 2543) at Region Ascaron.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>What are you laughing at?Humph! Help me inform the Conch Merchant . Lamon to come and collect his Conch, I need to go to the bar now.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 7
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Odie has always been a drunk with no money, I can only use this to make him help me.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 8

Needs.Description: Talk to Captain Jack (1672, 3777) on Canary Isle.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Why do you look at me like that? We merchants all look like this.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 8
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I am already used to being adored by girls, and boys being jealous.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 9

Needs.Description: Head to Autumn Island and talk toNorthern Pirate - Yakamoto (2221, 3285).

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Scar is a man badge, beer is a pirate's partner, I will not miss out on any beer. I wonder if my friend Northern Pirate - Yakamoto will join, although not a lot of people can understand him when he talks.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 9
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I am a pirate from a faraway land who just learnt your language.##@@#$, I love this beautiful island.&*&%, Hmm��but being a pirate is often misleading. I had some issue with Captain Jack when I first came here.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 10

Needs.Description: Talk to Trader - Sacenis (2279, 1112) at Glacier Isle.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Jack is going also? Please let me think about it then. I think I'll just go fishing with my friend Trader - Sacenis.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 10
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I really love Northern Pirate - Yakamoto, especially his romantic trait and his appearance switch.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 11

Needs.Description: Talk to ham (826, 3347) at Old Shaitan City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If Jack likes going to the bar, then I'll go to the sea side with Northern Pirate - Yakamoto. Enemies should meet less. Yes, I think that boy Ham will be interested in going to the bar.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 11
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Kids shouldn't be going to the bar, but��handsome boys are an expection! I will go for sure, thank you for the good news.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 12

Needs.Description: Talk to Zurbi (1037, 671) in Atlantis Haven.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Gentlemen will not enjoy the wine himself, and that's my rule. I am going to call my friend Zurbi.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 12
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>To speak the truth, everytime Ham gives a suggestion, it is very exciting. However, is because of this I get scold by my mother every time that I'm not mature enough.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 13

Needs.Description: Talk to Accessory - Rikka (996, 2969) in Andes Forest Haven.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Although I've sworn to never listen to his suggestions again, but going to the bar is my goal and sign to become mature, so..hehe, if you pass by Andes Forest Haven please help me ask Accessory - Rikka if he has any beautiful buttons. This will be my first time going to the bar, I cannot dress too poorly.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 13
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Selling buttons to go to the bar? Forbei has grow up now, but his mother face doesn't seem to get affected at all, she still processes the best charm as a customer.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 14

Needs.Description: Talk to Pirate Jeremy (2362, 657) on Isle of Chill.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Remembering back when I was young I met Pirate Jeremy, and our friendship is very good. My Jewlery business is so successful thanks to his help. If you're free to go Isle of Chill, please help me give my greetings to him.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 14
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Haha, that was my first time going to the bar. I remember that time I was only a tiny pirate, and I drank to make myself become more brave while sailing at sea. I don't know why I'm so fateful with Rikka, sometimes I think if Rikka is a girl, then maybe I won't be single anymore.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 15

Needs.Description: Talk to Lessie (1379, 612) at Icicle City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>This reminds me I want to join the pirate group Lessie, but too bad he's too tiny. If you want to travel out to the sea, you have to drink beer to become more brave.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 15
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>My goal is to become a Golden Pirate like Huckinson.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 16

Needs.Description: Talk to Harbor Operator - Whitcombe (2041, 1355) in <yHafta Haven>

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To achieve my dreams, I think I should start learning to swim, sword skills, and operate a boat. I think Harbor Operator - Whitcombe can help me learn how to operate a boat.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 16
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>He wants to learn operating a boat from me? Haha, my boat skills are very famous you know.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 17

Needs.Description: Talk to Solaru (1202, 3179) in Babu Haven.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I don't go to the bar anymore. There seem to be a growing of dark aura around here, If I don't help the ships that came from afar, I don't know how many people will become shark's buffet. Maybe you can go ask Solaru, I remember he said he was going to go for a vacation, maybe he can intro me a place or two.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 17
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>I'm a person who is willing to give up life just for my dreams and honour, even girls agree.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 18

Needs.Description: Talk to Harbor Operator - Ramus (2297, 3723) at Muse Haven.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I'm about to go out, if you have anything to say please hurry. Bar? That's a good place to meet people, I think I am going to change my plan now. Please help me tell Ramus that this haven came a lot of traders lately and he should look over his port as well, thank you very much.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 18
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Thank you for coming and bringing me this message. I'm short of man right now, do you want to stay here and be my assistant?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 19

Needs.Description: Look for Elizabeth in the Treasure Gulf at (616, 965).

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Habour Operator is a high rank and busy job. Speaking of busy I haven't seen cute Elizabeth for awhile, I wonder if her style is still the same.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 19
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Waiting for one person is very painful and lonely, but I enjoy my standing ground for this passion.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 20

Needs.Description: Talk to Miner Drunky (296, 57) down at Silver Mine B2

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>I always relay on some strange shining jewlery to waste time, but Miner Drunky told me he dugged up one Ancient Emerald, and I'm in need of money, I must make him stay and sell it to me. Strange though, how can digging dug up an emerald?

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 20
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>An outstanding man and expensive treasure is what beautiful women loves the most, like me and Ancient Emerald.

Definitions.Name: TOP Ambassador 21

Needs.Description: Talk to Babara (1310, 530).

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Congratlations for completing this super long Community quest, think now you will know more people around the world, this will help in your exploring a lot. I also heard the beautiful Bar Waitress - <bBabara> is looking for you.

Definitions.Name: Community Hero 21
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You have passed TOP test, I will award you with an emblem.

Needs.Description: Talk to Trader - Yuka (2519, 2397) at Cupid Isle
Talk to Harbor Operator - Ramus (2297, 3723) at Muse Haven.
Look for Heaven Teleporter at (474, 1054).

Definitions.Name: The Brave Love

Needs.Description: To Find Blurry in Argent City.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> There is still much room for improvement. You��d better visit Blurry, he will teach you a lot.

Definitions.Name: The Brave Love
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done, I should have more tasks to assign to you.

Definitions.Name: Mu's Rune
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>If only the Despair Knight - Saro can be defeated, then my soul will be released so that I can return to the Holy Land. I believe you are able to defeat him.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>You are really a honorable warrior. This rune is now yours as the reward. The next rune can be found on the Abyss Mudmonster - Karu, the guardian of Abaddon 6. He is the embodiment of Taurus--Aldebaran (178, 77). Go ahead! I will pray for you!

Definitions.Name: The Third Task

Needs.Description: Kill 20 Grassland Elks in Argent at <j(1390, 2658)> and come back.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t> Recently, the Grassland Elks brought us a lot of trouble. Could you give them a lesson for us?
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Well done. You completed it so quickly. I will reward you something.

Definitions.Name: The Sixth Task
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>The final task is very simple. All you need to do is just finding another two people as you companions. And on you team, you must have one person whose level is from 20 to 30, another person whose level is from 31 to 40 and the other whose level is higher than 40.When you make it, you can go to find Swordsman Ray in the Lower Icicle Castle to get your reward!

Definitions.Name: Journey of the Voyager

Needs.Description: Look for Burgess at (3254, 3278)
Look for Sacenis at (2279, 1112)
Talk to Dilady at (3595, 739)
Talk to Whitney at (3097, 3530)

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Since you chosen to be a <bVoyager>, you must be prepared for what is to come.<n><t>I have befriend some sailors when I was young. Now, they are incharge of harbors in some part of the world.<n><t>Take my recommendation letter to them and they will know what to do. <n><t>They are <pZephyr Isle>'s <b Burgess>, <pGlacier Isle>'s <b Sacenis>, <pOutlaw Isle>'s <b Dilady> and <pSara Haven>'s <b Whitney>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Oh you are back! You are now a full fledged <bVoyager>.<n><t>Sail the sea and make your legends today!

Definitions.Name: Walk of the Cleric

Needs.Description: Bring 3 Elven Fruit Juice, 2 Panacea and 1 Fancy Petal to <bGranny Dong> in Icicle Haven at (795, 363)
Bring 3 cups of Elven Fruit Juice, 2 Panacea and 1 Fancy Petal to <bDoctor Chivo> in Chaldea Haven at (630, 2091)

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To become a <bCleric>, you must have faith. I hope that you will remember this. I will give you a simple task.<n><t>Collect a total of 2 <yFancy Petals>, 4 <yPanaceas> and 6 bottles of <yElven Fruit Juice>.<n><t>Pass half of each to <bGranny Dong> in Icicle Haven and <bDoctor - Chivo> in Chaldea Haven. Each must receive 3 bottles of Elven Fruit Juice, 2 Panaceas and 1 Fancy Petal.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations!<n><t>You are now a qualifed <bCleric>!<n><t>May Goddess Kara be with you.

Definitions.Name: Ways of the Seal

Needs.Description: Bring the required 3 items and <yHeart of Purity> to <bHoly Priestess Ada> in <pOld Shaitan City> at (862, 3303). Let her purify it with the <ySoul of Purity>.

Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To become a <bSeal Master>, you must have a balance of good and evil. To test your ability, I need to do something:<n><t>Collect 3 <yDingle Bells> from <rCrazy Sheep>, 10 <yDangerous Sharp Claws> from <rStinging Beak> and 3 <yHearts of Purity> from <rSnow Spirit>. Bring these to <bHoly Priestess - Ada> at <pOld Shaitan City> and ask her to cleanse them with <ySoul of Purity>. <n><t>Look for <rStinging Beak> in the deep forest in <pAscaron> and the rest of monsters can be found near <pIcicle Castle>
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you are now a qualified <bSeal Master>.<n><t>May the Goddess bless you!

Definitions.Name: Code of the Crusader
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Looks like you have become an excellent Swordsman. Since you want to be stronger, you should advance to become a <bCrusader>. I will need to test you accordingly.<n><t>In the forest west of <pSolace Haven>, there are some <rThickskin Lizards>. Get 5 <yGreasy Lizard Skins> from them and go to <pSkeleton Haven> east of Icicle City, defeat 10 <rSkeletal Warriors> and get 3 <yWarrior Certificates>. Lastly, buy a set of <yBreast Plate> and return to me.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations!<n><t>You are now a full fledged <bCrusader>!<n><t>More challenges awaits you from now on!

Definitions.Name: Champion's Valor
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>Want to become a <bChampion>? Good!<n><t>However, you must bring the following items before you return: <n><t>You must have a suitable weapon of a Champion, go and buy a <yCriss Sword>. Bring me 5 <yNinja Masks> from <rNinja Mole>. 5 <rPolar Bear>'s <yGreat Bear Tooth> and 5 <ySolid Rock> from <rRock Golem>.<n><t>This way, you can prove that you have the capability to become a great Champion.<n><t>Look for <rNinja Mole> in <pAbandoned Mine>, <rRock Golem> in <pAndes Forest> and <rPolar Bear> can be found east of Icicle City
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You have successfully become a qualified <bChampion>!<n><t>More challenges awaits you!

Definitions.Name: Sharpshooter Range
Definitions.BeginTalk: <t>To become a <bSharpshooter> is simple. Go to <pSkeleton Haven>, defeat 10 <rSkeletal Archers> and bring back 5 <yOld Quivers>. Also, kill 10 <rNinja Moles> in <pAscaron>'s <pAbandoned Mine> and bring back 5 <rBroken Ninja Swords>.
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You have successfully become a qualified <bSharpshooter>!<n><t>Remember! The key to victory is to remain calm in all circumstances.

Definitions.Name: Swordsman Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you've obtained the Courage Certificate. You are now officially a Swordsman!<n><t>(You can now activate class quest at Peter.<n><t>Also, buy your weapons from Blacksmith Goldie, armor from Tailor Nila and skill books from Grocer Jimberry)

Definitions.Name: Herbalist Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulation my child! Now you are a Herbalist! May the Goddess be with you!<n><t>(You can now activate class quest at Gannon.<n><t>Also, buy your weapons from Blacksmith Smithy, armor from Tailor Moya and skill books from Grocer Amos)

Definitions.Name: Hunter Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations, you are now a qualified Hunter. Looks like things will be more peaceful here with you around.<n><t>(You can now activate class quest at Ray.<n><t>Also, buy your weapons from Blacksmith Bash, armor from Tailor Hannah and skill books from Grocer Palpin)

Definitions.Name: Explorer Promotion
Definitions.ResultTalk: <t>Congratulations! You are now a qualified Explorer! Your adventuring will lead you to many places around the world, quite the person of envy I must say!<n><t>(From now on, you can accept class quests from Little Daniel.<n><t>Also, you can buy Explorer's weapon from Blacksmith Goldie, defensive items from Tailor Granny Nila and also skills books from Grocer Jimberry. Dont forget!)
